title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Your Opportunity 

As a Principal Engineer , you will help design, build, and operate the clinical decision support and API-driven data delivery platform that enables Vytalize Health to embed timely, actionable clinical insights directly into provider workflows. Working cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Product, Clinical Operations, and EMR partners, your solutions will transform how clinicians access dataâmoving from external tools and workarounds to seamless, in-workflow decision support via CDS Hooks and real-time APIs. 

You will own the technical foundation for Clinical Decision Support (CDS) Hooks, REST APIs, and the architectural patterns that ensure clinical data is accessible, trustworthy, and performant at the moment of care. This role sits at the intersection of healthcare interoperability standards, modern API design, and operational excellence. You will establish reliability metrics and SLAs that ensure CDS Hooks and APIs serve clinician workflows with consistent quality and performance. You will be part of a small, high-performing healthcare engineering team where engineers support each other's growth through mentorship and tight collaboration.

Primary Responsibilities 

- Lead design and implementation of the CDS Hooks platform, including card orchestration, hook context handling, EHR-side logic orchestration, and integration with downstream data services

- Own CDS Hook API contracts and evolution, ensuring compliance with SMART CDS Hooks specification while adding performance, reliability, and healthcare-specific optimizations

- Lead technical integration with EMR systems (Epic, NextGen, Athena, ECW) for CDS Hook discovery, execution, card rendering, and user action handling

- Design, build, and maintain public-facing REST and event-driven APIs exposing clinical data, quality metrics, care gaps, attribution data, and decision support content to partners and provider-facing applications

- Establish API contracts, versioning strategies, and deprecation policies that balance innovation with stability for external consumers

- Implement and maintain API security patterns including OAuth 2.0, scope-based authorization, rate limiting, and audit logging for compliant clinical data access

- Design and optimize real-time or near-real-time data pipelines feeding CDS Hooks and APIsâensuring low latency, high freshness, and graceful failure modes

- Design and implement comprehensive testing and QA frameworks for CDS Hooks and APIs â including hook context validation, card rendering verification, and clinical workflow testing across EMR systems

- Establish reliability metrics and SLAs (latency, availability, freshness) for CDS Hook delivery and API performance; measure and track against clinical requirements

- Define and measure clinical impact metrics â adoption of CDS Hooks, clinician interaction rates, workflow integration success, and patient outcome influence

- Exercise architectural judgment across tradeoffs in correctness, latency, scalability, maintainability, and operational risk in clinical data systems

- Design and implement reliability patterns for CDS and API services including monitoring, alerting, failure detection, graceful degradation, and incident recovery

- Partner with Data Reliability Engineer to define and operate SLAs for CDS Hook delivery, API response times, and data freshness aligned to clinical needs

- Establish and uphold engineering standards for API design, data schemas, integration patterns, and interoperability; maintain high-quality technical documentation and OpenAPI specifications

- Partner with Data Engineering to align upstream data models, gold-layer datasets, and platform capabilities with clinical decision support and API requirements

- Serve as the technical authority on clinical interoperability standards (SMART CDS Hooks, FHIR, HL7, CDS Hooks, EHR integration patterns)

- Collaborate with Product, Clinical Operations, and Business stakeholders to clarify requirements, translate clinical workflows into platform features, and shape product direction

- Act as trusted technical advisor to EMR partners, healthcare systems, and external API consumers; ensure expectations and delivery are well-defined and predictable

- Ensure all CDS and API services comply with healthcare security, privacy, and regulatory requirements (HIPAA, state regulations, payer mandates)

- Partner with IT Security and Compliance teams to implement secure access controls, audit logging, encryption, and data protection measures across delivery mechanisms

- Design and implement audit trails for all clinical data access; support compliance audits and regulatory reporting

- Mentor team members through design reviews, pairing, and architectural guidance on clinical data integration and API design

- Document new and existing systems, designs, processes, and procedures

Required Qualifications 

- 8+ years of experience designing, building, and operating API platforms, service-oriented systems, or backend infrastructure at scale

- Demonstrated experience operating at a senior or staff-level individual contributor scope, owning complex systems end-to-end

- 3+ years of direct experience with healthcare data integrations, EMR workflows, clinical data exchange, or healthcare interoperability standards (FHIR, HL7, CDA, claims data)

- 2+ years of hands-on experience with CDS Hooks, SMART on FHIR, or similar clinical decision support APIs

- Strong experience designing and operating REST APIs, including contract design, versioning, error handling, and authentication/authorization patterns

- Deep understanding of healthcare data integrations, EMR workflows, and interoperability patterns (FHIR, HL7, CDS Hooks, SMART on FHIR)

- Expertise in designing for reliability, SLAs, and operational metrics; ability to translate clinical requirements into technical SLOs

- Experience defining and measuring API performance metrics (latency, availability, error rates); familiarity with SLA monitoring and enforcement

- Strong systems thinking with ability to design for scale, reliability, maintainability, and resilience

- Proficiency in modern backend languages (Python, Java, Go, or similar); comfort reading and reviewing code across languages

- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Databricks, GCP) and containerized services (Docker, Kubernetes, or managed services)

- Proven ability to partner effectively across engineering, product, analytics, clinical operations, and business teams

- Clear written and verbal communication skills, particularly for explaining technical concepts and tradeoffs to clinicians and non-specialists

- Comfortable working in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment with healthcare compliance and regulatory constraints

Strong Pluses 

- Hands-on experience with CDS Hooks specification and SMART on FHIR implementations in production healthcare environments

- Experience implementing and testing CDS Hooks across multiple EMR systems (Epic, NextGen, Athena, ECW) including clinical workflow validation

- Familiarity with healthcare data formats and standards: FHIR resources (Patient, Condition, Medication, etc.), CCD/C-CDA, claims data (837s, 835s), HL7 v2 or v3

- Experience designing and operating real-time or near-real-time data pipelines feeding clinical applications and decision support systems

- Knowledge of value-based care metrics, care gaps, quality measures (NQF, HEDIS), and HCC/RAF risk stratification

- Experience with API management platforms, developer portals, or partner ecosystem / API monetization patterns

- Familiarity with OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and federated identity patterns in healthcare systems

- Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and safe deployment practices

- Background supporting provider-facing platforms or external clinical partners; deep understanding of provider workflows and constraints

- Experience in a healthcare startup or high-growth healthcare technology environment

- Familiarity with healthcare data governance, interoperability regulations (21st Century Cures, ONC rules), and clinical data quality frameworks

- Experience with API testing frameworks and quality assurance for distributed systems

Perks/Benefits 

- Competitive base compensation

- Annual bonus potential

- Health benefits effective on start date

- Health & Wellness Program; up to $300 per quarter for your overall well-being available on start date

- 401K plan effective on the first of the month after your start date; 100% of up to 4% of your annual salary

- Unlimited (or generous) paid "Vytal Time", and 5 paid sick days after your first 90 days

- Company paid STD/LTD

- Technology setup

- Ability to help build a market leader in value-based healthcare at a rapidly growing organization

Please note at no time during our screening, interview, or selection process do we ask for additional personal information (beyond your resume) or account/financial information. We will also never ask for you to purchase anything; nor will we ever interview you via text message. Any communication received from a Vytalize Health recruiter during your screening, interviewing, or selection process will come from an email ending in @ vytalizehealth.com

title: Graphic Designer & Video Editor
description:
Description BlueTuskr is a full-service e-commerce growth agency built exclusively for e-commerce brands. We combine paid media, owned media, creative, and analytics to help our clients scale profitably. Our team is made up of specialists who are deeply invested in their craft â and in the success of the brands they serve.

This isn't a "jack of all trades" environment. We hire people who are exceptional at what they do, then give them the resources and autonomy to do it well.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Graphic Designer and Video Editor who creates with conversion in mind. You know that a beautiful email that doesn't get clicks isn't finished yet, and that a product page is a sales tool first. This is a hands-on role for someone who has spent real time designing for e-commerce brands â emails, landing pages, website sections, and social/ad creative â and can explain exactly why each design choice was made.

You'll design across a portfolio of e-commerce clients, working closely with our email, CRO, Shopify development, and paid media teams. You'll also use Claude and other AI tools as a real part of your workflow â to move faster on ideation, variations, and production, without sacrificing quality or brand consistency.

This role starts part-time at 15 hours/week, with real room to grow as your client roster and responsibilities expand.

What You'll Own Email & Retention Design

- Design campaign and automated flow emails (newsletters, welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back, etc.) that are on-brand and built to drive clicks and revenue
- Design mobile-first, with clear hierarchy, scannable layouts, and strong calls to action
- Prepare email-ready files and specs (image slicing, live text vs. image text, alt text, dark mode considerations) for clean builds in Klaviyo and other email platforms
Web Creative & CRO Support

- Design landing pages, homepage, and collection page sections, product page (PDP) modules, banners, and promotional assets for Shopify stores
- Partner with the CRO team to design test variations based on data, heatmaps, and hypotheses â not just personal taste
- Hand off dev-ready Figma files to our web developers, with desktop and mobile layouts, organized layers, and clear specs
Social & Ad Creative

- Design static social and paid ad creative for Meta, TikTok, and other channels
- Create ad variations and iterations to support creative testing
- Video editing for social and ad use (resizing, trimming, captions, simple motion) where needed
Process & Quality

- Follow each client's brand guidelines closely, and flag gaps or inconsistencies when guidelines are missing or unclear
- Apply design and e-commerce best practices (accessibility, contrast, legibility, load-friendly assets, platform specs)
- Present work with a clear rationale â why this layout, this hierarchy, this CTA â to internal teams and, when needed, clients
- Take feedback well, turn revisions around quickly, and keep work moving across multiple accounts and deadlines
- Use Claude and other AI tools to speed up concepting, copy-to-layout exploration, asset variations, and repetitive production tasks â while following client confidentiality and our AI use guidelines
Who You Are Skills get you in the door. These are the qualities that make you right for this role:

- An exceptional designer with a strong eye for layout, typography, and color â your portfolio speaks for itself
- Conversion-minded â you think about what the customer needs to see, feel, and do next, not just what looks good
- Detail-obsessed â you catch the misaligned element, the off-brand color, and the typo before anyone else does
- A clear communicator who can explain the reasoning behind design choices and keeps the team updated without being chased
- Excellent at managing your time â you can juggle multiple clients and deadlines in a remote, async environment without dropping the ball
- AI-curious and AI-capable â you already use tools like Claude in your workflow and are excited to find new ways to work smarter
- Adaptable â you can shift between very different brand styles and still make each one feel right.
What Success Looks Like In your first 90 days:

- You've learned the brand guidelines and design systems for your assigned client accounts
- You're consistently delivering email, web, and social designs on time with minimal revision rounds
- You've handed off at least one web project or CRO test variation to our Shopify dev team with clean, dev-ready files
- You've built AI into your workflow in a way that measurably speeds up production
- Internal teams trust your work and your reasoning, and come to you with ideas, not just requests

Must-Have:

- 2â4 years of e-commerce digital design experience (email, website, social, etc.)
- A portfolio showing e-commerce work â ideally with context on goals and results
- Advanced proficiency in Figma
- Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
- Hands-on experience using Claude and/or other AI tools in a design workflow
- Experience designing for the web and supporting website creative (landing pages, site sections, PDPs)
- Strong understanding of conversion-focused design and e-commerce best practices
- Proven ability to follow and apply brand guidelines across multiple brands
- Strong written and spoken English for async communication with a U.S.-based team
Strong Differentiators:

- Video editing skills (Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or similar)
- Experience designing for Klaviyo or other email platforms
- Familiarity with Shopify themes and how designs get built
- Experience designing A/B test variations or working with CRO data
- Paid social ad creative experience (Meta, TikTok)
- Agency background preferred

This role is fully remote.

Time Commitment and Availability

- Hours: 15 hours/week to start, with the opportunity to scale up as the role and client roster grow
- Availability: Between 9 a.m. and 6 p.m. EST
Compensation

$20â25 USD/hour, based on experience and portfolio. This is a part-time, remote contractor role starting at 15 hours/week. Video editing experience is a strong plus and is factored into the rate.

title: Technical Customer Support
description:
QuickMail is a cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform for markets you can't afford to burn. Our customers can't easily replace leads that land in spam, which is why deliverability matters more to us than anything else. We have been running since 2014, and we pioneered deliverability technology such as Inbox rotationâ¢ and deliverability AIâ¢.

The Role

We are hiring a technical customer support person with an owner's mentality.

You will own support for QuickMail and Mailflow, our deliverability add-on. There is no first or second line. You are the first and last person our customers talk to.

Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are.

The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking.

This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer.

We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it.

If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.

What Work Looks Like

You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable.

Every day

- Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it.

- Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution.

- Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform.

Delighting customers

- Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast, and setting them up for success.

- Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked.

- Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates.

Making support smarter with AI

- Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off.

- Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do.

- Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving.

Keeping the product solid

- Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected.

- Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors.

- Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks (emails not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or Telegram, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. Then run the retrospective so it does not happen twice.

Running the week

- Lead the weekly team meeting in MonsterOps: issues written up, to-dos done, numbers updated.

- Keep rock status and KPIs current in MonsterOps.

Tools you'll use: Helpscout, our Support Dashboard, Sidekiq, GitHub, Slack, Telegram, MonsterOps, Outline, MxToolbox, Postmark, Bento, TidyCal, Fathom, Visual Code and Claude.

Who You Are

- You build rapport fast. You are warm, positive, and relatable in writing and on calls.

- You are a good communicator. Externally, you can show warmth, empathy and care. Internally, you are able to communicate clearly and concisely about important things.

- You can operate with minimal instructions. You understand a short brief without every detail spelled out. You can prioritize well (especially when you have a lot on your plate), and get things done without hand-holding.

- You are comfortable on video. You are natural on live calls with Zoom and Meet, and on recorded video through tools like Loom.

- Your teammates can always count on you. You say what you'll do and you do what you said.

- You act with a constant sense of urgency. You can execute fast and find new ways to improve your productivity.

- You are resourceful. You use all the tools at your disposal to get great results.

- You have a low ego. You don't take offense easily and you handle disagreement as a discussion, not a personal attack.

- Growth mindset. You are positive about new workflow/process/product/tool changes. You love giving and receiving positive and negative feedback without getting defensive.

- Hours that overlap with East coast US and UK, where most of our customers are.

A Plus If You Have

- Experience with customer facing work, or if you don't have it, tell us why you are perfect for this role.

- Working knowledge of deliverability and LinkedIn outreach. Warmup, DNS, inbox rotation, DKIM, SPF, Outlook and Gmail technical setup. We can teach this, but a head start helps.

- Comfort with agency setups. Workspaces, guest seats, inbox purchases and what happens when an agency loses a client.

- Light data skills. You can pull numbers from Help Scout or our MCP to back up what you report.

- An eye for happy customers. You notice them and ask for testimonials and case studies at the right moment.

How We Work Together

You'll work directly with the founder and with our lead developer.

Working with the founder can be intense. Here is what that looks like in practice:

- Replies are short and can come across as harsh. If something written lands badly or isn't clear, ask.

- Direction can change. The founder may say one thing, then something different a few days later as they learn more. When that happens, check what changed and adapt.

- Information should be short and to the point. Lead with what matters, then give more details if asked.

- The founder can stay frustrated about a problem until it's solved. That's something they are aware of and working on. You'll do well here if you can stay calm and focused when the pressure is on.

- The team often thinks fast and interrupts each other when discussing ideas. If that would bother you, this role probably isn't for you.

This role suits someone with high emotional intelligence, who doesn't take things personally, asks when something is unclear, and keeps many things moving at once.

Your schedule can be flexible. If you have a martial arts class every Thursday at 3 pm, go and make up the time later. In return, on the rare occasion the team needs your help on a weekend, we ask you to be flexible too.

Benefits

- Contract type: full-time or part-time

- Compensation: $2,500 to $4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and location. US-based hires will work as independent contractors (1099).

- Start date: negotiable

Welcome to Miaplaza! 

Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive homeschool curriculum platform where all students can be successful! 

MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio is our newest offering for Ohio families looking for a flexible public school option. The school will serve grades 7-11 in its first year. The school aims to serve 250 students year one, with plans to grow to over 1,000 students by 2030. ð

Role Summary 

The Academic Dean leads the instructional team and is the school's authority on academic standards at MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio (MOAO), including student conduct, attendance compliance, and academic integrity. This person is the primary leader for teacher supervision and development, oversees academic data and testing coordination, and works closely with the Student Support team (counselors and advisors), who lead student interventions and support. As a member of the MOAO leadership team, the Academic Dean contributes to schoolwide strategy and helps keep instruction, student culture, and compliance with Ohio requirements working together. The role calls for someone who can coach teachers with warmth and rigor, handle sensitive student and family situations with sound judgment, and use data to make decisions. 

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES 

Instructional Staff Management 

- Directly supervise instructional staff, holding weekly 1:1s focused on coaching, support, and goal setting. 

- Lead recruiting, onboarding, and training for new teachers. 

- Observe live instruction and office hours on a bi-weekly basis and provide actionable feedback. 

- Monitor grading practices to ensure students receive timely, high-quality feedback. 

- Complete annual and semi-annual walk-throughs and performance reviews as outlined by the ODEW and manage bi-weekly timecard approvals. 

- Coordinate instructional and grading coverage for teacher absences. 

- Address performance concerns through clear expectations, documentation, and, when needed, formal improvement plans in partnership with People Operations. 

Student Conduct, Attendance & Academic Integrity 

- Own the school's student conduct process, from initial report through investigation, determination, and documentation, applying policy consistently and fairly and creating policy where needed. 

- Oversee academic integrity cases, including investigating suspected plagiarism, AI misuse, and other violations, and ensuring consistent, well-documented outcomes. 

- Own the school's truancy and attendance compliance process, including required notifications, documentation, and filings under Ohio law. 

- Partner with the Student Support team, which leads outreach, intervention plans, and ongoing student support. Hand off cases and coordinate so that accountability and support work together. 

- Serve as the escalation point for teachers and Student Support on conduct, attendance, and integrity concerns. 

- Communicate with students and families about conduct and integrity decisions in a way that is clear, respectful, and focused on getting students back on track. 

- Maintain accurate records and report on trends in conduct, attendance, and integrity cases to school leadership.Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â 

- Keep handbooks, policies, and procedures current in these areas. 

Academic Data & Testing Coordination 

- Analyze course-, teacher-, and school-level data on performance, engagement, and attendance to identify trends, risks, and opportunities. 

- Turn data into action by recommending and implementing instructional strategies, and share insights with Student Support to inform their interventions. 

- Serve as the school's testing coordinator for Ohio state assessments and other required or school-administered testing, including scheduling, proctoring logistics, test security, accommodations coordination, and make-up testing. 

- Partner with the appropriate teams on state data reporting, ensuring accuracy and timeliness. 

- Prepare clear summaries of academic and testing data for leadership, teachers, and families. 

Professional Development 

- Design and lead regular PD sessions for instructional staff, informed by teacher feedback, observation, and student data. 

- Build a culture of continuous improvement, reflective practice, and growth for the instructional team. 

- Collaborate with school and company leadership on schoolwide professional learning priorities. 

Curriculum & Cross-Team Collaboration 

- Serve as the primary point of contact between the instructional team and the Content team on curriculum, checkpoint assignments, and MiaPrep platform issues. 

- Gather teacher and student feedback and make curriculum recommendations. 

- Support consistency in instructional practice and expectations across courses and departments. 

- Lead regular instructional team meetings to align resources, expectations, and practices. 

- Assist teachers in comparing their curriculum to the OST blueprints to identify gaps, and create a plan to fill these gaps in the short and long term.Â 

What We're Looking For 

- Proven leadership experience managing, coaching, or mentoring teachers 

- Sound judgment and a steady hand with sensitive student, family, and staff situations; knows when to resolve and when to escalate 

- A collaborative approach to working across teams, especially with student support professionals 

- Excellent written and verbal communication, including documentation that holds up to scrutiny 

- A fair, consistent, relationship-first approach to discipline and accountability 

- Comfort with data and the ability to translate it into clear decisions 

- Exceptional organization and follow-through across many concurrent priorities 

- Resilient, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement in a fast-paced environment 

- Growth mindset with a focus on coaching and constructive feedback 

THIS POSITION IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND THE EMPLOYER INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY DECEMBER 1ST, 2026. 

Requirements: 

- Bachelor's degree required; master's degree in education, educational leadership, or a related field preferred 

- Valid Ohio teaching license and/or administrator license, or ability to obtain one, to be confirmed against current requirements 

- At least 3 years of teaching experience 

- At least 2 years of experience in a leadership role such as department chair, instructional coach, dean, or assistant principal 

- Experience in virtual school settings or teaching online 

- Experience supervising employees and conducting evaluations or performance reviews 

- Comfort working in online learning environments and with learning management and student information systems 

The Ideal Candidate Brings: 

- Experience administering or coordinating standardized testing and working with student assessment data 

- Experience as a member of a founding team for a new school 

Compensation & Benefits 

- The expected starting pay range is $40.00 - $48.00 per hour. An Academic Dean at MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio works an average of 40 hours per week. When working year-round, this can equate to an annual pay range of $83,000 - $99,800.

Eligible employees can use PTO for all kinds of absences including: vacation, holidays, illness, injury, family leave, and other personal business. Full-time employees receive 16 hours of floating holiday PTO per quarter and accumulate additional PTO at the rate of 1 hour per every 15 hours worked. The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product. You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself.

- Leadership - Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.- Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.- Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it. 

Mandatory: 

- Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally AI-powered apps. 

- Strong product sense : you can tell a good feature from a busy one. 

- Intuition for applied AI and on-device constraints : model size, latency, memory, battery, and the gap between a good demo and a reliable feature. You don't need ML research expertise, because our core abstracts it away. 

- You use AI tools heavily in your own work and enjoy experimenting with new models and capabilities. 

- Deep JavaScript and React . 

- Initiative, curiosity, resilience , and the ability to give and receive direct critique. 

Preferred: 

- Bonus: Experience with local or on-device inference, LLM evals, cross-platform mobile and desktop apps, or open source .

description:
Fuel50 is a workforce transformation platform helping organisations understand workforce capability, build skills and enable internal mobility in an AI-driven world. Our products combine skills intelligence, talent marketplace experiences and responsible AI to help people and organisations take their next step.Â 

We are looking for a Product Design Lead to shape the next chapter of our product experience and design organisation.Â 

This is a senior player-coach role. You will lead and develop our product design team while staying close to the work, setting direction, shaping product strategy, prototyping ideas and helping teams ship high-quality experiences.Â 

You will work closely with Product and Engineering as a leadership trio, influencing decisions across the organisation and helping Fuel50 build products that are simple, trusted and valuable.Â 

If youâre a strategic design leader who still loves getting close to the work, developing people and shipping real product, weâd love to hear from you!Â 

What you'll do: - Lead, manage and coach our product designers, supporting their growth and helping them reach their next level.Â 
- Set and communicate a clear product design vision across Fuel50's skills intelligence, talent mobility and AI-powered experiences, and tell the story of where our products are going in a way that excites customers, colleagues and leadership.Â 
- Own the design direction without waiting for it to be handed to you. Spot opportunities, form a point of view, and prototype ideas to make them tangible.Â 
- Bring a strong point of view to senior conversations, challenge assumptions constructively and influence decisions across the business.Â 
- Partner with Product and Engineering from discovery through to delivery, balancing customer value, design quality, technical reality and pace.Â 
- Design human-centred AI experiences with appropriate trust, explainability, user control and clear handoffs, including agent and assistant experiences that work across multiple surfaces such as the Fuel50 platform, Microsoft Teams and Copilot.Â 
- Grow our design engineering capability, and be comfortable building and shipping working prototypes or code yourself.Â 
- Evolve our design system, accessibility standards (including WCAG compliance) and design-to-code practices so Fuel50 feels coherent and high quality across every product.Â 
- Shape design team structure, capability, hiring, planning and ways of working as the organisation evolves.Â 

What you'll bring: - Experience in product design in a SaaS or technology environment (we suggest 7 or more years), including at least 2 years leading, managing or coaching designers, and a track record of building healthy, high-performing teams.Â 
- Strong product design craft across discovery, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, research and shipped digital products.Â 
- Experience designing complex, connected systems and journeys for multiple personas, ideally in an enterprise or B2B product.Â 
- The ability to think big and set a compelling vision, while staying pragmatic about what can be learned and shipped next.Â 
- The ability to originate ideas and direction, and to communicate them clearly through stories, prototypes and design narrative.Â 
- Confidence working with experienced senior stakeholders and influencing through clarity, judgement and strong communication.Â 
- Experience working closely with Product and Engineering as a genuine cross-functional trio.Â 
- Technical fluency and a willingness to get into the code. You should be comfortable building working prototypes using HTML, CSS, JavaScript or similar tools, and have contributed code that has shipped to production, for example front-end changes or design system components submitted through pull requests.Â 
- Hands-on experience using AI coding and design tools, such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, to prototype faster and ship real work. We want someone who uses these tools well and can show how they have changed the way their team works.Â 
- Working knowledge of accessibility and WCAG. You have designed to WCAG standards, tested for it, and built accessibility into your team's design system and review process.Â 
- An interest in design systems and data-informed decision-making.Â 
You do not need to tick every box. We care about the quality of your thinking, the way you work with people and your ability to turn ambitious ideas into better product experiences.Â 

All Fuellies are a core part of our culture and making Fuel50 an amazing place to work. Some additional benefits are:Â Â 

- A day off on your birthday and your Fuel50 anniversaryÂ 
- A âReFuel Dayâ once a quarter to relax and refuelÂ 
- Remote work and flexible work times - we're supportive of school commitments, traveling in off-peak hours, and attending to lifeâs eventsÂ 
- A progressive parental leave policyÂ 
- Comprehensive fully subsidised health insurance with Southern CrossÂ 
What's it like to be a Fuellie? Fuel50âs team is fully remote, with an HQ in New Zealand, and team members across five countries. We have a co-working space in the BHive in Takapuna that we use to meet occasionally for team and strategic planning and other team events. If youâre based outside of Auckland and are needed on-site for anything, weâll pay for you to get here.Â 

We know that having the right people with the right attitude and behaviour is a big part of what makes us successful.Â Living our values is an important part of being successful in this role.Â Â 

- We have a culture around continuous and respectful feedback and recognition - be part of a team working towards a common goal and helping each other every step of the way.Â Â 
- We have #SuperheroAwards at quarterly planning meetings and spontaneous recognition and shout-outs across the business.Â Â 
- We'll have your back when you need help - your colleagues want to see you succeed and work hard to help you do so.Â Â 
- We work hard and deliver amazing results to our clients - when you see our amazing feedback, you'll be proud to be a Fuellie.Â 
Application process: If this sounds like you, then please apply. If youâre not sure you're ready or perhaps you don't meet all requirements yet, please apply anyway. We'll review every application that we get.Â Â 

Please include a link to your portfolio or attach it as part of your application.Â 

This role is based in New Zealand, candidates must hold the relevant right to work in NZ i.e. Citizenship or a work visa at the time of application.Â

title: Director Payment Integrity
description:
Job Title: Director, Payment Integrity 

Reports To: Vice President, Operations

This is an exempt position reporting to the Vice President, Operations. The Director of Payment Integrity is responsible for the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams. This role functions as both the director setting strategy for these departments and the direct supervisor managing day to day operations. This position interfaces with all departments of SIHO as well as external stakeholders, vendors, and customers. The ability to interact with all levels of SIHO staff and external parties with a high level of professionalism, while adapting quickly between multiple high priority items, is essential.

Brief Description of Duties: 

- Directly supervise and manage the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams, including day to day oversight, staffing, and performance management

- Read, research, and interpret federal and state regulations governing grievances and appeals, and translate regulatory requirements into practical, actionable process changes

- Continuously monitor and improve grievances and appeals processes to ensure ongoing compliance with CMS and state regulatory requirements

- Support the claims and benefit configuration quality assurance program, including developing and delivering training and education for staff

- Stay current on emerging fraud, waste, and abuse trends and lead efforts to proactively identify and investigate potential FWA

- Review results across all three departments and identify process improvement initiatives and cost savings opportunities

- Analyze department and operational data in Excel to identify trends and draw actionable insights

- Manage data transfers with vendor partners, meet with vendors regularly to ensure processes are working as intended, and escalate potential issues as they arise

- Interact directly with customers as needed

- Work with SIHO Legal and key leadership on special cases and external inquiries from CMS, the Indiana Department of Insurance, law enforcement, and others

- Develop, maintain, and report statistical measurements assessing the effectiveness of the QA, FWA, and G&A programs

- Lead or support key corporate and departmental compliance initiatives, including SOC audits, CMS Part C Reporting and ODAG, and others as assigned

Minimum Skills Requirement:

title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey 
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role 
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do 

- Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

- Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

- Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

- Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

- Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

- Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

- Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

- Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for 

- Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

- Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

- AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

- High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

- Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

- Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit 

- Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

- MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

- Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting 

- Competitive, top-of-market compensation

- You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

- Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

- Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

Learn more about Delinea on Delinea.com , LinkedIn , X , and YouTube .

Join our passionate, global team at Delinea and help us make the world a safer and more secure place. Our success is driven by world-class product leadership, outstanding engineers, and strategic investment from TPG. We value diversity, innovation, and a culture of respect and fairness. If you're ready to push boundaries and challenge the status quo in security, we want to hear from you.
Â 

Apply today to help us achieve our mission.

Delinea secures human, machine, and AI identities, eliminating standing privilege and reducing the attack surface across on-premises and cloud. As the platform expands into Non-Human Identity governance, AI agent identity, StrongDM, and consumption-based licensing, we are hiring a dedicated leader to own how we package value and price capability across the whole portfolio. This is a horizontal L-1 role, peer to the General Managers of Workforce, Workload and AI, reporting to the Chief Product Officer. 

What You Will Own 

- Price and packaging architecture across the portfolio: tiering, licensing metrics, add-on structure, bundling. 

- Proposal quality into our monthly Price Committee: the analysis, the financial model, the recommendation, and the action register through to closure. 

- Discount governance, including band policy and the guardrails behind it. 

- Monetization for new categories: NHI governance, AI agent identity, StrongDM, consumption-based licensing. 

- Commercial readiness at launch, so packaging and pricing ship with the product. 

- The single source of truth for pricing, packaging and quoting guidance, partnering with Product Marketing on seller enablement. 

- Price realization, attach rate and competitive position, informed by competitor pricing, market benchmarks and win/loss data. 

What We Are Looking For 

- 12+ years across pricing strategy, monetization, product management or product marketing, including 5+ years owning pricing as a named function. 

- A track record of building a monetization function where none existed: cadence, governance, documentation, analytical bench. 

- Experience preparing and defending recommendations to a formal pricing committee or equivalent decision body. 

- Demonstrated design of tiered packaging for enterprise software, and strong financial modeling (pricing impact, ARR and expansion, discount optimization). 

- Credibility with executive peers, holding a position on pricing under pressure without direct authority over sales or finance. 

Strongly preferred 

- Cybersecurity or identity security (PAM, IAM, SIEM, endpoint); exposure to NHI, machine identity or secrets management. 

- Consumption-, usage-, or outcome-based pricing models alongside seat-based subscription. 

- Working knowledge of CPQ (Salesforce CPQ, Apttus); pricing through M&A integration or a major commercial model transition. MBA a plus. 

Why Now 

Pricing at Delinea has been carried by people doing it well alongside a full portfolio, and the surface area keeps growing. The opportunity is to make monetization a professional discipline, with a decision forum that already works. If you want to own monetization end-to-end rather than manage an approval queue, this role is built for it. 

Why work at Delinea? 

- We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.

- We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.

- What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.

At Delinea, our core values are STRONG and guide our behaviors and success: 

- Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do

- Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments

- Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team

- Ownership - We take initiative and follow through

- Nimble - We adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment

- Global - We embrace diverse people and ideas to drive better outcomes

We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.

We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays. 

Delinea is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type with regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Dann bist du bei Finanzcheck genau richtig. Wir sind eines der führenden Online-Kreditportale in Deutschland und bringen seit Jahren erfolgreich Kund*innen und Banken zusammen. Dabei setzen wir auf leistungsstarken Vertrieb, moderne Tools und ein Team, das Erfolge feiert.

Bei uns erwartet dich kein Callcenter-Job, sondern eine professionelle Vertriebsumgebung, in der dein Einsatz und dein Ehrgeiz den Unterschied machen. Mit unserer ungedeckelten Provision bestimmst du dein Gehalt selbst – wer stark performt, kann bei uns auch überdurchschnittlich verdienen!

Zur Verstärkung unseres Vertriebsteams mit knapp 100 Vertriebsprofis suchen wir dich ab sofort in Vollzeit als:

Vertriebsprofi - Kreditberatung im Homeoffice (w/m/d) 

Das machst du bei uns

- Du übernimmst die telefonische Kundenberatung und den aktiven Verkauf unserer Kreditlösungen bezüglich der Vermittlung von Krediten unserer Partnerbanken.

- Vom ersten Kundenkontakt bis zum Vertragsabschluss bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson und führst unsere Kund*innen durch den gesamten Prozess.

- Mit deinem Gespür für Kund*innenbedürfnisse erstellst du maßgeschneiderte Angebote und überzeugst mit deiner Abschlussstärke.

- Du setzt moderne Vertriebsmethoden und Tools ein, um deine Abschlüsse effizient und erfolgreich zu gestalten.

- Dein Fokus liegt klar auf dem Abschluss – die Beratung steht im Vordergrund, aber du verfolgst immer das Ziel, unsere Kreditlösungen zu verkaufen.

Das bist du

- Du bringst nachweisbare Vertriebserfahrung aus dem Direktvertrieb oder Telesales mit.

- Idealerweise hast du Produkte oder Dienstleistungen im Bereich Finanzen, Banken und Versicherungen vertrieben bzw. dazu beraten.

- Begriffe wie Upselling / Cross Selling sind dir nicht fremd – Vertrieb ist für dich mehr als ein Job, es ist dein Antrieb.

- Am Telefon überzeugst du durch eine klare, professionelle und verbindliche Kommunikation.

- Du verfügst über Erfahrungen im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen und hast eine gewisse Technikaffinität, um dich schnell in neue Systeme rein zu arbeiten.

- Du bist ein Teamplayer, aber vor allem ein Hunter, der Spaß daran hat, Kund*innen zu gewinnen und Abschlüsse zu feiern.

Das bieten wir dir

- Ungedeckelte Provisionen – dein Einsatz bestimmt dein Einkommen, ohne Limit nach oben.

- Ein Fixgehalt, kombiniert mit einem leistungsstarken Provisionsmodell.

- Karriere- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten in einem erfolgreichen und wachsenden Vertriebsteam.

- Work-Life-Balance: Genieße die Flexibilität, zu 100% deutschlandweit im Homeoffice zu arbeiten. 
- Du wohnst in Berlin oder Hamburg? Auch für dich haben wir drei Tage Homeoffice: Mit einem Hybridmodell schaffen wir die perfekte Balance zwischen Fokuszeit und Team-Spirit in unseren modernen Büros vor Ort.

- 30 Tage Urlaub + zusätzliche Kinderkranktage.

- Umfangreiche Einarbeitung, regelmäßige Sales-Coachings und Profi-Trainings, damit du dein Potenzial voll ausschöpfst.

- Ein starkes Team von ehrgeizigen Vertriebler*innen, mit denen du Erfolge gemeinsam feiern kannst.

Worauf wartest du noch? 

Wenn du ein echter Vertriebsprofi bist, der Abschlüsse liebt und bereit ist, durch Leistung sein Einkommen auf das nächste Level zu bringen, dann wartet bei Finanzcheck deine Chance.

Lade hierzu einfach deinen Lebenslauf hoch (vorzugsweise als PDF-Datei) und wir melden uns innerhalb von wenigen Tagen zurück. Bewerbungen werden ausschließlich über das Bewerbungsformular angenommen. 

Bei Fragen erreichst du mich und dein Talent Acquisition Team jederzeit unter -----
Ich freue mich auf deine Bewerbung! ☺️

Tugce Cakir 

Wir setzen uns für ein diverses und inklusives Umfeld ein. Gemeinsam als ein Team aus über 50 Nationen mit unseren verschiedenen Fähigkeiten, Ideen und Erfahrungen arbeiten wir aktiv daran, Vielfalt im Unternehmen zu repräsentieren.

Bei Finanzcheck.de stehen wir für Vielfalt und schaffen ein Umfeld, das eine Vielzahl von Perspektiven, Fähigkeiten und Backgrounds repräsentiert. Wir setzen uns für gleiche Beschäftigungs- und Entwicklungschancen ein, unabhängig vom Geschlecht oder der Geschlechtsidentität, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, Hautfarbe, Beeinträchtigung, Kultur oder Herkunftsland.

Kannst du dich mit unserer Kultur identifizieren? Dann werde Teil von uns! #bestesTeam

description:
Your mission

As a Senior Customer Success Manager at Boardwise, you will help our enterprise customers successfully implement, adopt, and scale Boardwise across their organisation. - Based in Germany

- Structured, proactive, hands-on, and customer-first mindset

- Strong understanding of corporate decision-making processes and organizational hierarchies.

- Experience working with Executive Offices, Board Offices, or Corporate Secretariats.

- Proven experience engaging with C-level executives and senior management

Why us?

- 100% remote work and flexible working hours

- High ownership in a fast-growing SaaS company

- Strategic role at the intersection of Customer Success, Consulting, Change Management, Product, and Sales

- Close collaboration with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders

- Transparent, trust-based culture with fast decision-making

- 2–3 offsites and workshops per year

- Clear development paths and a steep learning curve

der task

you

description:
Deine Aufgaben bei Varify

- Du übernimmst Neukunden nach dem Abschluss vom Sales-Team und bringst sie strukturiert zum ersten erfolgreichen Test.

- Du betreust ein eigenes Kundenportfolio, führst regelmäßige Check-ins und Strategie-Calls und hilfst bei Testideen und Priorisierung.

- Du erkennst Abwanderungsrisiken früh, anhand von Nutzungsdaten und Health-Score, und gehst proaktiv auf Kunden zu, bevor sie kündigen.

- Du identifizierst Upsell-Potenziale, etwa auf höhere Pläne oder neue AI-Features, und übergibst oder schließt sie selbst ab.

- Du führst Kündigungsgespräche, verstehst die echten Gründe dahinter und machst Rettungsangebote.

- Du gibst strukturiertes Kundenfeedback an Produkt und Entwicklung weiter und baust Customer-Success-Prozesse mit auf.

So sieht der Job konkret aus

- Du betreust Kundenaccounts, von KMU bis Mid-Market, plus Agenturen, die Varify für ihre Kunden nutzen.

- Deine Tools: HubSpot, ChartMogul und unsere eigenen Nutzungsdaten.

- Du berichtest an Frederick Mieke (CRO) und arbeitest eng mit Sales, Support und Produkt zusammen.

- Woran wir Erfolg messen: Net Revenue Retention, Logo-Churn, Time-to-First-Test

- Du baust den Bereich mit auf. Viele Prozesse entstehen gerade erst, du gestaltest sie mit

Was du mitbringst

- Mindestens 2–3 Jahre Erfahrung in Customer Success, Account Management oder Beratung, idealerweise im B2B-SaaS-Umfeld

- Verständnis für Online-Marketing und Web-Analytics. Erfahrung mit A/B-Testing, CRO oder GA4 ist ein großes Plus.

- Technisches Grundverständnis: Du schreckst nicht vor einem Tracking-Setup oder einem Snippet zurück.

- Du arbeitest gern mit Zahlen und priorisierst nach Daten statt nach Bauchgefühl.

- Du kommunizierst klar und empathisch, auch wenn ein Kunde gerade unzufrieden ist.

- Sehr gutes Deutsch und verhandlungssicheres Englisch, denn ein großer Teil unserer Kunden ist international.

Ihre ersten Monate bei Varify

Du lernst unsere Plattform und unsere Kundenstruktur im Team kennen und übernimmst schrittweise die eigenständige Betreuung unseres Bestandsportfolios. Wenn du nicht jeden Punkt unserer Anforderungen zu hundert Prozent erfüllen, freuen wir uns dennoch über deine Bewerbung.

Das bieten wir dir

Du erhältst ein variables Jahresgehalt von EUR 53,000–72,000, welches sich einem Fixgehalt und einer Provision zusammensetzen.

Du profitierst von zusätzlichen Urlaubstagen, Vorteilen bei öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln, Unterkunft, der Möglichkeit zum Remote arbeiten, Mitarbeiterrabatten, Mentoring, kostenlosem Parken, kostenlosen Snacks, kostenlosen Getränken, Homeoffice, einer Home-Office-Ausstattung, erlaubten Haustieren, Gutscheinen und Ermäßigungen, flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, einem Fitnesscenter vor Ort, einem Fitnessabo, einem Firmenlaptop, einem Firmenhandy, Entschädigung für Reisekosten, bezahlten Co-Working-Optionen, beruflicher Bildung, barrierefreiem Zugang, lockerer Kleiderordnung sowie Teamevents und Firmenfeiern.

Über uns

Varify ist die europäische A/B-Testing-Plattform für Teams, die ihre Website datenbasiert optimieren wollen: cookieless, DSGVO-konform mit Hosting in Frankfurt, tief integriert in GA4 und BigQuery und zum Festpreis statt nach Traffic abgerechnet. Über 450 Unternehmen und Agenturen testen bereits mit uns.

Unsere Kunden kündigen selten wegen des Preises. Sie kündigen, wenn im Alltag die Zeit fürs Testen fehlt, wenn ihnen die Testideen ausgehen oder die Ressourcen fehlen. Genau da setzt du an: Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Bestandskunden mit Varify echte Ergebnisse erzielen, langfristig bleiben und mitwachsen.

title: Business Product Owner | Full Time (m/w/d)
description:
Who Are We ? 

🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork –– fast, smart, and seamless. 

Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO.

At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital.

Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow.

We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy. 

💼 About This Role 

We are looking for a Business Product Owner to join our team and act as a mini-CEO for one of our key markets, taking full ownership of its performance and growth. You will play a crucial role in establishing and maintaining our products' market leadership, driving product expansion, and enhancing operational efficiency.

🎖️What success looks like 

In your first month 

- You understand our product, customers, and operational landscape; how value is created, delivered, and scaled and start identifying opportunities for improvement.

- You establish strong working relationships with the Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success teams.

By 3 months 

- Alongside our Product Owner, you contribute to defining a clear product vision and strategy, grounded in customer needs and market realities.

- You analyse product workflows and cost structures to improve efficiency and reduce time-to-market without sacrificing product quality.

- You coordinate cross-functional initiatives with Engineering, Sales, and Marketing to ensure efficient and well-executed go-lives.

- You become the main point of contact for our customers and engage directly with them, turning feedback into clear, actionable insights.

By 6 months 

- You proactively drive product and operational improvements that measurably impact efficiency, cost, and customer satisfaction.

- You influence roadmap decisions through market research, competitive analysis, and customer data.

- You streamline customer support and success processes to improve response times and long-term customer health.

- You’re trusted as a key partner across teams – shaping how we scale, not just what we build.

🚀 What You Need to Be Successful: 

- You bring 3+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or similar roles within a B2B environment.

- You are fluent in English. Proficiency in additional languages is a plus.

- With the strong background in client-facing roles you bring, you know how to engage stakeholders at every level, bridging the gap between technical execution and executive leadership.

- You have an interest in software development, are eager to learn new tools and technologies, and bring basic coding experience.

- You quickly grasp complex processes & technical requirements allowing you to create tailored solutions that deliver value for both clients and the business.

- You put the customer first, anticipate their needs, and focus on delivering solutions that improve satisfaction and the overall experience.

- You are based in Munich and able to work from the office 3 days per week.

🌟 How We Set You Up to Be Successful 

We don’t just define what success looks like – we actively support you in getting there through a structured, hands-on onboarding process during your first six months with us.

- Onboarding sessions with your hiring manager & COO, Ksenia, to understand your role, goals, and priorities.

- Onboarding sessions with our CEO, Felix, to learn about CONROO’s vision, strategy, and business.

- HR onboarding, with our People Partner, Hind, covering our values, tools, policies, and processes.

- A buddy system to support you during your first 2 months.

- Clear goals for your first 1, 3, and 5 months, with expectations defined from day one so you know how success is measured.

- We know that starting a new role can be overwhelming. That’s why we provide clear documentation, a structured to-do list, and role-specific materials to help you get up to speed quickly.

👥 About Our Team 

We’re a team of around 30 curious minds working from our offices in Munich and Nuremberg – and remotely across Germany. We value ownership and a mindset driven by continuous learning. We take ideas seriously, see them through, and aren’t afraid to roll up our sleeves when challenges arise. As we grow, we keep raising the bar, looking for smarter, better ways to work – and have fun in the process together along the way.

🤝 Why Us 

💫 A mission that matters : Be part of a company that’s working on something meaningful and a purpose you can stand behind.

🏝️ Workation : Switch up your usual scenery and spend up to 30 days working remotely from a different location.

🎉 CONROO Time Off : Some moments deserve more than a celebration! Enjoy extra days off for special milestones like your birthday, wedding, or welcoming a new family member.

👊 Witness your actions shape our direction : You’re given the ownership and trust to make decisions that matter and the results are visible.

🏔️ Company getaway : Two annual team getaways where we work, unwind, and connect – away from the office. We went to the Austrian Alps last year, where should we go next?

🏢 Multiple office locations : Join us in one of our vibrant offices in Munich, Nuremberg, or Duisburg.

🎟️ Employee discounts : Use our employee discount portal to access attractive deals from top brands across tech, travel, fashion, home, and more – online and in-store.

🌍 International team: With 10 nationalities across a team of around 30 people, you’ll be part of a naturally diverse environment where different perspectives come together.

🧠 Hungry for knowledge? Our monthly S.H.A.R.E sessions teach you something new every month and give you the stage to share your passion & expertise too. If you want to go further, we’re happy to support you with a course, workshop, or other training opportunities.

Our Recruitment Process - simple, quick, and human.

- Introduce yourself in a 30-minute call with our People Partner, Hind.

title: Account Executive - Enterprise
description:
about us 

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

your mission: 

You will be pivotal to telli’s growth. Your mission is to drive revenue by building trusted relationships with enterprise customers and closing complex, high-value deals (€100k+ land deal size). As one of the first Enterprise AEs at telli, you’ll play a key role in shaping how we win, navigate, and scale our enterprise sales motion.

what you'll do: 

- Own complex enterprise deals end-to-end: Lead €100k+ deals from first discovery through signature, including demos, business cases, security reviews, procurement, legal, contract negotiations, and executive alignment. You uncover where telli creates measurable value and build the case to make it a priority.

- Build and own your pipeline: Our SDR team supports you, but you can generate own Enterprise pipeline. You identify the right accounts, develop account strategies, write outbound, make the calls, and create opportunities where none existed before.

- Navigate complex buying committees: Build relationships across Sales, Operations, CX, IT, Security, Legal, Procurement, Finance, and the C-Suite at large organizations. You identify champions, understand internal politics, and create consensus across multiple stakeholders.

- Run strategic, multi-threaded sales processes: You don't rely on a single champion. You map the organization, understand who influences the decision, and build relationships at multiple levels long before procurement enters the process.

- Own a quota and close €100k+ deals: Drive meaningful new ARR and take full accountability for your forecast, pipeline coverage, and revenue target.

- Build compelling business cases: Translate telli's product into measurable commercial impact for the customer and make the ROI clear enough to win internal budget and executive sponsorship.

- Bring the customer into the company: Feed structured insights back into product, marketing, and strategy. You sit closest to some of our most important prospects and customers, and your signal helps shape what we build next.

what makes you a great fit: 

- You've successfully closed enterprise deals: You have proven experience owning complex €100k+ sales cycles and selling to senior and C-Suite economic buyers.

- You know how to navigate complexity: You've worked through long sales cycles involving multiple departments, procurement, security, legal, and competing internal priorities, without losing control of the deal.

- You're an elite relationship builder: You know the difference between a contact, a champion, and an economic buyer. You build trust quickly and have won deals because of the relationships you created across an organization.

- You're a hunter: You know how to manufacture pipeline without relying on a warm inbound stream. You're comfortable breaking into large accounts and creating urgency from scratch.

- You have executive presence: You can hold your own with C-Suite stakeholders from the first interaction. You communicate clearly, challenge thoughtfully, and earn credibility quickly.

- You think strategically about accounts: You don't just run meetings, you map stakeholders, identify blockers, understand incentives, and continuously think about what needs to happen for the deal to move forward.

- You're commercially sharp: You understand how to build a business case, quantify value, negotiate confidently, and protect deal quality while getting complex agreements across the line.

- You're obsessively prepared: You know more about the prospect's business, priorities, and challenges than they expect you to. Every interaction has a purpose.

- You're low ego and high accountability: You're not above doing the grunt work. You take ownership when things go wrong, act on feedback quickly, and share credit when things go right.

- You speak business-level German and English 

- You want to work on-site 5 days a week in Berlin 

you may not be a good fit if: 

- You wait for pipeline to be handed to you. Enterprise AE means you generate

- You need detailed instructions and shy away from taking responsibility

- You only show up for the "strategic" parts of the deal and skip the procurement/security-review grunt work

- You've never personally carried a quota or closed deals end-to-end

- You want to work remotely. We're an in-person team

- You think this role looks like a 9-to-5 job

Rockstardevelopers, gegründet 2015 in Mannheim, weitere Büros in Stuttgart und München. Wir sind ein Software-Entwickler mit Erfahrung aus hunderten von individuellen Projekten für Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden.

Kurze Wege, ehrliches Feedback, keine politischen Spielchen. Keine Hierarchie-Ebenen zwischen dir und den Leuten, die Entscheidungen treffen.

Deine Aufgaben

Du arbeitest in Kundenprojekten bei großen Unternehmen, eingebettet in deren Teams. Dein Schwerpunkt ist das Backend mit C# und .NET: fachliche Logik, Datenbanken und die Schnittstellen zu anderen Systemen.

- Backend-Entwicklung mit C# und .NET, Webanwendungen mit ASP.NET

- Datenmodelle entwerfen und mit Microsoft SQL Server und T-SQL umsetzen, inklusive Performance-Optimierung

- Schnittstellen entwickeln und Systeme integrieren

- Bestehende Anwendungen weiterentwickeln, zum Beispiel Abrechnungs- und Finanzsysteme oder Identity-Management-Lösungen

- Code generieren, reviewen und refactoren mit Claude Code, Copilot oder Cursor

- Abstimmung mit Product Ownern, Fachbereich und Betrieb

Die Einsätze laufen überwiegend remote. Kundentermine sind meist in Frankfurt, an einzelnen Präsenztagen. Wer mag, kommt zusätzlich in eins unserer Büros. Zwang ist das keiner.

Wo du landest

Je nach Projekt bei Großkonzernen, im öffentlichen Sektor oder bei Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen. Unsere Kunden besetzen diese Projekte fast nur mit Festangestellten. Deshalb suchen wir dich in Festanstellung.

Was du mitbringst

Mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung als Entwickler, gezählt nach Ausbildung oder Studium. Für einige Projekte suchen wir Senior-Entwickler mit mehr als fünf Jahren.

Das erwarten wir: 

- C# und .NET, mindestens drei Jahre produktiv in den letzten fünf Jahren

- Microsoft SQL Server und T-SQL, einschließlich Datenmodellierung

- Webanwendungen mit ASP.NET

- Git, automatisierte Tests und saubere Übergabe an Betrieb und Team

Von Vorteil (kein Muss): 

- One Identity Manager (Backend, Prozessdesigner) oder andere Identity-and-Access-Management-Systeme

- SAP-Benutzer- und Rollenverwaltung oder SAP-Konnektoren

- Finanz-, Abrechnungs- oder Controllingsysteme

- Erfahrung im Umfeld von Eisenbahn- oder Verkehrsunternehmen

- LLM-Integration in Anwendungen (RAG, Tool-Calling, Agenten), auch aus einem Nebenprojekt

- React oder ein anderes Frontend-Framework

Du musst nicht alles können. Wichtig ist, dass du im .NET-Backend und in SQL Server sicher bist und dich schnell in neue Fachlichkeit reinfindest.

Projektsprache ist Deutsch

Du arbeitest im Team des Kunden, auf Deutsch, in Meetings und in der Dokumentation. Wir erwarten Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder besser.

AI-Tools sind Pflicht, kein Bonus

Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor: Damit musst du produktiv arbeiten können. Unsere Kunden erwarten das, und wir arbeiten auch so. Intern investieren wir in deine AI-Skills.

Was wir bieten

- Überwiegend remote, dazu Büro, wenn du magst

- MacBook (außer der Kunde stellt eigene Hardware)

- Verschiedene Kunden, verschiedene Projekte

- Die Gründer sind deine direkten Ansprechpartner

- Internes Upskilling in AI-Entwicklung

Bewerbung

Lebenslauf reicht. Kein Anschreiben nötig. Nach einer kurzen Video-Frage-Runde (2×90 Sekunden) melden wir uns innerhalb weniger Tage.

title: Working Student – Quality & Data (m/f/d)
description:
About JawBuddy

JawBuddy helps people with jaw pain, teeth grinding and TMJ problems through a guided exercise app. Our app measures jaw movement through the phone camera using computer vision and AR, so users see their progress in real numbers.

We are a small, funded health-tech team with paying customers in Germany. Next up: a B2B platform release in early 2027.

The role

You make sure our app and our numbers can be trusted, and you use AI to do it at a scale one person couldn't before. AI handles the repetitive checks; you handle what needs human judgment, like testing our camera features in the real world.

- You work directly with our CTO and founding engineer (~12h)

- Data quality (~5h)

- Automation with AI (~3h)

What you'll do

- Test our computer vision in the real world

- Test camera-based jaw tracking across devices, lighting, faces, glasses and beards

- Find the conditions where measurements break, and help the team fix them

- Own app quality

- Own the release checklist for every iOS and Android build

- Test accessibility, German texts, performance, slow networks and offline use

- Write clear bug reports in Linear, with steps to reproduce and evidence

- Keep test evidence documented, as our product requires

- Keep our data trustworthy

- Review the daily data-quality checks across Amplitude, AppsFlyer, RevenueCat and BigQuery, and investigate what they flag

- Find out why two tools disagree, and get it fixed

- Keep our tracking plan in sync with what the app actually sends

- Automate with AI

- Use AI tools to write automated tests (Maestro), generate test cases and run checks

- Review what AI produces: you are the person who decides whether it is right

What you bring

- Enrolled student, available 15–20 hours a week for at least 12 months

- Fluent in English (the app is in German; the team works in English)

- Solid SQL

- A structured, curious way of testing: you find the edge cases others miss

- You already use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or similar) in your daily work

Nice to have

- Test automation (Maestro, Detox, Appium)

- Accessibility (WCAG, VoiceOver, TalkBack)

- Product analytics (Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4) or attribution (AppsFlyer)

- dbt or Dataform, Git, Python

- Interest in computer vision, health tech or medical device quality

What we offer

- Real ownership

- You own the release checklist, and when you say a build isn't ready, we listen.

- Work with AI from day one

- You learn how to run quality at scale with AI, a skill few people have yet.

- Rare experience

- Computer vision, health data and quality in a health product, all in one role.

- A path to full-time

- After graduation, this role can grow into a Junior QA Engineer or Data Analyst position.

- Mentorship

- A weekly 1:1 with our CTO.

- Fair pay

- And hours that fit around your lectures and exams.

How we hire

- Send your CV.

- A 30-minute call with our CTO.

- A short paid trial: we send you a test build of the app, and you spend about 2 hours finding and reporting what's wrong. Use any AI tools you like.

- A final conversation, and an offer within a week.

title: Social Creative (m/w/d)
description:
Du lebst Social Media, denkst in Formaten und Hooks und hast ständig Ideen, aus denen Content werden will? Du weißt, was auf TikTok, Instagram und YouTube läuft, bevor es alle machen und kannst daraus Konzepte bauen, die für einige der coolsten Brands Deutschlands funktionieren? Dann sollten wir reden.

Wir suchen keine klassische Social-Media-Manager:in, die Redaktionspläne verwaltet und auch keine reine Producer:in. Wir suchen einen kreativen Kopf: jemanden, der Social Content wirklich versteht und lebt und vor allem Content Pieces konzipieren kann. Die Produktion selbst übernehmen meistens unsere externen Dienstleister:innen, aber wenn du selbst zur Kamera greifen oder schneiden kannst, ist das ein dickes Plus.

Wir haben gerade unser Produktions-Office in Eimsbüttel eröffnet und treffen uns regelmäßig, um gemeinsam zu arbeiten und uns auszutauschen. Deshalb suchen wir jemanden direkt aus Hamburg, die/der Lust hat, mit uns Zeit im Office zu verbringen und einen starken Team-Kern zu formen.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission, falls du sie annimmst: 

- Du entwickelst kreative Content-Konzepte, von der ersten Idee über das Storyboard bis zum fertigen Briefing für die Umsetzung.

- Du denkst in Formaten, Trends und Plattform-Logiken und übersetzt Brand-Ziele in Content, der scrollt-stoppt.

- Du bist „always on": Du kennst die Feeds, Sounds, Memes und Creator, bevor sie viral gehen und machst daraus Ideen für unsere Brands.

- Du arbeitest strategisch mit: Du verstehst, was eine Brand erreichen will, und baust Content, der auf Ziele einzahlt, nicht nur auf Likes.

- Du erkennst Trends früh und machst daraus schnelle, reaktive Formate (Real-Time-Content, wenn's drauf ankommt).

- Du analysierst, was funktioniert, lernst aus Daten und schärfst deine Konzepte so lange, bis sie performen.

- Du stimmst dich eng mit der Brand, weiteren Partner:innen und unserem Team ab und bringst deine kreative Handschrift ein.

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst:
