- Du verstehst und lebst Social Content, du weißt aus dem Bauch heraus, was auf welcher Plattform funktioniert und warum.

- Stärke in der Konzeption: Du kannst aus einer Brand-Aufgabe eigenständig Content-Ideen und Formate entwickeln und sie so briefen, dass andere sie umsetzen können.

- Ein tiefes Verständnis für die Plattformen und ihre Mechaniken. Meta, TikTok und YouTube sind dein Zuhause.

- Du lebst „always on": echter Draht zu Trends, Sounds, Creator-Culture und Internet-Humor.

- Strategisches Denken: Du weißt, dass Content nicht nur schön aussehen, sondern etwas erreichen soll.

- Hervorragende organisatorische Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu jonglieren.

- Reiselust: Für unsere Produktionen sind wir viel unterwegs und wir erwarten von Dir, bei den Drehs am Start zu sein. 

- Nice to have: Wenn du selbst produzieren kannst, Kamera, Schnitt (CapCut, Premiere o.ä.), umso besser. 

- Wenn du weißt, wie man in der Influencer-Bubble navigiert, ebenfalls ein Plus!

Benefits

- Ein Team von Expert:innen: Ein offenes, kleines Expert:innen-Team mit flachen Hierarchien, in dem jede:r mitreden und entscheiden darf. Wir leben eine Kultur, die Fehler erlaubt und das Lernen fördert.

title: Senior Data Scientist/ML Ops Engineer (all genders)
description:
Responsibilities

With a mission to empower 15.6 million house owners across Germany and the broader DACH region, we at Aroundhome are building a platform where every strategic decision is powered by data. We’re a team of around 250 people, and to take the next step, we’re looking for an experienced and hands-on Senior Data Scientist (all genders) to bring machine learning into the heart of our product.

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will build Aroundhome’s first machine learning model in production: the logic that decides which partners each homeowner is matched with. You will start from the problems homeowners and partners actually have, and own the solution end to end, in a small new team with a product manager, an engineer and the team lead.

Responsibilities:

- Start from the Customer: Understand what homeowners and partners need from a match, and turn that into the outcomes and guardrails your models optimize for, not just model metrics.

- Own Our Matching Models: Build and run the models behind our partner matching, end to end: data, features, training, evaluation, deployment and monitoring.

- Make Every Match Count: Improve our matching logic with deployed models that make the most efficient use of partner capacity, raise match rates, and account for regional supply and demand.

- Prove Impact: Measure every improvement against our current logic in controlled experiments designed for a two-sided marketplace, before it scales.

- Build the Data Foundation : Create the datasets and pipelines your models need, together with our engineer and the Data Engineering team. In the first months, this is a big part of the role.

- Shape Our ML Stack: Decide with the team how and where models run, and set the practices for machine learning at Aroundhome.

- Translate Models into Decisions: Explain trade-offs between customer experience, partner fulfillment and revenue to product managers, partner category managers, key account managers and senior leadership.

Skills

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics).

- Proven experience (5+ years) in applied data science, including at least one ads, ranking, pricing or marketplace model you took to production.

- Production-grade Python and advanced SQL, plus hands-on experience with modern data tooling (e.g., dbt, Airflow, Spark).

- Experience deploying and monitoring models on a cloud ML platform (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI, MLflow).

- Solid foundation in experiment design and causal inference, ideally in a marketplace where test and control groups affect each other.

- Hands-on experience with classical machine learning (e.g., gradient-boosted trees), probability calibration and offline vs online evaluation.

- A product mindset: you define success in homeowner and partner outcomes, challenge assumptions with evidence, and add complexity only where it earns its place.

- Strong communication skills and the ability to explain models and trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- A plus: experience with recommender systems or search ranking.

What we offer

Hybrid Work // Stay flexible: Decide freely whether you want to work from our office in Berlin, from home throughout Germany, or fully remote from Portugal. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries. 

Room to grow // Stay curious: In regular/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we offer monthly Tech Talks, an annual training budget, free access to LinkedIn Learning as well as great workshops to seek new input and specific training for your personal development. 

Mental & physical health // Stay healthy & active: We care about your well-being and support your health with a discounted membership at Urban Sports Club. In addition, our cooperation partner “Fürstenberg Institute” is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching. 

Taking responsibility // We #care: We care for our planet and the people who are living on it. To make our world a little bit better, our ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) promotes our awareness for environmentally friendly behavior. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back. 

Teamspirit // Stay connected: What drives us is our sense of community. That's why we celebrate our Company Day once a month at our Potsdamer Platz office, where everyone gets together in person. In addition to a comprehensive update of our C-Board, the main focus is on togetherness and the exchange of ideas over lunch and dinner together.

title: Data Strategy & Advisory Leader (Managing Principal)
description:
Build strategies. Shape change. Lead enterprise data transformation. 

The Role 

We are seeking a visionary Data Strategy & Advisory Leader at Managing Principal level to shape the future of data in financial services. You will lead the design, delivery, and scaling of enterprise-wide data strategies for tier-one banks, insurers, and investment firms — helping them unlock the value of their data and meet the demands of an ever-evolving regulatory and digital landscape.

This is not just about advising — it’s about owning the transformation agenda : defining innovative propositions, leading complex consulting engagements, inspiring cross-disciplinary teams, and driving commercial growth. You’ll be at the forefront of modern data strategy, governance, analytics, and AI adoption, while mentoring the next generation of data leaders.

What You’ll Do 

- Design and operationalise enterprise data strategies that enable business transformation across banking, insurance, and investment sectors.

- Lead high-impact consulting engagements in data governance, literacy, quality, regulatory response, and analytics-driven decision-making.

- Shape new market propositions in data consulting, including the adoption of AI, advanced analytics, and cloud-based data platforms.

- Drive process modernisation — from business analysis to technical design, solution implementation, and long-term optimisation.

- Build trusted senior stakeholder relationships , influencing strategic decisions and securing follow-on mandates.

- Scale data capabilities across internal teams and client organisations, ensuring consistent, high-quality outcomes.

- Contribute to thought leadership , industry events, and internal innovation initiatives.

What We’re Looking For 

- 8+ years of senior-level consulting experience in financial services, with a strong data strategy and advisory focus.

- Proven expertise across the full data lifecycle , supported by frameworks such as DAMA DMBOK, DCAM, or CDMC.

- Deep understanding of enterprise data transformation and practical experience in implementing modern data management solutions .

Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!

We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates. 

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation. 

Your Role 

As Senior Product Manager for one of our Revenue Management teams at RoomPriceGenie, you'll own the experience where hoteliers see, trust and act on our AI-powered pricing, both in our app and embedded in our partners' PMSs through Revenue Intelligence. This is not a feature-delivery role. We're looking for a senior PM who sets the strategy and direction, makes hard trade-offs, and turns complex pricing logic into decisions a hotelier can make in seconds.

You'll lead a team of engineers, collaborate closely with design and research and work closely with leadership, Account Management, Integrations, Customer Success and Sales. Your mission: make RoomPriceGenie the pricing tool thousands of independent hotels rely on every day.

What you'll do 

Product Vision & Strategy 

- Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area, anchored in clear business goals: adoption, retention, revenue uplift and expansion.

- Decide what not to build, and bring stakeholders along on why.

- Shape how pricing shows up across surfaces, from our core app to partner integrations and multi-property accounts.

- Champion simplicity and explainability: hoteliers should understand why a price was recommended and feel confident acting on it.

Discovery & Delivery 

- Talk to hoteliers regularly and, with UX research, turn hidden friction in their revenue management workflows into strategy, not just backlog items.

- Work closely with the other RM team to turn forecasting and pricing model output into clear experiences that build trust and drive action.

- Drive solutions end to end, from opportunity assessment to measured impact, knowing when to move fast and when to dig deeper.

- 5+ years as a Senior Product Manager, ideally in B2B SaaS, with clear ownership of outcomes, not just outputs.

- A track record of making complex systems radically simple

- Comfortable setting strategy in ambiguous spaces and making trade-offs with incomplete information.

- Genuine excitement about how AI is reshaping software and how it´s build.

title: Working Student - LLM Inference Performance
description:
About Tensordyne 

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

About the Role

How fast should an LLM building block run on our hardware? How fast does it actually run, and what would make it faster?

As a Working Student, LLM Inference Performance, you'll help answer these questions by working directly with our hardware and software engineering teams.

You'll write and optimize low-level kernels, benchmark performance on real silicon, and develop profiling tools that help engineers understand and improve LLM inference performance.

You'll gain hands-on experience with our Rust programming stack and Python SDK, use AI coding agents as part of your development workflow, and collaborate closely with engineers working on compilers, runtimes, and kernel optimization.

This is an opportunity to apply your academic knowledge to real-world AI hardware challenges while taking ownership of meaningful technical projects.

What You'll Do

- 
Understand our hardware: Learn how Tensordyne silicon processes data, manages memory, and synchronizes operations, and how key LLM components such as attention, MLP, and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routing map onto the architecture..

- 
Develop and optimize kernels: Implement, test, and tune low-level kernels to improve the performance of LLM inference workloads..

- 
Analyze performance: Build analytical and roofline performance models, compare predictions against simulator and real-silicon measurements, and investigate performance bottlenecks..

- 
Build benchmarking and profiling tools: Develop benchmark harnesses, profiling scripts, and trace visualizations that make performance easier to measure, understand, and improve..

- 
Work with AI coding agents: Explore workflows where AI agents assist with kernel development, optimization, and benchmarking, and identify the tools and context they need to work effectively..

- 
Collaborate across engineering teams: Work closely with compiler, runtime, and kernel engineers to translate performance insights into practical improvements..

Example project: Develop a benchmarking and profiling harness for an LLM building block, such as decode attention, at two abstraction levels. Compare measured performance against theoretical estimates and make the tooling accessible to AI coding agents.

What We're Looking For

- 
Currently enrolled in a Master's degree program in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field..

- 
Strong programming skills in Python and at least one of C, C++, or Rust..

- 
Understanding of computer architecture, memory systems, bandwidth, and parallel computing through academic coursework or personal projects..

- 
Interest in low-level programming, hardware performance, and optimization..

- 
Practical experience using AI coding agents in development workflows, with the ability to evaluate and improve their output..

- 
An experimental mindset, with the ability to form hypotheses, analyze measurements, and communicate technical findings clearly..

- 
Curiosity, initiative, and enthusiasm for learning new technologies..

Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be a plus:

- 
GPU or AI accelerator programming..

- 
Embedded systems or bare-metal programming..

- 
Performance profiling, benchmarking, or optimization..

- 
LLM inference fundamentals and architectures..

Why Join Tensordyne?

- 
Work on cutting-edge AI technology: Contribute to the development of next-generation AI inference hardware and software..

- 
Gain hands-on experience: Apply your university knowledge to real silicon and challenging engineering problems..

- 
Own meaningful projects: Build tools and solutions that directly support our engineering teams..

- 
Learn from experienced engineers: Work alongside specialists in hardware architecture, compilers, runtimes, and performance optimization..

- 
Explore AI-assisted development: Gain practical experience building with AI coding agents and shaping how they interact with advanced hardware systems..

- 
Make a lasting impact: Help develop performance tools and workflows that will support both current and future generations of Tensordyne technology..

Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values 

- Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed.

- Ethics and integrity always. Be open, honest, and respectful of everyone.

- Think Big. Be ambitious and have audacious goals.

- Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do.

- Own it and get it done. Results matter!

- Make each person better together than they would be as an individual.

- Embrace each other’s differences, and embrace that there will be differences.

The role

Help make the latest AI models run well on our silicon. You’ll work from model code to measured hardware performance: bring up new architectures, track down accuracy failures, and improve latency, throughput, and memory use.

The bigger challenge is making that work repeatable. You’ll build an agentic harness that can explore implementations, run experiments, check results, and guide the next change. Every investigation should leave behind better software, better tests, and a shorter path for the next model.

We’re looking for an excellent software engineer who understands LLM inference deeply and knows how to put coding agents to work. You’ll own substantial parts of our SDK and work closely with engineers across models, compilers, runtime, and hardware. Your particular focus will be numerical optimization: finding where precision matters, where computation can be cheaper, and how to preserve model quality.

What you’ll do

- Build the agentic workflows. Give agents the tools to inspect models, change implementations and numerical settings, run emulation and hardware experiments, and diagnose failures. Build the feedback and evaluation that make the results trustworthy.

- Bring up new models quickly; make them go brrrr. Work with engineers across the stack to take unfamiliar architectures from reference code to validated, performant execution on our accelerator. Turn what you learn into reusable model support and SDK improvements.

- Optimize numerics. Explore precision, accumulation, and quantization choices across the model. Understand how they interact with kernels, KV caches, memory, and distributed execution, then measure the gains in latency, throughput, and memory use against model quality on silicon.

- Make numerical quality measurable. Build conversion and emulation software that lets you test numerical choices quickly. Compare activations and outputs against reference models, trace accuracy regressions to their source, and validate changes with end-to-end model evaluations.

- Ship software that lasts. Own design, implementation, testing, and delivery. Build clear APIs that are easy to use for agents. Make difficult bugs reproducible and keep them from returning. Know when to build fast, and when to build thoroughly.

- Shape the next chip. Work with hardware architects to test how numerical formats and arithmetic choices affect real models. Turn those findings into better hardware and algorithm designs.

What we need from you

- You understand LLM inference end to end. You can read a new model’s implementation and reason about prefill, decode, attention, KV caches, MoE, batching, and parallelism. You understand how these translate into compute, memory, and communication on an accelerator.

- You build excellent software. You’ve owned substantial systems and delivered complex features from design through production. You’re strong in Python, thoughtful about interfaces, and rigorous about abstractions and testing.

- You are fluent with agentic tooling. You’d rather build the agent that runs the optimization than doing it by hand; and running numerous agents in parallel excites you. You know what is required for agents to work effectively in a large software organization, and you have the judgement when an agentic loop still needs a human.

- You take ownership and bring others along. You form clear hypotheses, test them, and drive problems to resolution across software boundaries. You communicate clearly through specs, design docs, and reviews that people and agents can act on. You explain complex trade-offs, give direct feedback, and make the people around you better.

If you tick a few of these boxes, we’d love to hear from you.

We’d be thrilled if you had

- Expertise in improving inference systems like debugging and optimizing the runtime of complex models and reasoning about accuracy-performance trade-offs.

- Experience with ML compilers, accelerator SDKs, or model compression libraries, particularly for non-NVIDIA accelerators such as TPU, Trainium/Inferentia, Tenstorrent, Groq, or Cerebras.

- Experience with model quantization, sparsity, codebooks, low-rank factorization or other compression techniques.

- Contributions to distributed inference or serving frameworks such as vLLM or SGLang.

Your code will help determine how quickly we support new models, how efficiently they run, and what we build into our next chip. You’ll own meaningful software, work directly with the people designing the hardware, and see your decisions tested on real silicon.

If you want to build the tools, solve the hard failures, and help set the engineering direction of a new inference platform, we’d like to hear from you.

Apex.AI is developing the software foundation for autonomous systems, intelligent machines, and software-defined vehicles. We are looking for an early-career Software Engineer to help advance our core software platform technologies, including Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida.

This role is ideal for recent university graduates or engineers with 1–2 years of experience who are passionate about modern C++, distributed systems, middleware, developer platforms, and systems software engineering.

You will work alongside experienced engineers on high-performance middleware, runtime systems, developer tooling, and software infrastructure used in safety-critical and real-time environments. This is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience building production-quality software for automotive, robotics, aerospace, and industrial automation applications.

We are looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex technical problems, learning deeply about software systems, and building tools and platforms that other developers rely on every day.

This role is based in our Munich office.

What You’ll Do 

- Contribute to the development and maintenance of core software components for Apex.AI products, particularly Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida

- Help build software platform capabilities, middleware features, developer tooling, and runtime infrastructure

- Support improvements in performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability across the platform stack

- Collaborate closely with platform, product, and applications teams to deliver production-quality software

- Learn and apply engineering best practices for modern C++ and systems software development

What You Bring

- Strong foundation in software engineering and computer science fundamentals

- Experience with modern C++ through coursework, internships, personal projects, or early professional work

- Familiarity with Python or scripting languages

- Experience developing software on Linux-based systems

- Interest in distributed systems, middleware, runtime systems, or embedded software

- Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills

- Familiarity with Git and modern software development workflows

- Curiosity, ownership mentality, and eagerness to learn new technologies

- Familiarity with TCP/IP, sockets programming, or Linux system programming

- Experience with CI/CD workflows and automated testing

- Exposure to robotics, autonomous systems, or embedded software projects

- Familiarity with build systems such as CMake or Bazel

- Understanding of distributed systems concepts or real-time systems

- Interest in automotive software, intelligent machines, or software-defined vehicles

- Internship or academic experience involving systems programming or developer platforms

Why Apex.AI 

- Build foundational platform technology used in real-world autonomous and intelligent systems

- Learn from highly experienced engineers working on technically challenging problems

- Gain hands-on experience with middleware, runtime systems, and developer infrastructure

- Engineering-driven culture with meaningful ownership, mentorship, and growth opportunities

- Competitive compensation, benefits, and professional development opportunities

- International team working at the forefront of mobility software innovation

About Apex.AI 

Apex.AI is an international software company specializing in the development of safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility systems, aiming to accelerate the transition to software-defined vehicles and mobility. Founded in 2017 by Jan Becker and Dejan Pangercic, the company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with additional offices in Munich, Stuttgart, Gothenburg, Tokyo, and Pangyo. To date, Apex.AI has raised over $75 million USD from world-class venture, financial and strategic investors including AGCO, Airbus Ventures, Canaan, Continental AG, Daimler Truck, HELLA Ventures, Jaguar Land Rover’s InMotion Ventures, LG Electronics, Lightspeed, Orillion, Toyota Ventures, Volvo Group Venture Capital and ZF.

The company’s flagship product, Apex.OS, consists of two core components: Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida.

- Apex.Grace is an application runtime framework in the form of a software development kit (SDK). It provides a robust framework for developing real-time, reliable, and safe applications. Core APIs are based on ROS 2 APIs with numerous extensions enabling real-time execution, reliable performance, deployment into large fleets, system state management, safety, security, and much more. It is safety-certified to ISO 26262 ASIL D.

- Apex.Ida is a communication middleware delivering optimal high-performance data transport across use cases. These use cases range from fully autonomous vehicles with dozens of high-resolution cameras to small signals with ultra-high frequencies in safety-critical domains. Its core is based on a shared memory data transport with connectors into DDS, SOME/IP, MQTT, CAN, and many more protocols, all abstracted into a single application-facing API.

Additionally, Apex.AI offers:

- Apex.Alan provides customers with a highly optimized and efficient software integration, development environment, build, test, and delivery process.

- Apex.OS for V&V enables record and playback of very large and diverse data streams, both time- and data-deterministically, which is crucial for replay, analysis, and performance evaluation of complex autonomous systems.

Apex.AI’s software solutions are utilized across a diverse range of industries, including automotive, agriculture, medical, and defense sectors. The products enable developers to efficiently create and deploy safe, reliable, and high-performance applications, thereby accelerating the adoption of software-defined mobility systems. Through its innovative software solutions and strategic partnerships, Apex.AI is at the forefront of transforming the mobility industry, facilitating the development of next-generation vehicles and systems.

Apex.AI is an international software company specializing in the development of safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility systems, aiming to accelerate the transition to software-defined vehicles and mobility. Founded in 2017 by Jan Becker and Dejan Pangercic, the company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with additional offices in Munich, Stuttgart, Gothenburg, Tokyo, and Pangyo. To date, Apex.AI has raised over $75 million USD from world-class venture, financial and strategic investors including AGCO, Airbus Ventures, Canaan, Continental AG, Daimler Truck, HELLA Ventures, Jaguar Land Rover’s InMotion Ventures, LG Electronics, Lightspeed, Orillion, Toyota Ventures, Volvo Group Venture Capital and ZF.

The company’s flagship product, Apex.OS, consists of two core components: Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida.

- Apex.Grace is an application runtime framework in the form of a software development kit (SDK). It provides a robust framework for developing real-time, reliable, and safe applications. Core APIs are based on ROS 2 APIs with numerous extensions enabling real-time execution, reliable performance, deployment into large fleets, system state management, safety, security, and much more. It is safety-certified to ISO 26262 ASIL D.

- Apex.Ida is a communication middleware delivering optimal high-performance data transport across use cases. These use cases range from fully autonomous vehicles with dozens of high-resolution cameras to small signals with ultra-high frequencies in safety-critical domains. Its core is based on a shared memory data transport with connectors into DDS, SOME/IP, MQTT, CAN, and many more protocols, all abstracted into a single application-facing API.

Additionally, Apex.AI offers:

- Apex.Alan provides customers with a highly optimized and efficient software integration, development environment, build, test, and delivery process.

- Apex.OS for V&V enables record and playback of very large and diverse data streams, both time- and data-deterministically, which is crucial for replay, analysis, and performance evaluation of complex autonomous systems.

Apex.AI’s software solutions are utilized across a diverse range of industries, including automotive, agriculture, medical, and defense sectors. The products enable developers to efficiently create and deploy safe, reliable, and high-performance applications, thereby accelerating the adoption of software-defined mobility systems. Through its innovative software solutions and strategic partnerships, Apex.AI is at the forefront of transforming the mobility industry, facilitating the development of next-generation vehicles and systems.

description:
Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien (m/w/d) | B2B SaaS Fintech, Berlin 

Du willst als Team Lead Sales in Berlin ein Vertriebsteam führen und gleichzeitig mitgestalten, wie Pennylane Steuerkanzleien in Deutschland gewinnt? Als erste Sales-Teamleitung für unser deutsches Kanzleisegment entwickelst du ein wachsendes Team regionaler Account Executives weiter: Du coachst im Kundengespräch, steuerst die Vertriebsleistung und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Head of Sales den Ansatz für den deutschen Markt – mit dem Rückenwind eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs Europas.

Unsere Vision 

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerkanzleien werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen. Steuerkanzleien geben wir die Plattform, mit der sie ihre Mandate effizienter betreuen und ihre Steuerberatung digital weiterentwickeln.

Über uns 

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs Europas – seit 2025 auch in Deutschland. Das haben wir seit der Gründung 2020 erreicht:

- 💻 Wir haben uns als All-in-One-Plattform für Buchhaltung, Finanzen und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Unternehmen und ihren Steuerberater:innen etabliert – KI-gestützt, cloudbasiert, mit offenen Schnittstellen.

- 💰 Wir haben rund 360 Millionen Euro Kapital eingesammelt – zuletzt 175 Millionen Euro in unserer Series E im Januar 2026, angeführt von TCV und Blackstone Growth, neben Investoren wie Sequoia, CapitalG (Alphabet) und DST Global. Unsere Bewertung liegt bei 3,5 Milliarden Euro.

- 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf über 900 Pennylaner:innen angewachsen, davon mehr als 400 in Tech, Data und Product – mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

- 🚀 Bereits mehr als 900.000 KMU und über 5.000 Steuerkanzleien nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich – in diesem Segment sind wir dort in fünf Jahren zum Marktführer geworden.

- 🇩🇪 Deutschland ist unser wichtigster Wachstumsmarkt: Geführt von Managing Director Tobias Janiesch wächst das deutsche Team in Berlin und München 2026 auf rund 100 Kolleg:innen. Du kommst in der Gründungsphase dazu und prägst, wie Pennylane hier verkauft.

Deine Mission 

Du wirst die oder der erste Team Lead Sales (m/w/d) – Steuerkanzleien in Deutschland sein. Deine Mission ist es, mit deinem Team von Account Executives Steuerkanzleien in ganz Deutschland für Pennylane zu gewinnen – du führst, coachst und baust das Team aus.

In Frankreich ist Pennylane in diesem Segment innerhalb von fünf Jahren zum Marktführer geworden. Du übernimmst das bewährte Playbook und passt es gemeinsam mit unserem Head of Sales, an den du berichtest, an den deutschen Kanzleimarkt an. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Tobias Janiesch, Managing Director Deutschland, zusammen. Unser Prozess: Erstgespräch, Interview mit dem Head of Sales, Case Study, Abschlussgespräch mit dem Managing Director in Berlin.

Dein Team 

- Full-Cycle Sales: Deine Account Executives verantworten den gesamten Prozess – von der Qualifizierung über die Produkt-Demo und den Abschluss bis zum Onboarding und Account Management ihrer Kanzleien.

- Starkes Setup: Dabei seid ihr nicht allein: Unser eigenes Customer-Success-Team in Berlin unterstützt euch bei Onboarding und Betreuung der Kanzleien, damit deine AEs genug Zeit für die Neukundengewinnung haben.

- Regional organisiert: Jede:r AE betreut eine feste Region in Deutschland – per Inside Sales und vor Ort in den Kanzleien.

- Im Aufbau: Du übernimmst aktuell zwei Account Executives und stellst gemeinsam mit unserem Talent-Acquisition-Team weitere ein – das Team wächst mit dir.

- Beratender Vertrieb: Dein Team gewinnt Kanzleiinhaber:innen und Partner:innen für eine neue Art der Zusammenarbeit mit ihren Mandanten. Ihr macht den Nutzen von Pennylane für den Kanzleialltag konkret und schafft Vertrauen in die Einführung einer neuen Plattform.

- Standort Berlin: Das Team wird aus unserem Berliner Office geführt – du bist an zwei Tagen pro Woche vor Ort, den Rest flexibel. Rund 30 % deiner Zeit bist du bei deinen AEs und in Kanzleien in Deutschland unterwegs, in der Regel ein Termin pro Woche, den du selbst planst.

Du wirst für die Leistung dieses Teams verantwortlich sein durch: 

- Du verantwortest die Vertriebsleistung deines Teams – gemessen am MRR aus deutschen Steuerkanzleien – und leistest damit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zum Wachstum im deutschen Kanzleimarkt.

- Du schaffst klare Erwartungen, coachst regelmäßig anhand konkreter Kundengespräche und nutzt Pipeline- und Conversion-Daten, um dein Team gezielt weiterzuentwickeln.

- Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Head of Sales den Go-to-Market-Ansatz für Kanzleien weiter (Inside Sales + Field Sales) und setzt ihn mit deinem Team um.

- Du begleitest deine AEs im Feld – bei Kanzleibesuchen, Branchenevents und Key Deals.

- Du arbeitest eng mit dem französischen Sales-Team zusammen und überträgst, was vom Playbook für Deutschland funktioniert.

Als Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien sind deine Ziele vielfältig: 

- Du erreichst die Vertriebsziele des Teams und steuerst das Tagesgeschäft – im Office wie bei den AEs in ihren Regionen.

- Du verantwortest das Sales Enablement deiner Account Executives: Techniken, Messaging und der gesamte Pennylane-Sales-Prozess.

- Du begleitest neue AEs durch Onboarding und Ramp-up und führst sie zu ihren Zielen.

- Du baust Teamgeist, Engagement und Wohlbefinden auf – mit Challenges, Teambuildings und Formaten, die du selbst gestaltest.

- Du bringst die Perspektive des Kanzleivertriebs in die Sales-OKRs von Pennylane Deutschland ein.

- Du gehst bei wichtigen Deals selbst mit rein – vor Ort in der Kanzlei oder per Video-Call.

Dein Profil 

- Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Sales mit – idealerweise SaaS mit mehrstufigen Deal-Zyklen und mehreren Stakeholdern – und hast bereits ein Sales-Team (AEs / Full-Cycle) erfolgreich geführt. Diese Führungserfahrung ist uns wichtiger als eine bestimmte Jahreszahl.

- Ein Plus: Du kennst den Markt der Steuerkanzleien oder das Accounting-/Fintech-Ökosystem – oder hast an Steuerberater:innen, Kanzleien oder andere Berufsträger verkauft. Wenn nicht, bringst du die Neugier mit, dich schnell einzuarbeiten.

- Du führst über Coaching: Du entwickelst Menschen anhand echter Kundengespräche, mit Daten, klarem Feedback und dem Mut, Entscheidungen zu treffen und durchzuhalten.

- Du bist offen für Selbstreflexion und fühlst dich wohl dabei, Feedback zu geben und zu empfangen.

- Du arbeitest bereichsübergreifend mit anderen Abteilungen zusammen – Marketing, Customer Success, Product und dem französischen HQ.

- Du bist hands-on: Du führst nicht nur vom Dashboard aus, sondern gehst selbst mit in Deals – auch vor Ort.

- Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau – deine Kund:innen sind deutsche Kanzleien – und sicheres Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit Paris.

- Du lebst in Berlin oder bist bereit, nach Berlin zu ziehen – und du bist gern bei Kunden vor Ort (rund 30 % Reiseanteil).

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen 

- 🏢 Berlin, hybrid: zwei Tage pro Woche in unserem Berliner Office, die übrigen Tage flexibel.

- 🌴 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr.

- 💵 Ein attraktives OTE-Paket: Fixgehalt plus variabler Anteil, gekoppelt an den MRR, den dein Team erzielt.

- 📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

- 🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln.

- 🇫🇷 Onboarding im Pariser HQ, regelmäßiger Austausch mit dem französischen Sales-Team und Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

- 💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

- 🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (alle 3 Monate) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar – plus Team-Events in Berlin.

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

description:
SDR – Sales Development Representative (m/w/d) – SME / KMU | Berlin (Hybrid) 

Unbefristet · Vollzeit · Start zum 1. Januar 2027 oder früher · Berlin, 2 Tage pro Woche im Office (Montag und Donnerstag)

Du hast bereits mindestens zwei Jahre B2B-Sales-Erfahrung und willst im Inbound-Vertrieb für den deutschen Mittelstand richtig Verantwortung übernehmen? Bei Pennylane in Berlin qualifizierst du Unternehmen, die bereits Interesse an unserer Software gezeigt haben, verstehst ihr Buchhaltungs-Setup und ihre Herausforderungen und vereinbarst passende Demo-Termine für unsere Account Executives – ohne Kaltakquise.

Du willst Arbeit, die etwas bewirkt – an einem Produkt, das bald Millionen von Unternehmer:innen in Europa helfen könnte?

Du arbeitest am besten in einer Kultur, die auf Vertrauen und Eigenverantwortung setzt?

Dann könnte Pennylane genau der richtige Ort für dich sein.

Unsere Vision 

Unser Ziel ist es, die beliebteste Finanzmanagement-Software für KMU in Europa zu werden.

Wir befreien Unternehmer:innen von zeitraubenden Aufgaben in Buchhaltung und Finanzen und geben ihnen die Finanzkennzahlen an die Hand, die sie für die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen brauchen.

Gleichzeitig helfen wir Steuerkanzleien, weniger Zeit mit repetitiven Aufgaben und mehr Zeit mit der Beratung ihrer Mandant:innen zu verbringen.

Kontext 

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich – und wir sind im zweiten Jahr unserer Expansion nach Deutschland, mit unserem deutschen Team in Berlin.

In 6 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

- 💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Steuerberater:innen bekannt gemacht.

- 💰 Wir haben insgesamt 400 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, PayPal und viele mehr investiert hat.

- 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf mehr als 1.100 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

- 🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeitenden bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

- 🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen tausender Kund:innen und Steuerkanzleien gewonnen – mit herausragenden Bewertungen.

- 🚀 Bereits mehr als 1.300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 6.500 Steuerkanzleien nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

Warum ist diese Rolle so wichtig für uns? 

Das SDR-Team ist entscheidend dafür, wie wir neue Kund:innen gewinnen.

Als erstes Glied in unserer Sales-Kette prüfen SDRs, welche Anfragen gut zu Pennylane passen, und machen daraus Gesprächstermine – und legen damit die Basis für den Erfolg des gesamten Teams.

Das deutsche SDR-Team besteht aktuell aus 2 Personen, und du gestaltest es mit, während es wächst. Du berichtest direkt an Jacob, unseren Global Head of Sales SME, und bringst deine Erfahrung aktiv in den Aufbau unseres deutschen SME-Vertriebs ein – mit Sales Academy, Buddy und Shadowing bringen wir dich schnell auf Pennylane-Niveau.

Wie trägst du zum Projekt bei? 

Wir erhalten täglich viele Inbound-Anfragen von Unternehmen, die Pennylane kennenlernen möchten. Genau mit diesen arbeitest du – 100 % Inbound-Vertrieb, Kaltakquise (Outbound) gibt es in dieser Rolle nicht.

Die größte Herausforderung: Tempo, Volumen und Qualifizierungstiefe in Balance halten. Du reagierst schnell auf deutsche Interessent:innen und gehst gleichzeitig tief genug, um ihr Buchhaltungs-Setup, ihre geschäftlichen Herausforderungen und die Komplexität ihres Falls wirklich zu verstehen.

Konkret heißt das:

- Du qualifizierst deutsche KMU-Leads: Unternehmensprofil, aktuelle Buchhaltungs- und Finanz-Tools, Pain Points, Bedarf und Kaufkontext

- Du machst aus qualifizierten Leads hochwertige Termine mit dem passenden Account Executive – relevant, sauber terminiert und mit hoher Wahrscheinlichkeit, dass sie stattfinden

- Du sorgst für eine saubere Übergabe und dokumentierst Qualifizierung, Use Cases, Stakeholder, Dringlichkeit, aktuelles Setup und nächste Schritte in Salesforce

- Du fasst per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn nach und reaktivierst Leads, die abgetaucht sind oder einen Termin verpasst haben

- Du entwickelst unseren deutschen SME-Vertrieb mit: Du teilst Marktfeedback, verbesserst unser Messaging und arbeitest eng mit AEs, Marketing und dem gesamten Sales-Team zusammen

- Optional, je nach Erfahrung: Du verantwortest den kompletten Sales-Zyklus für Self-Sign-up-Abbrecher – du reaktivierst Interessent:innen, die ihre Registrierung nicht abgeschlossen haben, zeigst ihnen die passende Lösung und schließt die Opportunity selbst ab

Dein Erfolg misst sich vor allem an stattgefundenen qualifizierten Terminen, Show-Rate, Akzeptanz durch die AEs, der Conversion von Termin zu validierter Opportunity und der beeinflussten Pipeline. Die Ziele kalibrieren wir gemeinsam am Volumen und der Reife des deutschen Marktes.

Wie sehen deine Aufgaben im Alltag aus? 

So sieht dein Einstieg bei uns aus:

Die ersten 30 Tage 

- Du lernst Pennylanes Produkt, unseren Ideal Customer, den deutschen Marktkontext, unsere Qualifizierungsmethodik, Salesforce und unsere internen Sales-Prozesse kennen und begleitest SDR- und AE-Calls (Shadowing)

Bis Tag 60 

- Du qualifizierst deutsche Leads eigenständig, erkennst ihre zentralen Pain Points und übergibst sie mit vollständigen, verwertbaren Notizen an den richtigen AE

Bis Tag 90 

- Du verantwortest den gesamten Qualifizierungsprozess für deutsche SME-Leads, erfüllst die vereinbarten Aktivitäts- und Qualitätsstandards, lieferst einen verlässlichen Fluss hochwertiger Termine und identifizierst erste Hebel für bessere Conversion und besseres Messaging

Nach 12 Monaten 

- Du bist ein verlässlicher, autonomer SDR für den deutschen SME-Markt, erreichst oder übertriffst deine KPIs, kennst deutsche Kundenprofile, Buchhaltungs-Workflows und typische Einwände aus dem Effeff und wirst von den AEs als Quelle hochwertiger Opportunities geschätzt

- Du prägst unser deutsches Sales-Playbook mit und beschleunigst den Aufbau unseres SME-Go-to-Market in Deutschland

- Abhängig von deiner Leistung und offenen Positionen kannst du dich perspektivisch in Richtung Account Executive entwickeln

Wen wir suchen 

- Du bringst mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb mit – als SDR/BDR, im Inside Sales oder in einer vergleichbaren kundenorientierten Rolle, idealerweise in SaaS, Fintech, Buchhaltungssoftware oder einem anderen beratungsintensiven Vertriebsumfeld

- Du führst starke Discovery- und Qualifizierungsgespräche: Du verstehst das Buchhaltungs- und Finanz-Setup eines Unternehmens, erkennst Pain Points, Dringlichkeit und Entscheider:innen und beurteilst, ob eine Anfrage zu Pennylane passt

- Du arbeitest mit hoher Eigenverantwortung, Follow-up-Disziplin und CRM-Sorgfalt: hohes Lead-Volumen, saubere Salesforce-Daten, hochwertige Übergaben an die AEs

- Du bist neugierig, kundenorientiert und ein:e starke:r aktive:r Zuhörer:in – du stellst die richtigen Fragen und gibst dich nicht mit Oberflächenantworten zufrieden

- Du bist resilient, diszipliniert und proaktiv: Du gehst souverän mit Absagen um, bleibst beim Nachfassen dran und hältst in einem schnellen Sales-Umfeld ein hohes Tempo

- Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder nahezu muttersprachlichem Niveau und verhandlungssicheres Englisch (unsere Unternehmenssprache)

- Ein Plus: Erfahrung mit Inbound-Qualifizierung und Salesforce, Verständnis für Buchhaltungs-, Finanz- oder ERP-Prozesse, Erfahrung im Verkauf an Steuerberater:innen, Finanzteams oder Geschäftsinhaber:innen – und Französischkenntnisse

- Ship software that lasts. Own design, implementation, testing, and delivery. Build clear APIs that are easy to use for agents. Make difficult bugs reproducible and keep them from returning. Know when to build fast, and when to build thoroughly.

- Shape the next chip. Work with hardware architects to test how numerical formats and arithmetic choices affect real models. Turn those findings into better hardware and algorithm designs.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

The Role

We're hiring a Senior Data Engineer .

Data sits at the core of what tem does. Our time-series data is the spine that runs from pricing through to billing: every transaction depends on it working. You'll be working across a genuinely varied set of workloads: textual data, time-series data, and event streams, each with its own ingestion and reliability challenges, including TSDS.

You'll join our Data Service team of 4, owning the design, reliability, and recovery strategy of specific ingestion pipelines and systems end-to-end. This is an individual contributor role: no team to manage, full ownership of the work you do. - Maintain and improve the data platform, including working through the existing tech debt backlog.

- Build monitoring and alerting so issues surface before they become incidents.

- Set the data quality checks that make an SLA commitment possible, and hold the line on them.

- Help take the number of data products with a defined SLA from 2 to 10.

- Own the design, reliability, and resilience of ingestion pipelines end-to-end, including TSDS, with a clear recovery strategy when things break.

- Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines for new and existing data sources.

- Decide the right approach (batch vs. streaming) for each pipeline in your domain, including high-scale, low-latency requirements for time-series data.

- Set data quality checks that make an SLA commitment possible, and hold the line on them.

Platform Maintenance 

- Own the day-to-day reliability of the data platform: monitoring, testing, and fixing issues before they become firefights.

- Own code quality and standards for the systems you're responsible for, including CI checks (linting, tests, coverage).

- Work through the existing tech debt backlog, prioritising fixes that unblock SLA commitments.

- Optimise pipelines for performance and cost as data volumes grow.

- Handle the failure modes specific to energy data: late arrivals, reprocessing, backfills.

Monitoring & Alerting 

- Build and improve observability across your systems so problems surface before they cause downstream impact.

- Set up alerting tied to the SLAs the team is committing to.

- Investigate and resolve issues within your domain, escalating genuinely cross-system problems.

Supporting Expansion 

- Help scope and prepare the platform for new data sources tied to international expansion.

- Flag where current architecture won't hold up as scope grows, even if fixing it isn't your call to make alone.

- Work closely with the AI team as their data needs on the platform grow.

Requirements

Must haves 

- Strong Python skills, with proven experience building and maintaining production data pipelines.

- Experience owning the design, reliability, and resilience of a data pipeline or system end-to-end, not just writing pipeline code.

- AWS or GCP experience.

- Great communication skills, comfortable working directly with stakeholders to scope and agree SLAs, and explaining technical trade-offs to non-technical audiences.

- Strong team player, comfortable working independently against a backlog and making judgement calls on prioritisation, while fitting into an existing team of 4.

- Terraform experience.

Bonus points 

- Experience with time-series data at scale.

- Experience with modern data stack tooling (Airflow, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, ClickHouse).

- Experience in energy or climate tech.

- Background in high-growth startups or scale-ups.

- Genuine interest in how AI tooling and workflows intersect with data engineering.

We're open to someone who doesn't tick every box here, as long as they bring solid AWS or GCP experience and the ability to own their own work end-to-end.

We move fast. Most processes take 2 to 3 weeks from first chat to offer. If you need us to adapt anything, let us know.

title: Member of Technical Staff
description:
About Seamflow 

Every plane, medical device, lift, battery and building has to be tested, inspected and certified before it reaches the world. It's the invisible layer that keeps the physical economy safe, and it still runs on Word documents, PDFs, spreadsheets and email. Seamflow is the software layer for that industry. We build AI-powered workflows for certification bodies, notified bodies and inspection companies: scheduling and resource planning, technical review, conformity assessment, field inspection, and document intelligence over messy real-world files.

Where we are: 

- Live in production inside some of the largest enterprises in the industry

- $4.5M seed, 14x oversubscribed , co-led by Northzone and Initialized Capital, the funds behind Spotify, Klarna, Coinbase and Reddit. Angels include Charlie Songhurst and Mario Götze.

- Demand is outstripping what we can build. That's the reason this role exists.

The team 

Most of our engineers were olympiad medallists in maths, physics or informatics before they were engineers. The team has come to us from Google, Amazon, X, Yandex, McKinsey and Bain, and from founding-engineer seats at startups that went on to multi-billion-dollar valuations. We hire against a very high bar, and this role exists to raise it further.

The role 

A Product Engineer owns the surfaces people actually work in. A coordinator planning a month of inspections across a fleet of auditors. A reviewer signing off on a technical file. These are dense, stateful workflows where the interface carries real consequences, and where the person using it has done the job for twenty years and will know immediately if the software doesn't understand it.

You own product surface end to end: the interface, the backend that supports it, and the data model underneath. Every customer runs the work differently, so there's no template to fall back on. You decide what the right thing to build is, build it, and are the one who hears about it when it's wrong. You'll ship to production in your first week.

What we're looking for 

We care far more about raw engineering strength than about matching a list of technologies. If you're excellent, we'll hire you whether you've spent the last three years in Rust, Go, Python, TypeScript, C++ or something we haven't heard of. Our stack is learnable in a fortnight. Judgement, speed and standards are not.

What we're actually screening for:

- You've built something hard and put it in front of real users. Not a prototype, not a course project. Something that ran, broke, and got fixed.

- You build genuinely good interfaces , and you can go as deep on the backend as the feature requires.

- You can hold a complicated workflow in your head and find the version of it that's simple enough to ship.

- Speed with taste. You ship fast, and you're opinionated about what not to build.

- You go to the source. You'll read the customer's actual documents, join the actual call, and look at hundreds of real outputs.

Signals we like, none of them required: 

founder or ex-founder, founding team experience, early engineer at a startup with a serious engineering culture, EF / YC / Antler, early or stealth-stage startup, design sense you can defend, open source you genuinely maintain.

This is probably not for you if 

- You want a strict boundary between work and life. We run one of the most ambitious startup cultures in Europe: fast paced, extremely high ownership, and in person in Shoreditch.

- You want a well-defined ticket handed to you each morning.

- You want to specialise narrowly and stay in your lane.

What you get 

- Real equity, and compensation that reflects a high bar

- Genuine ownership of product surface area from day one, with the founders in the room

- Relocation support and visa sponsorship, handled properly

- Lunch and dinner covered, 24/7 gym access, and any tool that makes you faster

- A small team with high standards, high trust, and no politics

If this sounds like your kind of problem, apply. A short note on the hardest thing you've built goes further with us than a polished CV.

title: Cyber Threat Intelligence Lead
description:
About CyberCube: 

CyberCube delivers the world's leading analytics to quantify digital risk , helping the largest global carriers, reinsurers and brokers understand, price and manage cyber risk in financial terms.

- AI at our foundation, cyber risk at our core. We don't just use AI, we shape it.

- Built on AI from day one. Artificial intelligence has been part of our strategy since the beginning, blended with deep cybersecurity and insurance expertise and backed by rigorous testing.

- Trusted by more than 100 clients, including 75% of the top 40 European and US cyber insurance carriers and 70% of the top ten reinsurance brokers.

- Backed for global growth. In 2025 Spectrum Equity joined some of CyberCube’s financial partners as a new cornerstone investor, accelerating our global growth and fueling innovation across our end-to-end cyber risk analytics for the insurance industry. 

- A truly global team across San Francisco, New York, London, and Tallinn.

- A culture of collaboration, openness, intellectual rigor, and ownership for excellence. 

- People at the forefront. We encourage CyberCubers to challenge themselves, push boundaries, and do the best work of their careers. 

The Impact You Will Make 

- Work in a team of cyber threat analysts, economists, data scientists, actuaries and risk modelers to develop insights, scores, and features for a suite of products delivering cyber risk analytics to the (re)insurance industry

- Own CyberCube's point of view on technology risk including factors such as:

- Offensive capabilities and trends among threat actor classes, and validating CyberCube models against observed real-world events,

- Security hygiene standards (e.g. NIST CSF, CIS) and mitigations for companies to lower their potential likelihood and/or impact of events, and

- Technology adoption and trends including the adoption, reliance on and governance of artificial intelligence

… translating these factors into the assumptions and scenarios that drive risk models – especially where historical data is limited

- Own the scenario and "event family" library for cyber catastrophe modeling, including emerging AI-driven scenarios

- Own the assumptions register and expert-judgment governance: the documented, client-defensible rationale for modeling choices that are not purely data-driven

- Present CyberCube methodology, threat landscape and emerging risk trends to clients and prospects and engage in strategic dialogue with key stakeholders as one of CyberCube's key voices and thought leaders on technology risk. Be able to differentiate when speaking with varying technical backgrounds and seniority (e.g. analyst to C-Suite)

- Engage in cross functional collaboration with stakeholders from engineering, product management, analytics personnel, and client facing teams to deliver on projects and product goals

- Deliver various cyber threat intelligence reports – e.g. threat landscape, scenario libraries, changes to mitigation and exploitation assumptions, etc. – on a quarterly cadence

The Skills and Experience You Will Bring 

- Bachelor's or master's degree in cyber security, computer science, statistics, economics, mathematics, or related field

- 3-5 years experience in offensive and/or defensive cyber security (CISSP, CEH, CISM, CompTIA Security+, or other certification preferred)

- Working fluency in Python / R, SQL, flat files and complex data types (JSON, XML), APIs, and Excel – enough to specify and interpret analysis with Data/Analytics teams

- Ability to translate real-world cyber threat behavior into modeling assumptions and scenarios – e.g. scenario likelihoods, severity, and mitigation impacts

- Intellectual curiosity, willingness to learn new skills, and push ideas forward

- Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills

- Strong communication and consulting presence with key stakeholders

- Experience working in and leading project teams

- Ability to work in an agile, fast-paced startup environment

- Ability to maintain relationships, collaborate effectively, and meet deadlines with a distributed, remote-first workforce

- Ability to think creatively and respond to emerging threats (cyber, AI, other) and their modeling implications in a timely manner

The Extra Credit, or The Focus Areas You Will Develop 

- Experience with analytics and risk modeling

- Experience in a SaaS product development environment

- Familiarity with ML techniques and statistical data analysis

- Familiarity with AI / LLM risk and its implications for cyber risk, social engineering, product safety, errors/omissions, and critical infrastructure

- Familiarity with a wide variety of Internet technologies such as BGP, TCP/IP, DNS, etc.

Why You'll Love it Here 

- Play an instrumental role in reshaping one of the key industries in the world

- Flexible working hours and the option to work remotely

- Opportunity to participate in a secondment program

- Company-supported mentorship program

- Grow in a collaborative, respectful, and empathetic culture

US specific

- Competitive salary and unlimited PTO

- Generous healthcare benefits with medical, dental and vision coverage

- Monthly catered lunches and happy hours

- Company-paid learning and development assistance

- Dependant care assistance plan

UK specific

- Competitive salary, pension and benefits

- Generous private medical healthcare insurance with dental and vision coverage

- Extra vacation days during winter holidays

AI Fluency at CyberCube 

AI is reshaping how work gets done across every function. We value people who are curious about AI, eager to learn, and thoughtful about applying AI tools to work more effectively. AI fluency is part of how we assess every role in our hiring process.

title: Senior Manager, Creator Partnerships & Social Commerce
description:
Build, Scale & Operate Leading DTC Brands alongside A-Players 

Maneuver Marketing 

Our Vision, Mission & Success are fuelled by our commitment to be a driving force of positive change to the health of everyday consumers, providing conscious, high-quality & innovative supplement products.

In just 5 years, we kicked off our own DTC Health & Wellness brand from scratch and scaled it to USD$100M+ in annual sales, serving more than 3,000,000 customers worldwide with an average of 4,000 daily orders across 9 SKUs.

These results caught the attention of The Financial Times , as they ranked us among APACs top High-Growth Companies. We have also been awarded 2nd place on the E50 Awards , jointly organised by The Business Times and KPMG in Singapore. 

This is just the beginning of our journey, and you could be part of the next stage of our growth! 

Your Next Role 

We are looking for a strategic, commercially minded and highly organized Senior Manager, Creator Partnerships & Social Commerce to lead and scale our creator marketing capability.

You will own the end-to-end creator strategy and drive implementation for two women’s health brands. One brand offers supplements that help with symptoms and root causes, and the other offers supplements that support one’s lifestyle habits and addresses nutritional gaps.

Leading a team of two associates who execute the seeding program, you will upgrade and refine our current strategy to build a reliable community of high-quality creator partnerships that strengthen our organic presence, generate commercially valuable content and support our paid media performance.

This is a hands-on management role. You will set the strategy and performance targets, develop the team, improve our systems and processes, and remain directly involved in high-value partnerships and campaign decisions.

The ideal candidate combines strong creator marketing instincts with operational discipline, commercial judgment and a clear understanding of how creator content can be transformed into effective paid advertising.

What You’ll Do 

1. Own the Creator Strategy Across Both Brands 

- Own creator strategy for two women's health brands across two distinct motions: an established seeding program producing content at volume, and a new TikTok Shop affiliate program built for direct sales.

- Scope is deliberately asymmetric. Seeding covers 4 flagship SKUs today, expanding to all 6 once the team's agentic workflows free the capacity. TikTok Shop launches focused on 2 products under one brand.

- Build creator-driven demand that shows up beyond the platform it originates on: branded search volume, Amazon and Shopify sales lift, and a content library that feeds paid media.

- Identify the right mix of healthcare professionals and content creators for each campaign.

- Establish measurable targets across outreach volume, response rates, partnership approvals, content delivery, cost efficiency and campaign performance.

- Monitor competitor activity, creator pricing and emerging platform trends to keep our approach relevant and competitive.

- Build and deploy AI workflows that increase the team's throughput - creator qualification, outreach personalization at volume, content tagging and rights tracking. We expect measurable capacity gains, not experimentation.

2. Lead and Develop the Creator Marketing Team 

- The Meta seeding program is built and running at scale. Your associates own the day-to-day operations; your job is to consult with creative leads, sharpen briefs, run creative tests, and hold quality while the majority of your own attention goes to TikTok and affiliates.

- Oversee the team’s day-to-day outreach, follow-ups, creator communication, fulfilment coordination and administrative workflows.

- Build clear processes and operating rhythms that allow the team to manage a high volume of influencer activity accurately and efficiently.

3. Build a Scalable Creator Acquisition Pipeline 

- Source creators across three routes: direct outreach, the TikTok Shop affiliate marketplace, and the established creator network available through our TikTok consultant. Convert the consultant's network into signed, producing partnerships rather than a list.

- Sustain the current output of hundreds of pieces of creator content per month across the seeding program, while building a separate affiliate creator pipeline for TikTok Shop.

- Assess potential partners based on audience fit, content quality, engagement, credibility, pricing and their ability to create or follow relevant trends.

- Develop partnerships with a strong focus on micro- and mid-sized creators, while selectively pursuing larger influencers when commercially justified.

- Create tailored outreach strategies for a competitive market in which larger brands may offer significantly higher creator fees.

4. Build the TikTok Shop Affiliate Program 

- Own the TikTok Shop affiliate program for 2 products under one brand, from creator recruitment through commission structure, sample logistics and GMV performance.

- Set and manage commission tiers, open collaborations, targeted invites and any performance-based arrangements; decide where flat-fee and where commission-only makes sense.

- Own affiliate GMV as a number you're accountable for, and the unit economics behind it: cost per acquired affiliate, sample cost per producing creator, blended commission rate.

- Identify and develop the small number of affiliates who will drive the majority of GMV, and build repeat and exclusive arrangements with them.

- Work with the TikTok Affiliate Creative Strategist on creative direction. They own research, concept and brief content; you own creator supply, terms, relationship and program performance.

5. Own Campaign Execution and Creator Relationships 

- Oversee partnerships from initial outreach and qualification through contracting, product delivery, content production, payment and performance review.

- Ensure creators receive clear briefs, campaign expectations, timelines and feedback.

- Build strong, professional relationships that encourage creators to become long-term brand advocates rather than one-off partners.

- Maintain an active and engaged creator community through regular updates, challenges, educational content and brand communications.

- Own claims compliance in creator content across both brands. Maintain the do-say/don't-say guidance creators work from, and make sure it holds at volume across seeding, affiliate and organic.

- Ensure FTC material-connection disclosure and platform-specific policy compliance on every partnership. TikTok Shop enforces supplement claims differently from Meta; both need to be handled correctly.

6. Turn Creator Content into Growth Assets 

- Secure usage rights and TikTok ad authorization (Spark Ad codes) at the point of partnership, not retroactively.

- Establish a clear process for reviewing, categorizing and distributing creator-generated content.

- Evaluate content based on brand alignment, creative quality, audience relevance and potential commercial use.

- Work with Paid Media, Creative and Marketplace to route creator content to its highest-value use: paid social, marketplace listings, email and brand channels.

- Translate both organic and paid media learnings back into creator briefs so creators can produce stronger, more testable content.

- Supply the brand social channels with a steady flow of approved, on-brand creator content. Publishing and community management on brand-owned accounts sit with a separate role.

7. Own Tools, Vendors and Operational Excellence 

- Manage our external partners - the TikTok consultant and content agencies - including scope, output quality, cost and the decision on when capability should move in-house.

- Own the influencer marketing stack end to end. We currently run SARAL; assess whether it, Modash, Lefty or an alternative best serves discovery, outreach, relationship management and reporting at our volume.

- Partner with Supply and Operations teams to ensure product kits are shipped accurately and on time.

- Oversee creator invoicing and payment workflows, ensuring submissions are accurate, approved and processed promptly.

- Identify bottlenecks and introduce scalable workflows, automation and documentation where appropriate.

7. Measure and Improve Performance 

- You'll be measured on four things: TikTok Shop affiliate GMV, cost per usable content asset, branded search and marketplace lift attributable to creator activity, and content throughput against quality standard. Everything else is diagnostic.

- You'll manage a defined creator and sampling budget across both programs, with authority to reallocate between seeding and affiliate based on returns.

- Define and monitor the KPIs required to evaluate the health and commercial impact of the influencer program.

- Track outreach volume, open and response rates, approval rates, creator acquisition costs, content delivery, engagement, reach, conversions and return on investment.

title: Senior Product Lifecycle Manager
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Program Management Team 

Wayve’s Program Management team turns complex technical goals into coordinated delivery. Working closely with engineering, product, safety and validation teams, we align priorities, manage dependencies and bring clarity to ambiguous challenges. We combine technical depth with cross-functional leadership to help teams move faster, more predictably and with purpose—focusing on meaningful outcomes rather than process for its own sake.

As Senior Product Lifecycle Manager, you’ll connect Wayve’s product milestones to the detailed technical plans, system-level artefacts and readiness evidence needed to deliver them. You’ll lead complex, multi-team programmes from one milestone to the next, ensuring teams work from a shared, credible plan across our Level 2 and Level 4 products.

🧠 Your day-to-day 

- Partner with engineering and product leads to translate product milestones into integrated cross-team schedules, priorities and delivery plans.

- Review technical progress, backlog health, dependencies and system-level evidence to determine whether programmes are ready to move forward.

- Identify technical risks and sequencing bottlenecks early, then drive the decisions and mitigation plans needed to protect delivery.

- Facilitate difficult conversations around scope, resources and competing priorities, helping teams reach clear and practical decisions.

- Adapt plans quickly as technical understanding, product priorities or delivery constraints change.

- Communicate programme status, schedule changes, risks and decisions clearly and proactively across technical teams and senior stakeholders.

🧩 What you’ll be working on: 

- Owning and maintaining integrated lifecycle plans for complex Level 2 and Level 4 product milestones, creating a clear source of truth across teams.

- Managing cross-team dependencies and critical-path activities across engineering, product, safety, verification and validation.

- Managing system-level artefacts throughout the product lifecycle, ensuring the right information and evidence are available at each milestone.

- Establishing clear milestone-readiness criteria and using technical status, metrics and backlog data to support evidence-based delivery decisions.

- Aligning programme scope, sequencing and resource decisions with Wayve’s strategic and commercial priorities.

- Improving lifecycle-planning practices and tooling so teams can identify risk earlier, coordinate more effectively and deliver with greater predictability.

🙌 You should apply if: 

- You have 5+ years of experience leading complex, multi-team technical or product programmes, with responsibility for planning, execution and delivery across several engineering teams.

- You bring a strong background in the automotive or autonomous-vehicle industry and understand the complexity of delivering integrated vehicle and software products.

- You have the technical depth to work closely with engineers, evaluate complex system architectures and challenge delivery plans constructively—not simply track execution.

- You think in systems, understanding how technical decisions, dependencies and changes in one area affect downstream teams and product outcomes.

- You’re decisive under uncertainty and can make sound prioritisation and trade-off recommendations with incomplete or evolving information.

- You have a strong track record of identifying delivery, technical and dependency risks early and driving them through to resolution.

- You use metrics, technical evidence and backlog health to assess readiness and guide programme decisions.

- You’re product-minded and outcome-focused, connecting delivery decisions to customer value and business impact rather than process completion alone.

- You can facilitate challenging stakeholder conversations, resolve conflicting technical priorities and create alignment without relying on formal authority.

- You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, tailoring complex programme information for both technical and business audiences.

- You’re proficient with Jira, Confluence and modern backlog, planning and programme-management tools.

- Experience working in a safety-critical, regulated or complex multi-stakeholder environment would be valuable.

- A programme-management qualification such as PMP, CAPM or PRINCE2 would be a plus.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve: 

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: 

This is a full-time role based in our London office.

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process: 

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

- Initial call / recruiter screen (30 minutes)

- Competency Interviews (HM Call; 60 minutes)

- Deep-dive technical interviews (Stakeholder Management, Delivery Use Case; 2 hours)

- Final interview : mission & values alignment (45 minutes).

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):
