✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

title: Applied AI Engineer, AI for Mistral
description:
About Mistral 

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As an Applied AI Engineer, your mission is to make Mistral AI-native from the inside. You lead the design and delivery of production-grade AI systems in rapid cycles, building the iconic use case for multiple department (eg: GTM, HR, Engineering, Finance, ect) in your portfolio. You sit where product, engineering and the business overlap, turning advanced technology into real-world solutions that move a metric.

You translate complex, often ambiguous business requirements into engineered solutions that work at scale. You act as the technical lead for your departments and contribute as an Individual contributor you guide the technical choices, build the solution end to end, drive adoption, and keep improving it. Your goal is to build clients trust, and deliver high ROI solutions, not a hit-and-run POC.

What You Will Do

- Run discovery with department heads and key users, map their workflows, and turn ambiguous needs into a prioritized use-case backlog with clear expected value.

- Deliver end to end: design and ship production-grade full-stack apps (Python/FastAPI, React) and AI systems, from scoping through deployment and adoption.

- Encode business rules, KPIs and ROI metrics as durable datalake assets and app logic, so your departments run on trustworthy, observable data.

- Dogfood the latest Mistral products as a first internal user, and turn what you learn into credible product feedback that shapes the roadmap.

- Own architecture for your surface: keep it scalable, secure and observable, with a high bar on clean code.

- Spot patterns across departments and lift one-off solutions into reusable building blocks.

What We're Looking For

- At least 3 years building and deploying production AI software.

- Strong full-stack engineer: Python/TypeScript, scalable backends (FastAPI/Node), and enough frontend (React/Vue) to ship a usable app yourself.

- Hands-on with modern GenAI use cases: RAG, agents, workflows, orchestration and evaluation.

- Strong command of vibe-coding tools, paired with genuine care for clean code and architecture: speed without slop.

- Strong ownership and a bias for delivery. This is made for high-velocity engineers who already have experience.

- Fluent in AI-native tools (Slack, Linear, etc.).

- Passionate about solving customer problems. Here, your customers are Mistral's own teams.

- Excellent communication in fluent English: you can explain a technical idea to a lawyer, a marketer and a staff engineer in the same afternoon.

Nice to have

- Exposure to Legal, Public Affairs, Marketing or Compute/Infra domains, or a track record of getting fluent in an unfamiliar domain fast.

- Data engineering or analytics experience (warehouse modeling, dbt, dashboards).

- Contributions to open-source projects, especially around LLMs.

- A builder's instinct for internal tooling and platform reuse.

What We Offer 

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page .

Privacy Policy

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role 

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

You'll be the founding analytics engineer in Finance, shaping our data infrastructure and analytical capabilities during a critical transformation. - Build, optimise and maintain production-ready ETL/ELT pipelines using DBT, Databricks and SQL

- Create scalable data models and analytical solutions using modern data modelling techniques

- Build and champion data quality and testing practices; catch errors before they reach stakeholders

- Experience with Databricks or similar cloud data platforms, or willingness to ramp quickly

- Strong understanding of data modelling and analytics architecture

- Comfort working autonomously and managing priorities with ambiguity; ability to break down complex problems

You've built processes others follow; here, you'll do that with AI as a core enabler.

title: Ground Software Engineer - Core
description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft Orbital is looking for a Software Engineer to join our Core team within Ground Platform. The team develops the core capabilities that support Loft's ground platform, improve development workflows, and ensure platform reliability. You'll help build shared services and tools that benefit software teams across Loft.

You'll work on backend services, workflow automation, AI tooling, and platform infrastructure, with a focus on observability and reliability. You'll also have the opportunity to take part in spacecraft operations through SatDevOps rotations, helping investigate anomalies and supporting real-time incident response when needed.

If you're excited about improving how software is developed across Loft, contributing to key technical decisions, and building more reliable platform systems, we'd love to hear from you.

About this role: 

- Evaluate and implement new technologies and software patterns that propagate to the entire Loft's software stack

- Lead the creation and evolution of Loft's AI tooling for development, review, and spacecraft anomaly investigation

- Develop central ground platform functionalities such as workflow automation, microservice inter-communication, and metrics

- Take responsibility for the reliability and performance of Loft's ground platform infrastructure , including message queues, CI/CD, and observability

- Have the opportunity to take part in spacecraft operations through SatDevOps rotations, occasionally helping investigate anomalies and supporting real‑time incident response when needed

- Collaborate with software engineers and satellite operators from all over the company to support and foster consistent, maintainable, and performant software solutions

Must Haves: 

- Solid backend software development experience

- Hands-on knowledge of deployment and Infrastructure as Code

- Ability to define and maintain CI/CD pipelines

- Experience working with Kubernetes

Nice to Haves: 

- Python development, particularly with Django

- Knowledge of GraphQL and Graphene

- Experience with message queues and streaming technologies ( NATS )

- Knowledge of DevOps and observability tools (Helm, Terraform, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Loki, etc)

- Familiarity with AI tooling

- Frontend development with Vue and Web Components

Some of Our Awesome Benefits: 

- Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success

- Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best

- Health and life insurance, we care about your health

- Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand )

- Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences

- Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together

- Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable

* Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes. 

Who We Are 

Loft: Space Made Simple. 

Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit. 

We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives. 

With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure. 

As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.

title: TECH LEAD IA H/F
description:
Le rôle 

Équiper des équipes de LLM et de coding agents prend un après-midi. Les faire travailler en AI-Native SDLC, c'est-à-dire concevoir et livrer du logiciel avec des agents dans la boucle plutôt qu'à côté, demande de faire évoluer tout l'environnement autour : architecture, gestion du contexte, harness (la couche système qui donne à un agent ses outils, ses permissions et son contexte d'exécution), developer platforms, intégration au SI, infrastructure, sécurité, observabilité, évaluation.

Comme Tech Lead, tu aides nos clients à comprendre ces transformations, tu arbitres les décisions d'architecture qui en découlent et tu mets en place les capacités qui leur manquent. Tu conçois, tu conseilles, et tu descends dans le code quand il faut confronter une décision au réel.

Pourquoi on ouvre ce poste 

Nos clients ont dépassé le stade du POC. Leur question porte maintenant sur l'intégration des agents au SI et au cycle de delivery, et sur ce qui doit être mutualisé dans une plateforme plutôt que laissé à chaque équipe. Ce sont des questions d'architecture, et on n'a personne dont c'est le métier à plein temps.

Tes missions 🎯 

• comprendre le contexte Product, business et technologique du client, son SI et son environnement de delivery

• identifier ce que l'IA change et les capacités technologiques qui manquent pour y répondre

• concevoir les architectures et arbitrer les choix structurants : build ou buy, plateforme ou équipe, standardisation ou autonomie, besoin immédiat ou capacité durable

• prototyper ou implémenter certains composants quand une décision d'architecture a besoin d'être éprouvée

• accompagner les équipes client et faire monter les équipes Thiga en compétence

• intervenir en avant-vente comme garant technique, challenger les demandes et aider le client à transformer un problème flou en décision

Deux exemples de ce que ça donne concrètement 👀 

Passer à l'échelle avec les coding agents 

Le cas du début. Tu analyses l'existant, tu identifies les capacités manquantes et tu conçois l'architecture qui permet aux équipes et aux agents de travailler ensemble de façon observable et sécurisée. Le vrai sujet est souvent le knowledge : reconstruire un contexte exploitable à partir de repos, de docs et de conventions que personne n'a maintenus depuis trois ans.

Décider ce qui se mutualise 

Cinq équipes expérimentent chacune avec leurs propres modèles, agents et outils. Tu aides le client à trancher ce qui remonte dans une plateforme, ce qui reste décentralisé et dans quel ordre y aller. La réponse est rarement la grande plateforme IA. C'est plus souvent trois capacités bien choisies qui débloquent tout le monde.

Avec qui tu travailles 🤝 

- 
Chez nos clients : CTO, responsables Engineering, architectes, Platform Engineers, développeurs, équipes sécurité et Product. Tu dois pouvoir passer d'une discussion d'architecture très technique à une décision avec un dirigeant dans la même journée.

- 

Chez Thiga : nos Product Builders, Product Engineers et consultants Product. Ton rôle est de construire les enablers technologiques qui leur permettent de tirer parti de l'IA sur leurs missions, et de les faire progresser.

Ton profil 🚀 

Une culture Tech large 

Tu es d'abord un bon technologue. Tu comprends assez bien les systèmes logiciels modernes pour raisonner sur une architecture entière : software architecture, systèmes distribués, APIs, données, cloud, infrastructure, sécurité, IAM, CI/CD, developer platforms, observabilité. On cherche quelqu'un capable de repérer ce qui est structurant, de comprendre les interactions entre les couches et d'aller en profondeur quand le problème l'exige, plutôt qu'un spécialiste de chacune de ces disciplines. Tu as assez de kilomètres au compteur, souvent une dizaine d'années, pour avoir vu des architectures évoluer, atteindre leurs limites et parfois échouer.

Une vraie profondeur IA 

Tu comprends les systèmes construits avec des LLM et des agents, ce qu'ils permettent et où ils coincent. Context engineering, retrieval, tool use, systèmes agentiques, evals, sécurité, observabilité : tu sais raisonner sur les propriétés architecturales que ces systèmes introduisent et sur ce qu'elles impliquent pour le reste du SI.

Du jugement, et des mains 

Tu raisonnes en trade-offs, tu prends position et tu expliques pourquoi une option est préférable dans un contexte donné, sans confondre architecture et accumulation de technologies. Et tu es resté assez hands-on pour ouvrir le code, manipuler des APIs, explorer une infra ou monter un prototype quand ça devient le moyen le plus rapide de savoir.

Une culture Product et client 

Tu cherches à comprendre le problème, les utilisateurs, les contraintes de l'organisation et le résultat attendu avant de dessiner une solution. Tu sais challenger un client, poser plusieurs options avec leurs compromis, puis l'aider à décider.

Apprécié 

Une expérience du conseil, des transformations Product & Engineering, des developer platforms ou des systèmes IA en production. Si tu écris, contribues à de l'open source ou parles en conférence, c'est un vrai plus.

Pourquoi Thiga 👀 

Thiga vient du Product Management, ce qui change la manière d'aborder l'AI-Native SDLC. Cette transformation touche la technologie, le produit et la façon dont les équipes travaillent en même temps, donc on refuse de la traiter comme un simple sujet d'outillage ou de plateforme.

Tu seras rattaché à la Tribe Tech & IA, qui réunit nos Product Builders, les consultants qui déploient l'AI-Native SDLC chez nos clients et les architectes qui en construisent les enablers. Notre ambition : mener de vraies transformations chez nos clients, construire un collectif d'experts qui partage réellement ce qu'il apprend, et faire reconnaître Thiga comme un acteur de référence sur le sujet.

Il y a donc une vraie dimension intrapreneuriale, et la liberté qui va avec.

Process de recrutement 🎢 

1. Premier échange avec une Chargée de recrutement : ton parcours, ce que tu cherches, et une présentation précise de Thiga et du rôle.

2. Cas et soutenance : on t'envoie un cas une semaine avant. L'exercice ne consiste pas à retrouver notre architecture ou à réciter une stack, on veut voir comment tu abordes un problème complexe, comment tu explores les options, comment tu arbitres et comment tu défends une recommandation. On évalue quatre dimensions : profondeur Tech, profondeur IA, culture Product, posture de conseil.

3. Rencontre finale avec un.e Directeur.rice : approfondir ce qui doit l'être et valider l'envie de travailler ensemble, des deux côtés.

Notre culture 

Chez Thiga, nous vivons selon des principes forts : 

Product first 

Nous pensons produit dans sa globalité, de l'expérience utilisateur jusqu'à l'infrastructure. 

Hands-on or nothing 

Notre approche est radicalement pratique. Nous croyons en la démonstration concrète plutôt qu'en la théorie. 

Market Maker by Design 

Nous repoussons les limites et partageons ouvertement nos innovations. 

Knowledge Open Bar 

Le savoir n'a de valeur que lorsqu'il est largement partagé. Nous diffusons librement nos apprentissages et nos outils. 

Thiga accueille toutes les personnes compétentes et passionnées et s'engage en faveur de la diversité culturelle, l'égalité de genre et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés — au contraire nous considérons la diversité comme une grande richesse

description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋 

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We’re looking for a Strategic Account Executive to join our sales team in Paris. As a Strategic Account Executive focused on new business, you will be at the forefront of our company's growth in France, driving revenue by identifying, pursuing, and closing strategic deals with high-value new clients in the Hospitality industry . This role demands a proactive and results-oriented professional, with a demonstrated ability to consistently exceed sales targets within a direct sales environment. You will act as a trusted advisor, understanding potential clients' complex business needs and delivering tailored solutions that resonate and close

** Please note this role is based in Paris, France. ** 

What you’ll be doing: 

New business development 

- Proactively identify and qualify high-potential new clients within the hospitality sector, demonstrating how Lightspeed's platform can optimise their operations and enhance guest satisfaction.

- Develop and execute strategic sales plans to acquire key hospitality accounts, highlighting the benefits of our integrated POS, online ordering, and inventory management solutions.

- Build and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified leads, showcasing the future-proof capabilities of Lightspeed K platform for restaurants, bars, and hotels.

Direct Sales and Closing 

- Conduct demonstrations illustrating how Lightspeed's product empowers hospitality businesses to streamline operations and elevate guest experiences.

- Lead complex sales cycles, from initial contact to contract negotiation and closing, focusing on the value of Lightspeed's integrated payments and operational efficiency.

- Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual sales targets for new customer acquisition, driving the adoption of Lightspeed's transformative technology within the hospitality industry.

Client Relationship Building : 

- Establish strong relationships with owners, managers, and key decision-makers at prospective hospitality clients, understanding their specific needs and presenting Lightspeed as the ideal solution.

- Understand potential clients' business objectives and challenges, and align our solutions to address their needs, emphasising the benefits of Lightspeed's robust reporting and analytics.

- Smoothly transition new customers to the implementation and launch teams, ensuring a seamless onboarding experience with the Lightspeed hospitality platform.

And a little bit of.... 

- Work on other sales/marketing campaigns designed to improve the customer experience as well as grow Lightspeed MRR in the process.

- Maintain accurate records of sales activities and prospect interactions within the CRM system

- Contributing as part of the wider team to achieve organisational objectives even if this means doing things that aren’t strictly within the scope of your role.

What you need to bring: 

- 3-5 years relevant work experience in a 360 selling environment 

- Relevant work experience in an industry like IT solutions, software sales, e-commerce, cloud applications, SaaS, POS, retail/hospitality or technology.

- Experience working in a hospitality environment would be great, but isn’t necessary.

- Experience in an outbound sales environment.

What’s in it for you? 

Come live the Lightspeed experience...

- Genuine career opportunities in a company that’s creating new jobs every day;

- Work in a team large enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact;

- Exposure to modern and proven technology;

- Ability to work and grow in a truly flexible environment;

- Opportunity to learn, expand your skill set, forge wonderful relationships and make your mark within the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed culture, a true Canadian tech success story

… and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry:

- Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners)

- Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 EUR per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health 

- Mental Health Support through the Modern Health App- whether it is meditation, coaching or counselling you need - each employee gets access to this platform 

- Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

- Transit benefit if you travel by public transport to the office 

- Lunch reimbursement on the days you work from our Paris office 

- Healthy snacks and after work organised by the company

- Health insurance with attractive guarantee plans

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. 

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. 

Where to from here? 

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here .

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are: 

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
We are the platform turning browsing into shopping . We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands.

We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases.

In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company Flipp , creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia.

Ready to spark your growth with us?

WHO WE LOOK FOR 🦄 

Flipp + Shopfully’s Product team focuses on driving adoption and revenue of our products by identifying the biggest market opportunities, building the case for investing in them, and shipping solutions with engineering, all while representing the voice of our merchant customers.

About the role 

The Senior Product Manager is a senior, commercially minded product leader who already understands digital advertising. This role requires a strong strategic thinker with good business sense and solid hands-on product skills who leads opportunity identification, builds decision-ready business cases, and works with engineering to ship.

You will work closely with Sales, Engineering, Data, and Marketing teams across markets to align on key business objectives. By combining market insight, customer feedback, and industry trends, you will make sure our products resonate with merchants and drive growth. We’re looking for someone who can ramp up quickly and contribute independently.

WHAT YOU WILL DO 🏄

Market Understanding and Opportunity Identification 

- Work with Product Marketing, Sales Engineering and customer-facing teams to understand customer needs and prioritize the opportunities that matter most.

- Find the highest-leverage areas to invest in, and weigh customer demand against our resources, capabilities and strategic direction.

- Turn complex questions into clear priorities. For example: how do we create more value for retail partners as their strategies move toward e-commerce? How do we find and build opportunities at scale as products launch in new markets?

Business Cases and Strategy 

- Build business cases that size opportunities, weigh revenue trade-offs, and structure a clear recommendation so leadership can make a decision.

- Own your recommendations, and be ready to explain them and adapt them as you learn.

- Lead the strategy for how our products differentiate from competitors in the market.

- Partner with Sales and Finance on pricing and monetization so our offering stays cohesive.

Product Discovery and Delivery 

- Lead discovery with merchants, advertisers, and internal teams to define problems worth solving.

- Prioritise ruthlessly, balancing revenue impact, effort, and strategic fit.

- Work hands-on with engineering to define requirements and ship, from alpha and testing through broad launch.

- Partner with Sales and Marketing on launch timing and readiness, and run retrospectives on past launches to improve future ones.

Alignment and Stakeholder Management 

- Generate cross-functional alignment (Engineering, Data, Sales, Marketing, Content) with a shared focus on goals and timing.

- Work across markets and levels of seniority, including senior leadership, with confidence.

- Track progress and impact of product initiatives and communicate results clearly.

- Build relationships with industry analysts, partners, and customers, and represent Flipp + Shopfully at conferences and industry events where relevant.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED 🪄

Must-haves 

- Digital advertising foundations: supply vs. demand, how exchanges, SSPs, and DSPs work, programmatic bidding, pricing models (CPM, CPC, CPV), and fill rate and yield. Ideally gained in ad tech, a retail media network, a publisher, or a marketplace.

- Proven experience building business cases: sizing opportunities, weighing revenue trade-offs, and structuring recommendations for decisions.

- High autonomy: you figure things out, own the outcome and don’t need close management.

- Genuine excitement about using AI tools and rethinking how work gets done.

- Hands-on product skills: discovery, prioritisation, and working with engineering to ship, not only strategy.

- Stakeholder management, with the confidence to work across markets and levels of seniority.

- A scrappy, curious and confident approach. You’re hungry to make an impact.

👉 At our company, we value diversity and actively encourage it — we believe a variety of perspectives and backgrounds makes us stronger. We focus on potential rather than on having a “perfect” CV. If this role excites you and you believe you could grow into it — even if you don’t tick every single box in the requirements — we’d love to hear from you!

NICE TO HAVE 🎆 

- Retail, CPG, or retail media background

- Multi-market experience

- Can speak Italian or German

LOCATION 🌐 

While we have offices in Milan, Berlin, Barcelona, you can benefit from our flexible hybrid model (full remote available), empowering you to work where you're most effective.

HOURS ⏰
Your manager and several partner teams are in North America, so you’ll need to be flexible about working some later hours, beyond a standard 9-5 CET.

WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SHOPFULLY 🤗 

🌎 An opportunity to thrive in a rapidly scaling multinational company

🕶️ A vibrant, informal, and inclusive work environment

🧠 We champion autonomy, flexibility, and a hybrid work model, empowering you to own your work

📚 Access to learning opportunities and regular feedback sessions

🍓 Enjoy our central, modern offices featuring fresh snacks, coffee (including vegan options!), and ergonomic setups

🎉 Engage in meaningful team events: offsites, happy hours, company parties and celebrations that unite us beyond daily tasks

💻We provide all the necessary equipment for you to work effectively and set up your workspace, wherever you are

🧰 Benefit from additional country-specific advantages based on local contracts and practices

WHO WE ARE 💜 

We’re a team of 450 people (and counting!), from 30 different nationalities. We’re on a mission to innovate, and we believe the key to that is seeing the world through a variety of perspectives. That’s why building a more diverse team, as well as bringing in even more talent, is so important for us.

TO FEEL AT HOME 🛋️ IN SHOPFULLY YOU NEED 🎯 

- Progress Over Perfection : We move forward. Always. In a fast-moving world, speed with purpose beats certainty without action. Momentum matters—not for its own sake, but because it drives results.

- Clarity Through Transparency : We bring each other along. We work in teams, not silos. Transparency gives context, and context enables action. That means we share decisions early, publish work in progress, and document outcomes so others can learn, move faster, and build better.

We are looking for a Regional Field Chief Technology Officer to serve as a senior technical executive, trusted advisor, and public voice of our technology strategy in the market. This is a customer-facing, pre-sales technical leadership role reporting to the VP of Sales Engineering, with a dotted line to Product & Technology.

- Serve as trusted technical advisor and recurring executive sponsor for C-level and senior technical stakeholders at strategic, enterprise, federal and other key accounts — pivoting fluidly between business strategy conversations, risk, compliance, and deep technical architecture reviews.

- Partner with Sales and Presales leadership on the region’s most strategic and enterprise opportunities, leading technical deep-dives, architecture reviews, whiteboard sessions, and executive briefings, and advising on the technical implications of new product launches, roadmap changes, and competitive positioning.

- Proactively engage strategic accounts to strengthen technical trust, identify expansion opportunities, mitigate renewal risk, and guide customers toward secure software development and application security maturity.

- Identify and solve problems of strategic or industry scope, using innovative approaches to remove technical barriers, strengthen customer confidence, and improve business outcomes.

- Provide field-informed guidance on emerging AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, application security trends, and competitive market dynamics that may influence Black Duck strategy or customer adoption.

- Capture, synthesize, and escalate regional customer, partner, and market feedback into actionable input for Product, Engineering, and Sales systematically capturing technical objections and influencing the roadmap, packaging, launch readiness, and go-to-market strategy.

- Coach, enable, and review technical storytelling by sales engineers and account executives, including how to explain AI features accurately without overclaiming.

Qualifications and Experience Required :

- 15+ years in a senior technical leadership role (CTO, Sales Engineering leader, Principal Architect, or equivalent), including several years in a customer-facing or field/pre-sales capacity.

- Proven track record engaging and influencing C-level and senior technical audiences at enterprise organizations, with demonstrated success across complex enterprise sales cycles.

- Domain expertise in application security (SAST, SCA, DAST), enterprise architecture, cloud/SaaS platforms, APIs and integrations, and security best practices.

- Deep, practical understanding of AI/ML concepts as applied to security (e.g., anomaly detection, large language models, behavioral analytics, AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows), along with a candid grasp of their limitations and the practical limitations and controls needed for responsible adoption.

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, able to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and executive audiences.

- Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% to customer sites and industry events.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Systems Engineer  (Excavator Automation)
description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously. 

About the Job 

The autonomy team at Gravis builds autonomous systems for excavators operating in real construction environments. This role is at the intersection of system engineering, integration, field deployments, and debugging .

We are looking for an engineer with a degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Robotics or relevant fields and at least 2 years of practical, hands-on experience working with real systems - and if they fail, you can help us figure out why. This is not an entry-level or new-graduate role .

You will help define and execute system-level test scenarios , support atypical and beta deployments , and act as a technical bridge between the field and the engineering team. You will help train our field engineers and keep them in touch with fast evolving autonomy capabilities.

What you will do 

- 
Validate system behavior across machines, environments, and operating conditions

- 
Identify edge cases, failure modes, and operational limits

- 
Collaborate with engineering teams on making technical decisions on a system level

- 
Investigate system failure during field testing or deployments

- 
Apply hotfixes when appropriate

- 
Support or conduct deployments if needed, especially pilots or beta customers

- 
Support/conduct atypical deployments, pilots, and beta customers

- 
Capture lessons learned from deployments and feed them back into system testing and design

- 
Help prioritize fixes and improvements based on real-world impact

What we're looking for 

- 
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or a closely related field

- 
2+ years of hands-on experience working with complex systems (automation, robotics, vehicles, heavy machinery, industrial equipment, or similar)

- 
Strong system-level troubleshooting and debugging skills

- 
C++ and Python programming skills, proficiency in git systems

- 
Proficiency in Linux systems

- 
Comfortable working in field environments (construction sites, test yards, deployments)

- 
Ability to travel abroad, according to needs of the business

- 
Driver’s license B category

Beneficial 

- 
Experience with excavators, heavy equipment, or off-road vehicles

- 
Field testing experience

- 
Familiarity with communication technologies such as DDS, Zenoh, LCM etc.

- 
Experience in motion planning or control

- 
Experience in robotic competitions

Don't meet every requirement? If you're enthusiastic about this role but your experience doesn't match every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect candidate for this or other positions.

This is an opportunity to join a dynamic, multidisciplinary team and to be part of a company that is reshaping heavy construction.

Gravis is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team, and do not discriminate based on race, colour, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.

title: Team Lead - Invoices
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 

About the role 

Invoices is BLP's largest product. Every day, it decides whether a supplier invoice can be posted to the customer's ERP without a human touching it. The invoice team builds and runs that product.

This is a leadership job with three parts that are equally important:

- Build the team. The team is growing fast and is distributed across Zurich and several European countries. You hire, onboard, and grow engineers, and you develop the subteam leads who will carry more of the line management as we scale.

- Deliver for our biggest customers. Some of the largest enterprises in Europe are rolling out BLP right now. Their go-lives, automation rates, and escalations land on your desk, and you make sure the team delivers on what we promised.

- Turn the team into an empowered product team. Today, a lot of work still arrives as requests through proxies. You lead the shift toward a team that owns its problem space, defines outcomes, measures them, and decides what to build.

As Engineering Team Lead for Invoices, you lead the team that owns BLP's invoice product: You own the team's roadmap, delivery, people, and hiring.

This job is for you if you want to lead a strong engineering team through its next phase of growth and own the result.

You report to the Director of Product Engineering and work closely with the other product team leads, product management, and the go-to-market organization (project managers, customer success, and sales). The team is organized in subteams, each with its own lead, and you are the person who keeps them aligned.

What you'll do 

Lead and grow the team 

- Run regular 1:1s, ensure growth of the engineers in your team, review progress, and make promotion and ranking decisions together with engineering leadership.

- Coach and develop subteam leads, and set up the subteam structure as the team grows.

- Keep a distributed team connected and productive: clear working agreements, transparent planning, and a culture where people raise problems early.

Hire 

- Own hiring for the team end to end: define the profiles, screen candidates, run interviews, review coding challenges, and close offers together with Talent Acquisition.

- Keep a high bar while hiring at pace (our current target is around two new engineers per month), and make sure every new joiner has an onboarding plan and a buddy.

Own the roadmap and priorities 

- Build the quarterly roadmap and run monthly planning with product owners and product management, prioritizing by customer impact, revenue, and strategic value.

- Balance enterprise go-lives, automation improvements, platform migration, developer experience, operations, and new products, and say no when something does not move the product forward.

- Escalate early and clearly when priorities conflict, and communicate decisions to the go-to-market organization.

Deliver for strategic enterprise customers 

- Take responsibility for the engineering side of large enterprise go-lives: requirements engineering, solution design, test and fix cycles, and go-live readiness.

- Work directly with project managers and, where needed, with customer stakeholders and their IT teams, and give clear, regular engineering updates.

- Close gaps in the product rather than per customer, so the next enterprise customer arrives on a platform that already handles their case.

What you'll bring 

- You have led an engineering team of 8+ people for at least two years, ideally in B2B SaaS, and you have grown a team through hiring rather than only inheriting one.

- You have a strong backend engineering background and can still read, review, and discuss production code and system design with senior engineers.

- You have hired many engineers yourself, you know what a high bar looks like, and you can run a structured interview process.

- You have delivered complex software for enterprise customers, including demanding go-lives, and you are comfortable in a room with customer stakeholders.

- You prioritize ruthlessly, communicate trade-offs clearly, and can hold a position with engineers, sales, and executives while keeping the relationship.

- You develop people: you give direct feedback, set measurable goals, and help engineers grow into leads.

- You take ownership, surface problems early, ask for help when you are stuck, and hold your team to the same standard.

- You are fluent in English. German is a strong plus, since many of our customers and colleagues are in the DACH region.

What you'll get 

- A real mandate. You own the invoice team end to end: people, hiring, roadmap, and delivery.

- Impact you can measure. Automation rates and go-lives on our largest accounts are directly visible to customers and to the business.

- A strong team. Engineers from serious academic and industry backgrounds who care about doing the work well, with subteam leads already in place.

- A smooth handover. The current team lead moves into a new role in engineering leadership and stays available to support your start.

- Room to grow. As a fast-growing, global AI company, BLP keeps creating new leadership opportunities.

title: Senior Backend Developer
description:
Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it. 

quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end.

We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll. 

We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all.

Why this role exists 

Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries.

The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now.

This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it.

What you will own 

- Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket.

- The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent.

- The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current.

- Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms.

- The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns.

- The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team.

Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built.

How we work 

We are AI-native, operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how a small team ships like a large one, and how one engineer can hold the standard described here.

We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way.

And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard.

Your first year 

In your first month, you set up, learn the system and the people, and merge your first changes. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival.

By month nine, you are the person the team turns to for the quinn backend, and a developer you mentored is delivering features on their own. By the end of the year, the major backend roadmap items are live (logging, the database upgrade, versioning for our APIs and services), and at least one standard you introduced is used beyond your own team.

Who we are looking for 

- You have shipped and run production systems in C# and modern .NET / ASP.NET Core, and you know how they behave under load.

- You know PostgreSQL properly: schema design, transactions, locking, indexing and query optimisation. You read the execution plan before you add a cache.

- You have designed APIs and modules with clear boundaries and manageable dependencies.

- You treat personal and financial data with care. Security is part of how you design, not a review at the end.

- You use AI tools every day, and you can show where they made you faster and where you caught them being wrong.

- You own initiatives independently and raise risks before they become surprises.

- You review constructively, mentor willingly, and write code others can take over.

- English is your working language. German is a plus.

What makes you stand out 

- You have worked where an amount is either right or wrong: payroll, banking, insurance, accounting or tax.

- You have built foundations others relied on for years: an audit trail, observability, API versioning, a data model.

- You have taken a major database upgrade or migration through production without drama.

- You can explain what you built, why you chose your approach, and what changed because of it.

The team 

We are a small, fast and direct team: engineers in Zurich working closely with our Armenia team, and colleagues across Switzerland, Germany and the UK, 40 people in all. Not much process, not much hierarchy. A clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we mean: be open, own it, speak up, keep it simple, bias for action.

We are not filling a seat. If you would rather build the core than maintain the plumbing, we would like to hear from you.

The facts 

- Location: Zürich Wiedikon, hybrid with three days a week in the office; occasional travel to the UK, Germany and our Armenia team

- Role: Senior Backend Developer, individual contributor with technical leadership

- Reporting line: Our Lead Engineers

- Stack: C#, .NET 10, PostgreSQL; modular monolith

- Pensum: 100%

- Start: As soon as possible

- Language: English; German a plus

- Process: A 20–30 minute screening call, an in-person interview in Zürich on your career so far, a focused technical interview with the team (where we may work through a real quinn problem together), and reference calls

How to apply 

Apply with your CV and two short paragraphs: why this role, and why now. If you have something you shipped and are proud of, a system, a module or a write-up of a hard problem, include it. It tells us more than a CV does.

title: Certification Engineer
description:
About EH Energy Engineering 

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland . We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements , so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate .

Key responsibilities 

Certification strategy and project management 

- Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

- Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

- Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis 

- Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

- Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

- Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

- Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation 

- Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

- Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

- Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

- Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement 

- Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

- Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope 

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

- IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

Required qualifications 

- Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

- 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

- Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

- Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

- Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

- Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

- Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

- Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

- Fluent English, written and spoken

Preferred qualifications and personal profile 

Nice to have 

- Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

- Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

- Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

- Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile 

- Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

- Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

- Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

- Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

title: Erfahrener SAP Personalberater / Headhunter - Schwerpunkt Kandidatengewinnung
description:
Die besten SAP-Spezialisten der Schweiz suchen keinen Job, sie wollen angesprochen werden. Für das «Who is Who» der Schweizer Wirtschaft finden, überzeugen und begleiten wir genau diese Menschen. VANGARD ist eine auf SAP spezialisierte Headhunting-Boutique mit dem Anspruch: Headhunting. Nicht Recruiting.

Warum VANGARD, gerade jetzt 

Der Markt für Personaldienstleister ist unter Druck, viele Agenturen kämpfen. Wir stehen auf einem soliden Fundament: Seit 2012 sind wir im Schweizer SAP-Markt aktiv, haben bei über 400 SAP-Arbeitgebern platziert und sind in der SAP-Community bestens etabliert. Jährlich veröffentlichen wir das White Paper «SAP-Arbeitsmarkt Schweiz», mit Interviews von Branchenführern aus SAP-Beratung und Inhouse-Organisationen. Und dank unseres eigenen CRM-Systems vermessen und mappen wir den Schweizer SAP-Markt systematisch, wie kaum jemand sonst.

Für dich heisst das: Du musst nicht jeden Monat bei null anfangen.

Deine Rolle 

Du spürst Top-SAP-Spezialisten auf, für die sonst niemand einen Zugang findet. Du gewinnst ihr Vertrauen, verstehst ihre Ziele und begleitest sie bis zur Vertragsunterschrift und darüber hinaus. Unser Kandidatenpool mit tausenden Profilen, unsere gewachsenen Beziehungen und unser erprobtes Headhunting-Konzept geben dir vom ersten Tag an Rückenwind.

Deine Aufgaben 

Kandidatengewinnung 

- Systematisches Mapping des SAP-Markts: Wer arbeitet wo, in welchem Modul, mit welchem Erfahrungsprofil?

- Gezielte Direktansprache passiver SAP-Spezialisten über Telefon, Netzwerk, Empfehlungen und LinkedIn

- Aufspüren von Talenten, die auf keiner Jobbörse und oft nicht einmal auf LinkedIn sichtbar sind

- Kontinuierliche Pflege und Reaktivierung unseres Kandidatenpools

- Aufbau eines eigenen Netzwerks in der Schweizer SAP-Community, mit Empfehlungen als festem Bestandteil deiner Arbeit

Qualifizierung und Präsentation 

- Fundierte Interviews zur fachlichen und persönlichen Qualifizierung, von Modulwissen und Projekterfahrung bis zu Karrieremotivation und Wechselbereitschaft

- Ehrliche Einschätzung, welche Position wirklich passt, statt Kandidaten in die erstbeste Stelle zu schieben

Betreuung durch den gesamten Prozess 

- Persönliche Begleitung jedes Kandidaten als feste Ansprechperson, vom ersten Gespräch bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

- Individuelle Interviewvorbereitung, Gehaltsbenchmarks und ehrliches Feedback nach jedem Gespräch

- Begleitung durch Debriefings, Gehalts- und Vertragsverhandlungen

- Souveräner Umgang mit Gegenangeboten, Zweifeln und kritischen Momenten im Entscheidungsprozess

- Nachbetreuung nach dem Start, damit Platzierungen langfristig tragen und aus Kandidaten Botschafter werden

Zusammenarbeit mit den Key Account Managern 

- Projektarbeit in enger Abstimmung mit unseren Key Account Managern

- Bei Eignung Einbindung in die Kundengewinnung und -betreuung, etwa durch Teilnahme an Briefings und Kundenterminen

Was du mitbringst 

- Mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung in der SAP- oder IT-Personalberatung, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Direktansprache

- Einen nachweisbaren Track-Record im Gewinnen und Platzieren von Spezialisten, die nicht aktiv suchen

- Gutes Verständnis der SAP-Welt: Du weisst, was einen FI/CO-Berater von einem EWM-Spezialisten unterscheidet

- Die richtige Mischung aus Ausstrahlung und Hartnäckigkeit, am Telefon wie im persönlichen Gespräch

- Eine Art, die Menschen öffnet: Kandidaten rufen dich zurück, weil sie gerne mit dir sprechen, und hören dir auch nach dem dritten Nein noch zu

- Humor, Drive und die Gelassenheit, auch in hektischen Phasen den richtigen Ton zu treffen

- Stilsicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch

Was wir dir bieten 

- Ein stabiles Umfeld in einer gefragten Nische, mit gefülltem Pool und etablierten Beziehungen statt Kaltstart

- Erfahrene Mentoren mit über 10 Jahren SAP-Headhunting-Erfahrung, die dich mit viel Engagement, Know-how und Freude an deinem Erfolg unterstützen

- Ein solides Fixum und ein variabler Anteil, der deutlich über dem der grossen Personaldienstleister liegt: Bei gleichem Erfolg verdienst du bei uns unter dem Strich mehr

- Ein kleines, eingespieltes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und echtem Teamspirit

- Ein super modernes Office in Zürich-Greencity mit neuester IT

Was du sonst noch wissen solltest 

Bei uns ist jeder Tag anders, die Pace ist hoch, und Kandidaten wie Unternehmen erwarten eine Beratung auf höchstem Niveau. Dafür brauchst du Fokus, Engagement und Freude an Menschen. Unser Antrieb: SAP-Spezialisten in die Rolle zu bringen, in der sie wirklich wachsen, und dabei selbst jeden Tag besser zu werden.

Auf deine Kontaktaufnahme freuen wir uns.

title: Senior UX Designer - Map Visualisation
description:
TomTom's map is seen by millions of people every day - in dashboards, on phones, and across partner products worldwide. As a Senior UX Designer on the Map Visualisation team, you will shape how our 2D and 3D geospatial data is designed, styled and delivered across TomTom's product portfolio. 

You'll spend your days crafting multi-zoom map experiences, working with spatial data and collaborating closely with engineers and product managers to turn cartographic intent into production-ready map styles. You'll need to be as comfortable discussing label collision and style-layer specifications with engineers as you are refining colour palettes and visual hierarchy. 

This is a product role first. You'll be embedded in a cross-functional team that ships map rendering, map styles and SDKs used by other TomTom products and by the customers who build on our platform. You'll take part in the whole development lifecycle, from discovery and solution design through pull requests to release. Your product judgement, and your ability to bring people with competing priorities to a clear decision, matter here as much as your cartographic craft. 

AI is part of how we work. We expect you to use it to explore, prototype and ship faster, to know where it falls short, and to help shape map experiences in products where AI is part of the experience itself. 

What You'll Do 

- 
Design Compelling Map Experiences Create and refine 2D and 3D map visualisations from concept through production delivery. Own the end-to-end cartographic design process - from data exploration and sketching through to style implementation, QA and iteration across zoom levels, regions and use cases. 

- 
Maintain and Evolve Core Map Styles Enhance TomTom's core map styles, ensuring consistency, readability and visual quality across platforms, screen densities and global markets. Balance aesthetic ambition with rendering performance and data constraints. 

- 
Work as Part of the Product Team Work day-to-day alongside software engineers and product managers building TomTom's map data structures, renderers and SDKs. Take part in planning, refinement and reviews, provide design specifications engineers can act on, and review visual output during development and before release. 

- 
Make and Own Trade-offs Help decide what ships, when and at what quality. Weigh visual fidelity against render budget, memory and frame rate on automotive and mobile hardware, customer requests against platform consistency, and scope against release dates. Reach a decision with the people who own the product, record it and see it through. 

- 
Contribute to Renderer and Tooling Requirements Provide detailed input on the data and rendering capabilities needed to achieve design goals. Define requirements for internal cartographic authoring tools and identify workflow improvements that raise the team's output quality and speed. 

- 
Bring AI into the Design Workflow Use AI to shorten the loop from idea to rendered map: generating and editing style-spec JSON, scripting data exploration, and building interactive prototypes on real data instead of static frames. Turn what works into shared workflows the team can reuse, and help define how we check AI-generated output for cartographic quality. 

- 
Design for AI-Driven Map Experiences Contribute to how the map responds when the request comes from an AI system rather than a tap, for example in GeoAI answers, conversational search or agent-generated routes. Work out how the map shows what the AI found, how confident it is and when it is wrong. 

- 
Inform Decisions with Research and Data Participate in user research, customer conversations and competitive benchmarking. Use insights to ground design decisions and advocate for improvements that address real user needs. 

- 
Support the Design System and Standards Contribute to the Map Visualisation design system - documenting patterns, conventions and cartographic guidelines that enable consistency and scale across the product portfolio. 

What You'll Need 

Leadership & Product Team Experience 

- 
A track record of shaping product direction from the design seat. You set out the options, make the case for one and bring engineering, product and business stakeholders with you. 

- 
A track record of shipping software as a designer embedded in a product team, ideally on map, location or developer-platform products: SDKs, APIs, map styles or tooling that other teams and companies build on. 

- 
A clear understanding of how products move from discovery to release and beyond, including planning, roadmaps and measuring results after launch. You know how versioned releases, deprecations and backwards compatibility shape design choices on a platform with external customers. 

- 
Hands-on familiarity with how software gets built: backlogs, refinement, estimation, definition of done, Git, pull requests, code reviews, CI/CD, feature flags and release trains. You don't need to write production code, but you need to understand how your designs move through a rendering pipeline and into a release. 

- 
Sound judgement under constraint. You can point to decisions where you gave something up to ship, and explain why it was right for the product and its users. 

- 
Clarity with senior audiences. You can turn a complex design problem into a short, well-argued recommendation and own the result. 

- 
Comfort with disagreement. You challenge a decision with evidence, accept the outcome when it goes the other way and keep the work moving. 

- 
Experience contributing to solution design documents, technical specifications and cross-functional planning. 

Cartography & Digital Map Making 

- 
A solid foundation in digital cartography, GIS or geographic information design. If your map-making depth is still growing, show us how fast you are closing the gap, including how you use AI to learn. 

- 
Experience designing multi-zoom digital maps with attention to cartographic conventions, label placement, generalisation and cultural adaptation. 

- 
Working proficiency with key mapping technologies and ecosystems: MapLibre, Mapbox GL JS, OpenStreetMap data and tooling, QGIS, ArcGIS, Leaflet, OpenLayers or comparable platforms. 

- 
Experience working with diverse spatial datasets - vector tiles, raster tiles, GeoJSON, shapefiles, point clouds or terrain data. 

- 
Awareness of cartographic standards across regions and cultures, including sensitive topics such as disputed borders and local place names. 

Map Visualisation & Rendering 

- 
Demonstrated ability to build visually compelling 2D and 3D map experiences - from thematic styling and terrain visualisation to street-level detail. 

- 
Hands-on experience designing 3D map content such as buildings, terrain, landmarks and lane-level road geometry, in stylised or realistic form. You understand how LOD, lighting, materials and camera pitch affect legibility and performance. 

- 
Experience with 3D data formats and pipelines such as glTF and 3D Tiles, and how 3D assets are prepared and optimised for real-time map rendering. 

- 
Good understanding of real-time rendering concepts as they apply to maps: style layers, zoom interpolation, data-driven styling, symbol rendering and performance considerations. 

AI in Your Practice 

- 
Evidence that AI has changed how you work. Be ready to show a real example, such as a map style, data visualisation or coded prototype built with AI, and tell us where it let you down. 

- 
Sharp judgement of AI output. You can spot errors in generated work and know which decisions still need a designer's eye. 

- 
Experience turning personal AI use into workflows the team shares, within the limits of confidential data and licensing. 

Senior-Level Craft & Collaboration 

- 
5+ years of professional experience in UX, product or cartographic design, with most of that time spent inside software product teams. 

- 
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cartography, Geography, GIS, UX Design, Computer Science or a related field - or equivalent professional experience. 

- 
Ability to build clear, concise prototypes and specification documentation that bridge design and engineering. 

- 
Strong visual and graphic design fundamentals - typography, colour theory, hierarchy and layout. 

- 
User-centric mindset with a collaborative, low-ego approach to problem-solving. 

- 
High attention to detail and a real passion for the craft of map making. 

Nice to Have 

- 
Experience with game engines or 3D content pipelines (Unity, Unreal Engine, Blender) and their application to geospatial visualisation. 

- 
Familiarity with front-end languages and graphics APIs (JavaScript/TypeScript, WebGL, WebGPU, GLSL) or scripting for cartographic automation (Python, PostGIS, Overpass API). With AI, even basic coding skills go a long way. 

- 
Experience with map data processing tools and pipelines: Tippecanoe, Tilemaker, osm2pgsql, Mapnik or similar. 

- 
Understanding of the automotive, fleet management or logistics industries and their mapping requirements. 

- 
Familiarity with emerging trends in spatial computing, AR navigation or digital twins. 

- 
Experience contributing to design systems at scale. 

What we offer 

A competitive compensation package, of course. 

Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning. 

Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities. 

Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location.

Improve your home office with a setup budget and get extra support with a monthly allowance. 

Enjoy options to work from your home country and abroad for a set number of days each year, to visit family and friends, or to simply explore the world we’re mapping. 

Take the holidays you want with a competitive holiday plan, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday. 

Join annual events like our Hackathon and DevDays to bring your ideas to life with talented teammates from around the world. 

Become a part of our inclusive global culture and have the chance to collaborate with a diverse community – we have over 80 nationalities at TomTom! 

Find out more about our global benefits and enjoy additional local benefits tailored to your location. 

Meet your team 

We’re the User Experience Design team. Fueled by user insights and data analytics, our mission is to create powerful, easy-to-use products that delight our customers, from millions of drivers to automotive customers who embed our technologies in their vehicles. We deliver the design specifications for all TomTom’s products. Joining us, you'll be part of a team that brings together design disciplines from user research to interaction, concept and visual design. Together, we'll continue to develop a map that people trust all around the world. 

At TomTom... 

You’ll help people find their way in the world. In 2004, TomTom revolutionized how the world moves with the introduction of the first portable navigation device. Now, we intend to do it again by engineering the first-ever real-time map, the smartest and most useful map on the planet.

Work with a team of 3,600+ unique, curious and passionate problem-solvers. Together, we’ll open up a world of possibilities for car manufacturers, enterprises and developers to help people understand and get closer to the world around them.

After you apply 

Our recruitment team will work hard to give you a meaningful experience throughout your journey with us, no matter the outcome. Your application will be screene

Deepdesk, part of AnywhereNow, powers AI Assistants and Virtual Agents for enterprise contact centres, helping brands such as Achmea, Vodafone and DHL boost productivity today while scaling for the future of customer experience. As part of AnywhereNow, a global leader in customer experience technology with 220 colleagues worldwide, we combine the agility of a scale-up with the strength of an established enterprise provider. 

The Opportunity 

We are looking for an experienced developer to join our small engineering team. The centre of the role is backend development in Python or Go and cloud infrastructure, with some front-end work alongside. 

At Deepdesk, we are building “Augmented Intelligence” for the enterprise. Think Gmail Smart Compose for contact centres. We use machine learning to provide agents with real-time recommendations and autocomplete suggestions, supporting them in efficiently assisting customers. Alongside recommendations, we offer fully virtual assistants that can take care of repetitive tasks. 

You will work on the services behind this: the Python and Go services and APIs, the data stores and the cloud infrastructure that run our product for enterprise customers, including the services that serve our recommendation models. You will also pick up front-end work where it helps the product, for example in our admin interface and widgets. 

We are also building voice agents: AI that talks with customers in real time. Speech is turned into text, a language model works out the answer, and the answer is spoken back, all within a fraction of a second. You will help build and run the services behind this, in Python and Go. 

We have a start-up culture, but your code is directly used and proven at scale. Our technology is cutting-edge and continually evolving. 

What You’ll Be Doing 

• Build and maintain backend services and APIs in Python and Go, with background processing for heavy work. 

• Keep our databases fast and reliable. 

• Run and improve our infrastructure on Google Cloud: Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines. 

• Build and run the real-time voice agent services: speech to text, language model and text to speech, with low latency, in Python and Go. 

• Help deploy and run the machine learning services behind our recommendations. Machine learning experience is not required. 

• Design and provide complete and accurate end-to-end metrics. 

• Write and review well-tested, clean and maintainable code. 

• Follow software engineering best practices while staying pragmatic and avoiding over-engineering. 

• Contribute to front-end features in TypeScript and React when needed. 

Our Stack 

• Backend: Python (Django REST framework, FastAPI and Celery) and Go. 

• Voice: Go for our real-time voice AI service, with WebSockets, speech to text, language models, text to speech and the OpenAI Realtime API. 

• Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse and Elasticsearch. 

• Cloud: Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Flux and Cloud Build. 

• Front end: TypeScript and React. 

• Quality: automated tests (pytest, and BDD integration tests written in Go), code review on every change, and automation to keep our code and delivery practices in shape. 

What We’re Looking For 

• Strong professional experience building backend services in Python or Go. In Python, Django or FastAPI is a plus. 

• Solid knowledge of relational databases, in particular PostgreSQL. 

• Hands-on experience with containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD. Google Cloud is a plus. 

• Working knowledge of TypeScript and React, enough to build and fix front-end features. It does not need to be your strength. 

• A disciplined approach to testing, code review, maintainability and delivery. 

• Comfort working with autonomy and taking full ownership in a fast-moving environment. 

• Interest in voice and real-time systems, and willingness to also work in the other language. Our voice AI service and our integration tests are written in Go, and most of the backend is in Python. 

• A plus: experience with Celery, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, serving machine learning models, or real-time audio.

All employees are responsible for supporting and maintaining the organisation’s information security standards. This includes:
