title: Manager, Data science & Marketing Effectiveness (MMM)
description:
Manager, Data Science, MMM & Marketing Effectiveness – London, UK- 

Ekimetrics transforms how organisations make critical business decisions. Since 2006, we’ve been helping companies build sustained competitive advantage through AI-powered Managed Solutions. Our dual purpose is Competitiveness and Sustainability, because lasting leadership is built on both.

Our solutions are a unique combination of people and technology. We combine our Eki.Decisions platform with embedded experts in marketing, commercial effectiveness, and data science, connecting decisions across business domains to drive real, positive, scalable, and lasting impact.

With a full in-house team and offices in Paris, London, New York, Hong Kong, and Shanghai, we commit to responsibility and frugality in AI, systematically building competitive advantage, and being loyal to our values and DNA.

Your responsibilities 

As a Manager in Marketing effectiveness, you will lead high-impact programmes for international clients across industries such as Luxury, Beauty, Retail, Consumer goods, Mobility and Financial Services. You will manage multiple teams and accounts, oversee end-to-end project delivery, and ensure actionable insights are delivered to clients while driving business growth and talent development.

More precisely, you will: 

Lead Projects 

- Oversee end-to-end Marketing Mix Modelling and Marketing effectiveness programmes, from scoping and data strategy through to modelling, insights, and activation.

- Ensure robust project governance, including data quality, model validity, and actionable recommendations that drive client impact and business growth.

- Translate complex analytical outputs into strategic narratives and clear actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders and C-suite clients.

- Define, steer, and monitor project roadmaps using Ekimetrics’ methodologies and standards, ensuring delivery aligns with client objectives, profitability targets, and timelines.

- Provide strategic oversight to clients, helping them optimize marketing spend, enhance campaign performance, and improve customer segmentation and ROI.

- Support partners and senior managers in client engagement, delivering strategic insights, shaping proposals, and contributing to RFPs/pitches

- Continuously identify and implement innovative approaches to solve client business challenges.

People & Project Leadership 

- Line manage multiple team members, overseeing performance, conducting regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and talent assessments, while ensuring high-quality delivery, profitability, and client satisfaction.

- Lead talent development initiatives, including annual talent reviews and career development planning,

- Mentor project teams, guiding analytical workstreams, ensuring quality, and promoting knowledge sharing to develop team capabilities.

- Contribute to project staffing strategy, balancing business priorities, expertise requirements, and team development opportunities

- Recruit, align, and develop resources to build high-performing teams, retaining top talent.

- Encourage collaboration, communication, and knowledge sharing within squads, inspiring team engagement and continuous improvement.

Account & Business Growth 

- Serve as the operational and strategic point of contact for key accounts, maintaining strong long-term client relationships.

- Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities and support global account growth strategies.

- Contribute to the scoping and design of new projects, ensuring business cases align with Ekimetrics capabilities.

- Track and animate realized client business gains from Ekimetrics partnership, drive a narrative of program value to account stakeholders.

Practice & Thought Leadership 

- Enhance MMM methodologies, automation, tooling, and internal assets to scale delivery excellence.

- Contribute to thought leadership, knowledge management, and innovation initiatives.

- Act as an ambassador of Eki culture role-modelling Ekimetrics’ core values: Curiosity, Creativity, Excellence, Generosity, Enjoyment.

Your profile 

Experience & Technical Skills 

- Strong experience in econometrics, MMM, or marketing effectiveness.

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Data Science, Economics, Applied Mathematics, Marketing Analytics, or related field.

- Proficient in Python, SQL, Excel, and visualization tools; experience with Databricks, Azure, or other cloud/data platforms is a plus.

- Strong understanding of econometrics, regression, Bayesian statistics, and advanced modelling techniques.

- Skilled in handling large datasets, optimizing pipelines, and delivering high-quality outputs

- Track record of translating complex model results into actionable business recommendations.

- Fluent English is mandatory.

Client & People Management 

- Proven ability to lead multiple project teams and manage priorities autonomously.

- Skilled in client account management, maintaining relationships, and identifying growth opportunities.

- Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills for senior stakeholders.

- Strategic thinker with strong problem-solving skills and focus on continuous improvement.

- Experienced in mentoring, talent development, and encouraging team growth.

Soft Skills 

- Collaborative, proactive, and results-driven.

- Positive, resilient, and adaptable in fast-paced environments.

- Curious, creative, and committed to delivering high-quality and impactful work.

What we offer: 

Working for Ekimetrics is a lot of fun! Our London team consists of ~90 people. We come from all over the world to contribute value to Ekimetrics’ success - we love what we do, and we want to share it!

As well as an opportunity to join a driven, energetic, and highly innovative team, we also offer the following:

- 

- A compensation package between £80,000 and £95,000 & 20% bonus + £5000 Corporate bonus

- Hybrid working

- 25 days annual leave + Bank Holidays

- Private healthcare, life insurance, critical illness cover, and professional wellbeing support services

- Cycle2Work scheme

- 4% Group pension scheme

- Consciously cultivated culture: our best assets are our people. These sentiments are supported by our company values: Curiosity, Creativity, Excellence, Transmission and Pleasure. 

As an employer, Ekimetrics offers equal employment opportunities to all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, social status, disability, or age. Ekimetrics strives to develop an inclusive work environment that reflects diversity within its teams.

title: Senior Product Lifecycle Manager
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Program Management Team 

Wayve’s Program Management team turns complex technical goals into coordinated delivery. Working closely with engineering, product, safety and validation teams, we align priorities, manage dependencies and bring clarity to ambiguous challenges. We combine technical depth with cross-functional leadership to help teams move faster, more predictably and with purpose—focusing on meaningful outcomes rather than process for its own sake.

As Senior Product Lifecycle Manager, you’ll connect Wayve’s product milestones to the detailed technical plans, system-level artefacts and readiness evidence needed to deliver them. You’ll lead complex, multi-team programmes from one milestone to the next, ensuring teams work from a shared, credible plan across our Level 2 and Level 4 products.

🧠 Your day-to-day 

- Partner with engineering and product leads to translate product milestones into integrated cross-team schedules, priorities and delivery plans.

- Review technical progress, backlog health, dependencies and system-level evidence to determine whether programmes are ready to move forward.

- Identify technical risks and sequencing bottlenecks early, then drive the decisions and mitigation plans needed to protect delivery.

- Facilitate difficult conversations around scope, resources and competing priorities, helping teams reach clear and practical decisions.

- Adapt plans quickly as technical understanding, product priorities or delivery constraints change.

- Communicate programme status, schedule changes, risks and decisions clearly and proactively across technical teams and senior stakeholders.

🧩 What you’ll be working on: 

- Owning and maintaining integrated lifecycle plans for complex Level 2 and Level 4 product milestones, creating a clear source of truth across teams.

- Managing cross-team dependencies and critical-path activities across engineering, product, safety, verification and validation.

- Managing system-level artefacts throughout the product lifecycle, ensuring the right information and evidence are available at each milestone.

- Establishing clear milestone-readiness criteria and using technical status, metrics and backlog data to support evidence-based delivery decisions.

- Aligning programme scope, sequencing and resource decisions with Wayve’s strategic and commercial priorities.

- Improving lifecycle-planning practices and tooling so teams can identify risk earlier, coordinate more effectively and deliver with greater predictability.

🙌 You should apply if: 

- You have 5+ years of experience leading complex, multi-team technical or product programmes, with responsibility for planning, execution and delivery across several engineering teams.

- You bring a strong background in the automotive or autonomous-vehicle industry and understand the complexity of delivering integrated vehicle and software products.

- You have the technical depth to work closely with engineers, evaluate complex system architectures and challenge delivery plans constructively—not simply track execution.

- You think in systems, understanding how technical decisions, dependencies and changes in one area affect downstream teams and product outcomes.

- You’re decisive under uncertainty and can make sound prioritisation and trade-off recommendations with incomplete or evolving information.

- You have a strong track record of identifying delivery, technical and dependency risks early and driving them through to resolution.

- You use metrics, technical evidence and backlog health to assess readiness and guide programme decisions.

- You’re product-minded and outcome-focused, connecting delivery decisions to customer value and business impact rather than process completion alone.

- You can facilitate challenging stakeholder conversations, resolve conflicting technical priorities and create alignment without relying on formal authority.

- You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, tailoring complex programme information for both technical and business audiences.

- You’re proficient with Jira, Confluence and modern backlog, planning and programme-management tools.

- Experience working in a safety-critical, regulated or complex multi-stakeholder environment would be valuable.

- A programme-management qualification such as PMP, CAPM or PRINCE2 would be a plus.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve: 

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: 

This is a full-time role based in our London office.

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process: 

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

- Initial call / recruiter screen (30 minutes)

- Competency Interviews (HM Call; 60 minutes)

- Deep-dive technical interviews (Stakeholder Management, Delivery Use Case; 2 hours)

- Final interview : mission & values alignment (45 minutes).

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

description:
Firmus Technologies 

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific. 

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability. 

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally. 

Firmus AI Cloud 

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers. 

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale. 

AI FactoryOS Operations 

AI FactoryOS is Firmus' proprietary operating system for the AI Factory. It governs GPU telemetry, cooling, power and grid interaction as one integrated layer, so that every Firmus site can be optimised and monitored as a single system. 

AI FactoryOS Operations runs that platform in production and owns the 24/7 reliability of AI FactoryOS, Firmus AI Cloud and the platforms built on them, together with the service levels the estate is measured against. 

The remit is an engineering one. The function builds the guarded automation, remediation and operational tooling that turn manual response into a software-defined capability, and builds and operates the shared services the estate's own operation depends on. The function works closely with the engineering teams that build the platform, supplying the production evidence that shapes what they fix and what they build next. 

Role Summary 

Firmus runs large-scale, state-of-the-art AI infrastructure built on the latest generation of GPU rack-scale systems and operated as one estate to power the next generation of AI innovation. The Platform Reliability Engineering Manager leads the platform reliability team: the engineers who take on incidents escalated from the Global and Site Operation Centres and manage them through to resolution, and the Service Delivery Managers who run incident, change and problem management. Together they work with the operations centres and the specialist engineering teams to keep the estate within the service levels it is measured against. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, and strong technical competence is a core requirement of it. The role is expected to step into complex faults alongside the engineers, guide the diagnosis and recovery, and judge the technical quality of the team's work. The role manages the team's 24/7 on-call operation, its escalation paths to the specialist engineering teams, and its service level objectives . The team treats operations as a software problem, and the role leads the work of turning what the team learns into runbooks, guarded automation and permanent fixes. 

Key Responsibilities 

- Lead and manage the platform reliability team, including hiring, onboarding, performance, development and wellbeing across regions. 

- Manage the team's 24/7 on-call and incident command rosters, with cover across regions. 

- Serve on the incident command roster and act as incident commander for major incidents on rostered weeks, alongside the Service Delivery Managers. 

- Act as a senior technical escalation point for the team: join complex faults, guide diagnosis and recovery, and review the technical quality of the root cause analysis, runbooks and automation the team produces. 

- Manage the service level objectives for the services the team supports, and report service performance to leadership. 

- Work with the specialist engineering teams on clear escalation paths and response commitments. 

- Hold the team to its incident, change and problem management practice, and arbitrate when speed and process pull in different directions during an incident. 

- Drive the team's runbook and automation work, so that common faults are fixed once and handled by runbooks or automation, and engineers have time to build automation between on-call weeks. 

- Build a clear development path for the team's engineers into senior specialist roles, with mentoring and rotations agreed with the other engineering managers. 

- Work with the Service Delivery Managers and the engineering teams so that new and changed services are ready to support in production. 

- Turn production evidence, such as incident trends and repeat causes, into clear improvement requirements for the engineering teams, and follow them to closure. 

- Manage customer and leadership reporting on service health with the Service Delivery Managers, and attend customer service reviews where contractual response commitments are discussed. 

- Keep the team's ITSM, on-call and operational tooling fit for purpose. 

Skills & Experience 

- Solid hands-on engineering experience in infrastructure operations or site reliability engineering (Linux, networking, storage, Kubernetes or virtualisation), with the technical depth to lead a recovery, question a diagnosis and judge whether an escalation carries enough evidence. 

- Significant experience leading a 24/7 operations, SRE or production engineering team in a large-scale hosting, HPC, telecommunications, data centre or service provider environment, including running on-call rosters and incident response. 

- Working ability in scripting or programming (for example Python, Go or Bash) and in infrastructure as code, enough to review the team's automation and runbook code. 

- Working knowledge of site reliability engineering practice, including service level objectives , error budgets, toil reduction, runbook automation and production readiness, applied alongside formal incident, change and problem management. 

- Clear communication and sound judgement, including under pressure. 

- Experience with ITSM, on-call and observability tooling (for example Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, PagerDuty and Grafana). 

- Experience building and developing engineering teams, including hiring at pace, coaching early-career engineers, setting performance expectations and growing people into senior roles. 

Preferred Experience 

- Experience as a major incident commander, including communicating with stakeholders under pressure and leading post-incident reviews. 

- Experience operating GPU, HPC or AI infrastructure, including the failure modes of large-scale distributed training and inference. 

- Experience in a multi-tenant service provider, cloud or colocation environment with customer-facing reporting. 

- Experience working under contractual response commitments and compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2. 

- Experience setting up a new operations function or team, including rosters, escalation paths and standards. 

- Experience leading teams across time zones with follow-the-sun handovers. 

- ITIL or an equivalent service management qualification. 

Location & Reporting 

Location : Based in Australia or Singapore, with travel to Australian AI Factory sites as required. 

On-call : The function runs 24/7. First line monitoring and first response sit with the operations centre. This role serves on the incident command roster with the Service Delivery Managers and is the escalation point for the team outside hours. 

Reporting to :   Reports to the Head of AI FactoryOS Operations, working under broad direction with a high degree of autonomy. This role leads a team of 5 to 10 engineers and service delivery staff. 

Employment Basis 

Permanent full-time

Diversity 

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

description:
Are you someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, where you are given the autonomy and support to handle large amounts of responsibility? 

Are you looking for the opportunity to accelerate your sales career whilst also being surrounded by an exceptional entrepreneurial team with motivated and extremely driven people? 

The role

You’ll be responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of sponsors across our international conferences, building long-term relationships with senior decision-makers and driving sponsorship revenue.

This is a high-performance B2B sales role with a strong focus on sponsor retention, renewals and account growth, alongside identifying and closing new sponsorship opportunities.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for a commercially driven salesperson who enjoys building strong client relationships, growing accounts and consistently delivering against revenue targets.

You should have:

- 
At least 2 years of B2B sales experience.

- 
A proven track record of achieving or exceeding individual revenue targets.

- 
Experience managing client relationships, retaining customers and identifying opportunities to grow existing accounts.

- 
Confidence engaging, pitching and negotiating with senior decision-makers.

- 
Strong commercial instincts and the ability to identify new revenue opportunities.

- 
Ambition, resilience and ownership – you take responsibility for your portfolio, performance and results.

- 
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

This role might not be the right fit if...

- 
You prefer a role focused purely on relationship management, without responsibility for sales and revenue.

- 
You don't enjoy negotiating, closing deals and working towards commercial targets.

- 
You're not comfortable taking ownership of client relationships and proactively identifying opportunities to grow accounts.

- 
You're looking for a hybrid or remote position – our London team works together from the office five days a week.

What you’ll do

- 
Manage and retain sponsors: Build strong, long-term relationships with an existing portfolio of sponsors, driving renewals and repeat business.

- 
Grow existing accounts: Identify opportunities to upsell, cross-sell and increase sponsorship revenue within your portfolio.

- 
Drive new business: Identify, pitch and close new sponsorship opportunities to expand our client base.

- 
Own your revenue targets: Take responsibility for achieving ambitious individual sales and retention targets.

- 
Deliver exceptional partnerships: Work closely with our content and delivery teams to ensure sponsors receive a high-quality experience and see value in their partnerships.

What we offer

- 
Competitive salary and market-leading OTE.

- 
Significant ownership and responsibility from day one.

- 
The opportunity to work closely with our senior leadership team.

- 
International travel to our conferences.

- 
Training, coaching and ongoing development.

- 
Strong opportunities for internal progression as we continue to grow.

About us

Private Equity Insights is a global community connecting private equity professionals, investors and industry leaders through conferences, networking and industry insights. Our events bring together key decision-makers from across the private equity ecosystem to exchange ideas, build relationships and discover new opportunities.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media, a global B2B media and conferences group.

Start date: As soon as possible.

Monday–Friday, we work from our WeWork office in Victoria, London . Due to the collaborative nature of our work, we do not offer remote work.

You must have the right to work in the UK .

The role

You will play a key role across reporting and data analysis, from managing media content collection and coding to analysing, synthesising and presenting insights from large and complex data sets to support business decisions.

Duties and responsibilities

- Collaborate with the manager to prioritise tasks and manage workload effectively 

- Communicate clearly and professionally with colleagues and stakeholders 

- Work alongside other analysts and team leads to continue developing analytical and reporting skills 

Essential skills and experience 

- Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, analytics, or a related field 

- 5+ years’ experience in brand or consumer research, media analysis, or data/statistical analysis, ideally with exposure to social media research 

- Experience working with motorsports clients or a strong demonstrated interest in Formula 1 

- Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with excellent attention to detail 

- Comfortable working under pressure, both independently and as part of a team 

- Proficiency in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint for data analysis, reporting and presentations 

- Experience with data analysis and Boolean query logic 

- Familiarity with social research methods, unstructured data, Boolean searches, and tools such as Brandwatch or similar platforms is a strong advantage 

- Confident in interpreting data, identifying patterns and translating insights into clear, actionable narratives 

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including presenting insights to clients 

- Experience managing projects end to end in a collaborative environment 

- Experience working directly with clients 

- Interest in the communications and PR industry

title: Senior Mechatronics Engineer
description:
At Lightcast we are enabling scientists to gain a deeper understanding of human health and disease at the cellular level.

Our technology enables the direct, precise interrogation of single cell heterogeneity, interactions and functional behaviours with a level of flexibility and scale that was previously inaccessible. Across a broad range of disciplines from basic and translational research to drug discovery, we provide the freedom to accelerate discovery and apply novel biological insights. 

At Lightcast we are enabling scientists to gain a deeper understanding of human health and disease at the cellular level. Our technology enables the direct, precise interrogation of single cell heterogeneity, interactions and functional behaviours with a level of flexibility and scale that was previously inaccessible. Across a broad range of disciplines from basic and translational research to drug discovery, we provide the freedom to accelerate discovery and apply novel biological insights. 

The Lightcast platform is a benchtop laboratory instrument that uses microfluidics to allow precise and highly flexible control of thousands of aqueous microdroplets using software-generated light patterns. Control systems enable the integrated optical, mechanical, and fluidic sub-systems to perform complex workflows and assays used in the search for drug candidates. 

We are seeking a Senior Mechatronics Engineer to join our team and take a leading role in system design and engineering activities. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience delivering complex systems within a product business through a background in Electronics, Mechatronics or Mechanical Engineering, with an emphasis on designing and debugging systems at the intersection of hardware, firmware and control. You will have: 

- A strong technical track record in designing complex mechatronic products for function, reliability, manufacture, serviceability and cost 

- Hands-on and analytical approach to debugging complex systems, problem solving and resolution ownership 

- Full end-to-end development experience in mechatronic and electronic systems, having worked with development and manufacturing teams to engineer and improve product designs 

- Deep subject matter expertise and extensive experience in developing and delivering complex measurement systems and instrumentation 

Your responsibilities: 

- Working with our development, manufacturing and support teams to design, develop, deliver and maintain our platform and microfluidic products 

- A strong focus on delivering electro-mechanical system architecture designs 

- Taking a key position in system engineering activities, devising and delivering system tests, functional characterisation and verification tests 

- Technical review of projects, as a subject matter expert 

- Technical documentation of design outputs and rationale 

- Leadership in and advocacy for good product engineering practice, process development, definition and documentation

title: Staff AI Engineer, Developer Productivity
description:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office. 

About the role 

Oura is rebuilding how it builds software. Every engineer has agentic tooling, and our own pipeline already takes a well-formed ticket to a reviewed, tested commit stack. It runs interactively, headless, and on a cloud sandbox fleet, with its own evals and tracing. We are looking for engineers who use AI as a fundamental building block of both the products we ship and the way we build them.

That is a strong start on one stage of the lifecycle. The next step is the whole loop. As a Staff Engineer on the AI Transformation team, you will architect and own the system that turns agentic development from something power users do into the way hundreds of engineers across iOS, Android, backend and AI services ship every day. That means spec and intake, planning, implementation, review, testing, CI/CD, release, observability and incident follow-up, each with agents doing real work and humans keeping judgment where it matters.

This is a fast-moving, LLM-forward team. We prioritize rapid prototyping, iterative loops and AI-native development, with the speed of a startup and the reach of a product used by millions of members. You can work hybrid from our UK office in London. You will need the existing right to work in the UK; we are not able to sponsor a visa for this role. 

You will build the pipeline, measure it, and make it trustworthy enough that teams choose it. Success is measured in validated changes reaching members faster and safer: time to a trustworthy signal, escaped defects, cost per merged change, and how many squads run on the paved path because it is better, not because they were told to.

What you will do 

You don't need to do all of these on day one, but these are the kinds of problems you'll own:

- Set the technical direction for the agentic pipeline: Make our existing ticket-to-PR pipeline dependable infrastructure. Own its architecture, including agent orchestration, context management and tool calling, and improve its reliability, throughput, cost and developer experience across mobile, backend and web repositories. Run it unattended where the risk allows.

- Close the loop across the SDLC: Extend agentic workflows beyond code generation into spec quality checks, test generation, automated review, CI failure triage and repair, release verification, and post-deploy signals, so the system improves from what happens after merge.

- Prototype fast, then harden: Get a new workflow running in days, prove it on real tickets with real squads, and turn what holds up into production infrastructure.

- Run AI in production properly: Agents in production take more than an API call. Own the eval sets, LLM-as-a-judge grading, versioning, tracing and dashboards that tell us whether a workflow change made things better, including the hardest case: a change that passes CI and is still wrong. Track the numbers that matter (merge rate, rework, time-to-signal, cost per change, escaped defects) and make them visible to engineers and leadership.

- Make autonomy safe: Design sandboxing, permissions, human checkpoints and guardrails proportional to risk, with privacy by design as the default. Health data, security and infrastructure changes get stronger controls; low-risk, easily verified work runs hands-off.

- Lead AI-native engineering by example: Set the bar for AI-augmented engineering across the organization. Show in your own work what a pipeline-first engineer ships, and raise the craft of the engineers around you.

- Drive adoption with the teams: Embed with squads and their AI DRIs, find where the pipeline breaks on real work, fix the system rather than the single output, and turn what works into paved paths, skills, templates and docs other engineers can extend.

- Partner cross-functionally: Work with platform, developer productivity, security and privacy, AI infrastructure, mobile and backend squads, product and design, and engineering leadership to make trade-offs explicit and keep everyone moving on one system instead of five parallel ones.

Requirements 

We'd love to hear from you if you are:

- An experienced builder: Building and operating production systems that other engineers depend on, including developer tooling, internal platforms, or AI infrastructure at scale. We weigh demonstrated outcomes over years.

- Proven with agentic loops in production: You have built and operated agentic coding workflows or autonomous loops in a real engineering organization, beyond demos: background agents producing PRs, automated review, CI repair, test generation, or similar, with adoption and measured results.

- A whole-lifecycle thinker: You reason about specification, review, testing, CI/CD, release and operations as one system, and you know where the bottleneck moves when code generation gets cheap.

- A technical leader: You set direction across teams you don't manage, write the designs others build on, and are trusted with the hard calls on architecture and risk.

- Strong on fundamentals: mobile domain or backend APIs, concurrency, distributed systems, testing, debugging and reliability. You treat AI output as a draft and can show how you verify it.

- Technically versatile: Fluency in one domain of backend, iOS, or Android, with a stretch into others. You use the tools available to work across platforms and pick up new stacks quickly.

- Security and privacy conscious: You understand the responsibility of handling sensitive personal data and of giving agents access to real systems, and you design for both from the start.

- High agency: You thrive in ambiguity and shape the requirements yourself through experimentation.

- Collaborative and resilient: You bring teams along, take feedback from engineers who are skeptical, share credit, and keep going when experiments fail or the tooling changes under you. You communicate clearly with engineers, managers and non-engineering partners.

Would be a benefit 

You don't need all of these, but they're nice signals of fit:

- Experience with coding agents at depth: skills, MCP servers, hooks, sub-agent orchestration, headless runs.

- Built evaluation harnesses or benchmarks for coding agents, or LLM-as-judge grading tied to build and test outcomes.

- Experience with sandboxed execution at scale: ephemeral dev environments, VM or container fleets, macOS build infrastructure.

- Background in developer productivity measurement (DORA, SPACE, DX Core 4) and in turning metrics into decisions without turning them into targets.

- Shipped to mobile apps or other environments with slow, expensive feedback loops.

- Experience in digital health, wearables, MedTech, or other privacy-sensitive or regulated products.

- Contributions to open-source AI projects, or a portfolio of projects built on the latest agent capabilities.

- Mentored engineers or led an engineering community of practice.

What we offer 

At Oura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Oura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health and add to our benefits!
What we offer:

- Competitive salary

- An Oura Ring of your own + employee discounts for friends & family

- Flexible working hours

- Amazing culture of collaborative and passionate coworkers

If this sounds like the next step for you, please send us your application and CV as soon as possible.

title: Strategic Account Director
description:
About Payoneer 

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

Role Summary 

Location: London 

Hybrid 

Full-Time 

The Strategic Account Director is a new-business, quota-carrying hunter responsible for landing the largest, most complex enterprise logos in the market. You own the full pursuit — from target identification and outbound generation through multi-threaded, committee-driven sales cycles to signed, revenue-producing contracts. Your prospects run cross-border volume at scale, they are today served by incumbent banks or specialist fintechs, and displacing that incumbent is the job.

This is a role for someone who is energized by the chase: building conviction where none exists, getting into the CFO's and Treasurer's office cold, orchestrating a pursuit team through a long and technical evaluation, and closing seven-figure relationships. You set the bar for how strategic new business gets won at Payoneer.

This is a strategic role. It is deliberately seated centrally under Global Sales so the strategic-accounts motion can be built, proven, and standardized before ownership is distributed to the regions. You will work hand in hand with regional heads of sales for in-market coordination and, over time, help shape how this function scales across the field.

What You'll Do 

- Hunt and land net-new strategic accounts. Own a new-business quota. Identify, prioritize, and pursue the highest-value target accounts in your territory (typically $500K+/month cross-border volume, up to $10M+/month strategic targets) and convert them into signed, funded customers.

- Generate your own pipeline. Build top-of-funnel through disciplined, research-led outbound — direct executive outreach, referrals, partner and ecosystem channels, and events. Do not wait for leads; create them.

- Break into the buying committee cold. Get in front of and build conviction with CFOs, Treasurers, Finance Operations, and Compliance/Risk leaders at target accounts. Multi-thread deliberately so a deal never rests on a single contact.

- Displace the incumbent. Position Payoneer's speed, global coverage, economics, and platform breadth to unseat incumbent banks and specialist competitors. Run competitive displacement plays and build the business case that moves an entrenched buyer.

- Own complex, long-cycle deals end to end. Drive multi-stakeholder, technical, compliance-sensitive evaluations from first meeting to close. Own the mutual close plan, procurement, legal, and commercial negotiation.

- Sell the platform. Lead with value, not features. Land the entry wedge and architect the deal to open cross-border payments plus high-value services (Capital, Treasury/FX, Embedded/Platform Payments, Workforce/EOR, and emerging rails) — maximizing initial contract value and expansion potential.

- Qualify with discipline. Apply Payoneer's Sandler-based methodology — Up-Front Contracts, Pain Funnel, budget and decision qualification — to every pursuit so you invest team resources only in winnable, real deals.

- Orchestrate the pursuit team. Direct Solutions/Pre-Sales, Product Specialists, Compliance, and RevOps as a coordinated deal team through the sales cycle, and quarterback executive sponsorship where needed.

- Forecast honestly and close on time. Own a credible, hygienic pipeline and forecast in CRM. Drive deals to close dates and call your number straight.

- Set up the win for the long term. Land with a clean handoff to Customer Success and a clear expansion thesis, so every logo you close becomes a growth account.

Who You Are 

- 8+ years in enterprise B2B sales with a strong bias toward new business / new logo acquisition — not primarily account management or renewals.

- Consistent, demonstrable record of hitting or exceeding a new-business quota on complex, high-value deals.

- Proven ability to self-generate pipeline through outbound and to break into cold enterprise accounts at the executive level.

- Experience closing long-cycle, multi-stakeholder deals with meaningful (six- to seven-figure) contract value.

- Demonstrated success selling into and navigating executive buying committees — CFO, Treasury, Finance, Compliance/Risk.

- Strong commercial and negotiation skills, including running procurement, legal, and margin-protective deal structuring to close.

- Fluency operating in a matrix environment and orchestrating a cross-functional pursuit team.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred 

- Background in payments, fintech, banking, treasury, FX, or cross-border commerce.

- Track record of competitive displacement against incumbent banks or specialist fintechs.

- Experience selling a multi-product platform and structuring land-and-expand entry deals.

- Familiarity with a structured sales methodology (Payoneer uses Sandler).

- Exposure to compliance-sensitive, regulated sales environments (KYC/AML-aware selling).

- Strong CRM discipline and data-driven pipeline management (e.g., Salesforce).

Always striving for a higher standard than our last.

We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition. 

Our portfolio of leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition. 

From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG. 

With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for? 

Location: Icon 1, WA15 0AF 

Life at THG Beauty 

We know that beauty isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our portfolio of leading retailers and iconic beauty brands caters to everyone, everywhere, empowering customers all over the world to look and feel fantastic.

By combining our portfolio of owned brands inclusive of ESPA, Ameliorate and Christophe Robin, with a marketplace for over 1,300 third-party beauty brands through online retail sites LOOKFANTASTIC, Cult Beauty, and Dermstore, THG Beauty's ambition is to be the global digital partner of choice across the beauty industry, supporting the channel shift to online.

THG Beauty’s breadth of relationships is unique to the beauty market; it engages with brands as a retailer, a brand owner, and a product developer and manufacturer, making it the industry’s digital strategic leader.

Why be a Senior Analyst - Beauty Subscriptions at THG? 

As Senior Analyst in the Beauty Commercial team, you will own analytical work that helps THG’s Beauty division understand and improve its commercial performance. Working predominantly on subscriptions while also supporting trading, category, brand performance, you will build the analysis and insight that enables commercial teams to make better decisions.

As a Senior Analyst — Beauty Subscriptions , you will: 

Commercial Analytics 

- Own analytical projects across commercial performance of Subscriptions — trading, category and brand analytics, promotional effectiveness.

- Develop and maintain commercial KPI reporting

- Identify commercial opportunities and risks through data

Technical Delivery 

- Write and maintain SQL queries and analytical scripts

- Work with the Engineering team to understand the commercial data model

- Build dashboards and reports that communicate commercial performance clearly

Stakeholder Engagement 

- Present findings to the Commercial Lead and Beauty commercial stakeholders

- Manage ad hoc analytical requests from buying and trading teams

- Contribute to the broader commercial analytics team — sharing knowledge and maintaining high standards

What skills and experience do I need for this role? 

Essential 

- Experience (typically 3+ years) in commercial analytics, trading analytics, category management or similar

- Strong SQL skills

- Strong storytelling skills

- Proven ability to work independently and take end-to-end ownership

Desirable 

- Experience in beauty, lifestyle, fashion or e-commerce environments

- Exposure to subscription analytics - subscriber acquisition, churn, retention analysis, LTV

- Experience with Tableau, Looker or equivalent BI tooling

What Good Looks Like at This Level 

At THG, we expect everyone to demonstrate behaviours that match their level. Here is what that looks like in this role:

- Operates largely independently — owns complex commercial analytics end-to-end

- Deep expertise in commercial analytics — a reliable authority on trading and category performance

- Accountable for own targets — delivers high-quality analysis with minimal supervision

- Understands how commercial analytics connects to revenue, margin and trading outcomes

- Applies commercial judgement — thinks about business implications of the numbers

What’s in it for me? 

Career Development 

- Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&D team.

- Continued development through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider.

Enhanced Leave 

- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.

- Don’t want to work on your birthday? We don’t either! Enjoy your day off on us!

- Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service.

- Up to 10 days compassionate leave.

- Buy back up to 3 days each year.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, Engineering
description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The Role 

Legora has grown from 40 to more than 900 people in 18 months. During that time, we reached $100M ARR, tripled our valuation in five months, and continued expanding into new markets around the world.

Our Talent Acquisition function is now entering its next chapter. The processes, standards, and hiring approach that support our next phase of growth are being built today, which you’ll play a significant part in. You'll work closely with senior leaders from day one and play a key role in shaping how Legora hires and scales.

What you’ll do 

Product velocity depends on having the right engineering and technical talent in place, fast, and at a high bar. As a Talent Partner, you will own that directly. You are not a support function for the Engineering team. You bring genuine craft to how technical hiring gets done, and you're accountable for the quality and pace of the people who build Legora's product.

You will own end-to-end hiring across engineering in UK&I, working closely with senior leaders who are genuinely invested in recruiting, trusted to make high-impact decisions on hiring and team composition. Specifically, you will:

- Own full-cycle recruitment across UK&I, partnering closely with hiring managers to define role scope, success profiles, and hiring strategies aligned to business priorities.

- Help shape how Talent operates at Legora, contributing beyond hiring to process design, programs, tooling, and broader People initiatives.

- Build and nurture proactive talent pipelines for critical and future hiring needs, ensuring we stay ahead of demand rather than reacting to it.

- Run structured, data-informed hiring processes that balance quality, pace, and consistency while maintaining a high bar for talent.

- Deliver an exceptional candidate experience from first conversation through to offer, acting as a trusted and credible ambassador for Legora throughout.

What you bring 

You understand that hiring decisions are business decisions, and you hold yourself accountable to the same outcomes as the teams you hire for. You're hands-on, sharp, and trusted by senior leaders to shape teams that win. We're looking for:

- 5+ years in talent acquisition in a high-growth environment, startup, scaleup, or VC-backed company, with meaningful depth hiring engineering talent.

- A proven track record hiring high-performing engineering talent across the seniority levels that matter most at this stage of growth.

- The ability to hold a credible conversation with an engineering leader about what strong looks like. You understand the difference between a good CV and a good hire in technical roles, and you don't lower the bar when searches get hard.

- Experience partnering with senior stakeholders on hiring strategy and team build-out, not just executing briefs, but shaping them.

- The ability to run multiple complex searches without losing quality or pace.

- Comfortable in ambiguity with a bias toward action. You build a structure where none exists and move without waiting for perfect conditions.

- Collaborative but direct. You influence and challenge senior stakeholders when needed, and you drive decisions rather than defer them.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer 

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Commercial Director
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people , around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

The Opportunity 

This is one of the highest-leverage commercial roles in the business. As Commercial Director, you'll own the entire sales system at Relay — strategy, structure, process, and performance across all four of our segments: Pitstop/Field Sales, Enterprise, Large Parcel, and SME Parcel. You'll set the standards that let each segment lead build well, and you'll be personally accountable for the sum of the results.

Beyond the day-to-day, this role has a genuine builder's brief: creating the infrastructure and team capabilities that take Relay international over the next few years. If you want to shape how a fast-growing carrier goes to market at scale — and leave a lasting mark on how that machine works — this is the role.

What You'll Own 

Sales strategy and structure

- Design the shape of Relay's sales organisation across all four segments — how they relate, where they overlap, how resource is prioritised

- Define the sales motion for each segment: who it sells to, how, and through which channel

- Keep strategy current as the business and market evolve

Data and performance management

- Set the metrics that matter across pipeline, conversion, quota attainment, and productivity

- Build or oversee the dashboards that surface them

- Use data to make decisions on resourcing, territory design, and where to invest or pull back — instinct complements data here, it doesn't replace it

Process, structure, and scalability

- Own the sales playbook, forecasting cadence, deal review process, CRM hygiene standards, and comp and quota-setting principles

- Upskill and coach the existing team on pitch, process, and performance

- Build infrastructure that scales for the next three years, not just today's headcount

Team leadership and org design

- Lead the four segment sales leads (Pitstop/Field, Enterprise, Large Parcel, SME Parcel) and any central sales ops or enablement partners

- Decide what's centralised across functions versus what each segment lead owns locally

- Hire, develop, and coach those leads so each can build out their patch well

Global and remote team leadership

- Lead teams remotely across time zones and geographies as Relay expands into the Americas and Europe

- Proven capability to do this is a requirement — it can't be learned on the job here

Exec partnership and GTM planning

- Partner with the CCO and other function leads on revenue planning, headcount decisions, and commercial trade-offs

- Translate company strategy into a sequenced sales roadmap and GTM direction

- Push back clearly when targets or timelines aren't realistic

Who Will Thrive in This Role 

- Multi-motion sales leader. You've led more than one kind of sales motion — for example, high-volume SMB or transactional sales alongside enterprise or mid-market relationship-led sales. You're comfortable setting standards and managing performance across both. You've carried a number yourself and led others doing the same. This isn't a role for a single-lane specialist.

- Data-driven and structured operator. You define the metrics that matter, build or oversee the dashboards, and use data to make resourcing and process calls — not gut feel alone. You have a track record of introducing or significantly upgrading forecasting discipline, CRM hygiene, territory design, and comp structures in ways that improved consistency and scalability. You think in systems across a multi-year horizon, not just the next quarter.

- Global and remote team builder. You've led sales teams across multiple geographies or time zones, ideally including the US and Europe. You're comfortable setting standards, culture, and expectations remotely. Having helped take a company into a new country is a bonus; the core requirement is proven capability.

- People leader and org designer. You've led sales managers or leaders — not just individual contributors — and operated at least one layer removed from the front line. You have a track record of hiring and developing leaders beneath you, and making clear calls about what to centralise versus what to delegate.

- Exec partner. You've partnered directly with a CEO, founder, or C-suite on revenue planning and commercial trade-offs. You can push back on unrealistic targets while maintaining trust, and you can translate company strategy into an actionable, sequenced sales roadmap.

- Builder, not just operator. You've introduced new process, data infrastructure, or org structure in a previous role — not only operated within a system someone else built. This role is not about being a super-IC closer or a sector-pedigree hire; logistics experience is welcome but not a requirement or a filter.

Compensation, Benefits & Workplace 

- Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay’s success.

- Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you’d need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it.

- 25 days of holidays

- Enhanced parental leave.

- Hardware of your choice.

- Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more).

Who Thrives at Relay? 

- Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

- Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

- 1% Better Every Day : You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

- All In, All the Time : You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

- People-Powered Greatness : You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

- Grow the Whole Pie : You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

Volta has created a data collection and enrichment ecosystem for curated EP lab data which is fed into a physician validated, machine learning methodology to support complex AF solutions. Our newest technology, Volta AF-Xplorer II, is a data-driven AI decision support system that easily integrates into the standard physician workflow, providing a patient-tailored approach to complex AF and AT procedures. 

Our dynamic, innovative team is made up of 100+ collaborators in the EU and USA from a wide variety of backgrounds including engineers, business professionals and physicians, working together to develop AI solutions that help electrophysiologists help patients. 

Mission 

As Lead Data Science, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Volta's AI technology. You will lead a multidisciplinary Data Science team and contribute directly to the development of innovative machine learning solutions embedded in medical devices used daily in electrophysiology labs worldwide. 

Reporting to the VP Innovation, you will combine scientific expertise, technical leadership and people management to drive the development of next-generation AI algorithms while ensuring compliance with medical device quality and regulatory standards. 

Your Responsibilities 

Technical Leadership 

- 
Define and drive the Data Science roadmap in alignment with product and business priorities. 

- 
Lead the design, development and validation of state-of-the-art Machine Learning and Deep Learning algorithms. 

- 
Ensure scientific excellence and promote best practices in AI research and development. 

- 
Stay up to date with the latest advances in AI and identify opportunities to integrate new technologies into Volta's products. 

- 
Support the definition of data strategies and contribute to the continuous improvement of data collection pipelines. 

Team Leadership 

- 
Lead, mentor and grow a team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers and PhD researchers. 

- 
Foster a collaborative, innovative and high-performance culture. 

- 
Coach team members in both technical and professional development. 

- 
Coordinate priorities, allocate resources and ensure timely project delivery. 

Product Development 

- 
Collaborate closely with Software Engineering, Clinical, Regulatory and Product teams throughout the product lifecycle. 

- 
Contribute to software architecture discussions involving AI components. 

- 
Ensure production-ready, maintainable and high-quality code. 

- 
Participate in the preparation of technical documentation required for regulatory submissions. 

Scientific & External Collaboration 

- 
Represent Volta Medical at scientific conferences and technical events. 

- 
Contribute to publications, patents and collaborations with academic partners. 

- 
Communicate AI strategy and technical achievements to executive leadership, partners and investors. 

Your Profile 

Education & Experience 

- 
PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Physics or a related field. 

- 
10+ years of experience developing Machine Learning solutions in an industrial R&D environment. 

- 
5+ years of experience leading technical teams or mentoring Data Scientists. 

- 
Experience working in regulated environments (Medical Devices, Healthcare, Automotive, Aerospace or similar) is a strong plus. 

- 
Experience bringing AI models from research to production. 

Technical Skills 

- 
Strong expertise in Machine Learning, Deep Learning and statistical modeling. 

- 
Excellent understanding of model development, evaluation and deployment. 

- 
Strong programming skills in Python. 

- 
Experience with PyTorch, Scikit-learn, NumPy, Pandas and related ML libraries. 

- 
Familiarity with software engineering best practices (Git, testing, CI/CD, Docker). 

- 
Good knowledge of Linux environments. 

- 
Experience with cloud computing and MLOps is a plus. 

- 
Signal processing knowledge would be highly appreciated. 

Soft Skills 

- 
Strong leadership and coaching abilities. 

- 
Excellent communication and presentation skills. 

- 
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. 

- 
Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary and international environment. 

- 
Fluent English (spoken and written). 

Why join Volta Medical? 

Artificial Intelligence is transforming healthcare, and Volta Medical is at the forefront of this revolution. 

Joining us means contributing to cutting-edge medical technologies that directly improve patients' lives while working alongside internationally recognized experts in electrophysiology, AI and medical devices. 

At Volta, you will enjoy: 

- 
Meaningful work with real clinical impact. 

- 
An international, multidisciplinary and collaborative environment. 

- 
The opportunity to work on state-of-the-art AI applied to healthcare. 

- 
High autonomy and opportunities for professional growth. 

- 
Regular scientific exchanges and innovation-driven culture. 

- 
A workplace located in Marseille, offering an exceptional Mediterranean lifestyle. 

Volta Medical is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We encourage qualified individuals from all backgrounds to apply. If you are passionate about leveraging technology to make a positive impact on healthcare, we'd love to hear from you! 

Recruitment Process 

- Introductory & Culture Fit interview with our Senior VP People (45 min) 

- Technical & Leadership interview with our VP Innovation and our CTO (90min) 

- Interview with our CEO (60 min) 

- Coffee chat at our Marseille HQ (120 min) 
Spend time with the Data Science team, our Chief Clinical & Regulatory Officer, and our Co-founders (Julien/Clément). Discover our working environment, exchange ideas, and get a feel for what it's like to build AI solutions at Volta Medical.

title: Solution Architect / Solution Engineer
description:
Une nouvelle vision de la billetterie, au service du monde de la culture, des événements en direct, des loisirs et du sport. 

Bienvenue chez vivenu, leader mondial de la billetterie événementielle et l'une des entreprises technologiques à la croissance la plus rapide au monde. Nous avons révolutionné la billetterie de sites et producteurs comme les Grammy Awards, les Golden Globes, Fondation Louis Vuitton, Fondation du Patrimoine, Le Mans FC transformant les process de billetterie et les données collectées lors des parcours de vente en avantage stratégique. Bénéficiant d’investissements à hauteur de 65 millions de dollars, vivenu permet aux organisateurs d'événements de mettre en avant leur identité, de transformer l’expérience client, et d'intégrer la billetterie de manière transparente dans leur écosystème numérique.

vivenu s’engage auprès de ses partenaires pour assurer un support d’excellence et pour répondre de façon simple à leurs enjeux en créant des expériences exceptionnelles.

Rejoignez-nous et participez à la transformation des métiers de la billetterie et du marketing.

En tant que Solution Architect, vos responsabilités comprendront: 

- 
Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des intégrations sur mesure (connexions API, systèmes d’authentification SSO, ERP, etc.) en vous appuyant sur les puissants outils proposés par vivenu.

- 
Accompagner nos grands comptes dans la transformation de leurs boutiques en ligne existantes vers une architecture moderne, entièrement pilotée par nos API.

- 
Collaborer avec les différentes parties prenantes techniques de nos clients — directeurs techniques, équipes informatiques, agences web externes, etc. — afin de comprendre leurs besoins et de définir des plans d’action clairs et concrets.

- 
Veiller à ce que les attentes et les besoins des clients soient alignés avec les capacités de vivenu. Vous serez également le principal interlocuteur technique en interne pour traiter les problématiques complexes qui surviennent vente en période d’exploitation.

- 
Utiliser des scripts, l’IA et le prototypage pour tester rapidement différentes solutions . Vous transformerez ensuite les solutions éprouvées en guides et modèles d’intégration réutilisables à l’échelle de l’entreprise.

- 
Vous immerger dans des secteurs d’activité variés afin de relever de nouveaux défis techniques, de la conception initiale jusqu’à la mise en œuvre de la solution.

- 
Intervenir en tant qu’expert technique aux côtés de nos équipes commerciales, en les conseillant sur l’architecture des solutions, la faisabilité des intégrations, les délais et les ressources nécessaires.

- 
Rester impliqué tout au long de la phase de mise en œuvre afin de garantir que la solution livrée corresponde pleinement aux engagements pris auprès du client, tout en identifiant et en anticipant les éventuelles contraintes techniques en amont de la livraison.

Ce dont vous aurez besoin pour réussir dans ce rôle : 

- Au moins 5 ans d’expérience en tant que Solution Architect, Ingénieur ou dans un rôle technique similaire.

- Une expérience en développement ou une solide expertise technique, ainsi qu’une évolution assumée vers la relation client, les enjeux business et la conception de solutions.

- Une bonne compréhension du fonctionnement des applications web, des API REST, des webhooks, de la modélisation des données et des interactions entre les différents composants des écosystèmes logiciels modernes.

- Une capacité à lire et comprendre rapidement une documentation d’API, à écrire des scripts fonctionnels pour tester des solutions et à analyser ou déboguer du code généré par l’IA.

- Une réelle aisance dans les échanges avec des clients exigeants, ainsi que la capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément et à cadrer les attentes avec assurance.

- Un diplôme universitaire en informatique, en ingénierie ou dans un domaine scientifique ou technique connexe.

- Français & Anglais courant (niveau C1/C2) requis afin d’assurer une communication fluide et professionnelle avec nos clients et partenaires francophones.

Pourquoi rejoindre vivenu ? 

Pour être au cœur de l’exploitation de clients de renommée mondiale, en redéfinissant l’expérience utilisateur, grâce à une technologie de rupture. 

Une croissance durable 

Nous nous développons durablement en mettant l’accent sur la rentabilité et sommes soutenus par des fonds d’investissement de premier plan. Cela signifie un investissement continu dans nos employés, nos produits et notre vision à long terme. 

Une équipe engagée et mue par l’excellence 

Collaborez avec plus de 170 professionnels dévoués, comprenant des leaders venant de Google, Slack et Salesforce. Ensemble, nous façonnons l'avenir des technologies au service de la culture, des événements et des loisirs. 

Une emprise globale 

Nous sommes une équipe riche de sa diversité, axée sur le mérite — et répartie dans six bureaux dans le monde. Le talent et l'impact sont ce qui compte avant tout chez vivenu. 

Une croissance rapide 

Sifted classe vivenu parmi les scale-ups à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous sommes nourris par la volonté d’apprendre au quotidien et de nous améliorer continuement. 

Développer notre position de leaders et contribuer directement à la transformation de notre industrie 

Travaillez aux côtés de visionnaires — des fondateurs de Forbes 30 Under 30, aux lauréats du prix Executive of the Year. Chez vivenu, vous contribuerez à établir les nouvelles normes de l'industrie de la billetterie. 

Consultez la mission et les valeurs d'entreprise de vivenu ici . 

Chez vivenu, nous croyons que nos employés sont la clé de notre succès – et que l’esprit audacieux et la diversité de nos collaborateurs sont une richesse. Nous nous engageons à créer un cadre de travail qui offre à chaque collaborateur la possibilité de contribuer au succès de tous et de s'épanouir.

description:
Qui sommes-nous? 

Artefact est une nouvelle génération de société spécialisée dans le conseil en data et en marketing digital data-driven, dont les 2500 employés répartis sur 27 pays ont pour mission de transformer les données de nos clients en impact business tangible.

La société est née en France en 2014 et à connu une croissance forte, sur son métier historique, le conseil data marketing, mais aussi progressivement sur tous les cas d’usages data appliqués à l’entreprise. Artefact est soutenu par des investisseurs de premier plan (Cinven), européens, et qui visent à bâtir un leader mondial dans son secteur.

Le département Digital & Data Marketing d’Artefact 

Au sein des bureaux parisiens, l’équipe Digital & Data Marketing d’Artefact France est composée de 65 consultants dont le rôle est de construire les stratégies digital marketing les plus adaptées aux enjeux de nos clients, de les déployer et d’en mesurer la performance. 

En fonction des besoins des clients, nous aurons un rôle de conseil (stratégie, diagnostic de performance, modèle opérationnel, feuille de route, …) et/ou un rôle de mise en oeuvre avec les opérations de campagne et le déploiement de mesure du ROI (attribution/incrémentalité/MMM)

Ces projets s’appuient sur une expertise complète des canaux marketing et des plateformes en Paid Social, Paid Search, Programmatique, Retail media, mais aussi sur une expertise et en plein développement du GEO.

Missions 

Le/a consultant(e) marketing digital et data intervient dans le cadre de projets à forte valeur transformationnelle pour les équipes de nos clients. Épaulé de spécialistes du marketing digital et encadré par un manager/directeur, il est responsable de l’exécution des projets. Son objectif ultime est de concevoir des réponses marketing, média et data en réponse aux problématiques business de ses clients. Ses principales missions sont :

- Cadrage et orchestration des projets : interviews clients et partenaires, mise en place de workshops, préparation des uses cases

- Construction de roadmaps et d'analyses marketing : performance média, business, études concurrentielles, créatives, analyses d’audience

- Formulation et présentation de recommandations stratégiques pour le client, et mise en place avec les équipes clients ou internes (stratégie de mesure, campagne média, setup d’audience, audit de performance digitale, …)

Vous êtes ? 

- Issu(e) d’une formation école de commerce , vous bénéficiez d’un niveau bac +4/5 ou supérieur .

- Vous avez une première expérience en stage ou en alternance

- Vous possédez un fort intérêt pour le domaine du marketing digital

- Vous êtes curieux/se, proactif/ve, autonome, à l’écoute. Vous avez une prise de parole structurée et synthétique ainsi qu’une facilité à travailler en équipe. 

Pourquoi postuler ? 

- Développement professionnel : évaluation de performance semestrielle avec promotion potentielle ; trainings day mensuel ; développement des compétences via outils internes innovants.

- Développement personnel : collaborez avec les experts dans leur domaine, vous apprendrez des meilleurs ; feedbacks réguliers via parrain, managers, équipes et HRBP.

- Environnement de travail unique : équipe jeune (moyenne d'âge 28 ans); flexibilité télétravail ; séminaires d’équipe, entreprise ; localisation idéale dans Paris 9ème !

- Package salarial compétitif, en adéquation avec vos compétences et expériences.

Package de rémunération : 35k€ fixe à 40k€ fixe + 3k de variable 

Process de recrutement : 

- HR

- Entretien technique, un(e) Manager ou Directeur + Partner

Chez Artefact, nous recrutons nos collaborateurs uniquement en fonction de nos besoins et des qualités propres de chaque candidat. Nous assurons le développement de leurs compétences professionnelles et de leurs responsabilités sans discrimination d’aucune sorte, notamment de croyances, de genre, d’âge, de situation d'handicap, d’origine ethnique, d’orientation sexuelle, d’appartenance à une organisation politique, religieuse, syndicale ou à une minorité.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre :

Rémunération : 53 000€ à 63 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + jusqu’à 5 000€ de variable selon expérience et séniorité

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable. A la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.

Envie d'en savoir plus? Découvrez Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : https://www.artefact.com
