title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-Doctoral Position Ferroelectric-Based Ternary Computing: From Circuit Design to System-Level Integration Scientific Context
description:
Energy efficiency remains one of the foremost challenges in modern computing, spanning from edge IoT devices to high-performance data centers. Conventional CMOS-based architectures are approaching fundamental physical limits, while the "memory wall" — data transfers between processor and memory accounting for 70 to 90% of total system energy — continues to worsen with the ever-growing demands of data-intensive workloads such as deep neural networks and signal processing pipelines.

In-Memory Computing (IMC) has emerged as a disruptive paradigm to overcome these bottlenecks by embedding arithmetic operations directly within memory arrays, drastically reducing data movement. In this landscape, ferroelectric field-effect transistors (FeFETs) stand out as particularly compelling devices: fully compatible with standard CMOS fabrication processes, non-volatile, reconfigurable, and capable of storing intermediate polarization states — a property that naturally enables ternary logic within a single device.

The Post-Doctoral position will cover at least one of the following tasks:

- Design Standard Cell Technology Library based on FeFET devices developed at INL in order to be used with synthesis flow.

- Design and optimize ternary arithmetic units (multiply-accumulate units, adders, comparators) based on the FeFET ternary gate library developed within the project, targeting area, power, and timing closure under realistic process constraints.

- Develop and refine system-level models of FeFET-based ternary IMC units, abstracting circuit-level characterization results into architecture simulators, enabling design space exploration across the full heterogeneous system.

- Investigate hardware/software co-design strategies for mapping real-world applications — particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and signal processing kernels — onto the ternary IMC fabric, exploiting approximate computing techniques to trade precision for energy efficiency.

- Assess and benchmark the energy, performance, and accuracy trade-offs of ternary IMC against binary CMOS and binary NVM-based IMC reference implementations, using both synthetic benchmarks and real application workloads.

- Contribute to the definition of a design methodology for ternary ferroelectric circuits, including EDA tool flows, cell library characterization guidelines, and design rules, with the aim of enabling broader community adoption.

Required Candidate Profile 

The ideal candidate holds a PhD in microelectronics, computer architecture, or a closely related field , and demonstrates at least one of the following hard skills:

- Circuit and architecture design: Strong expertise in digital circuit design flows and computer architecture, with hands-on experience using industrial EDA tools (Cadence Virtuoso/Spectre, Synopsys). Experience with standard-cell library characterization is a plus.

- Emerging memory technologies: Solid knowledge of non-volatile memory devices, preferably including ferroelectric materials (FeFET, FeCap) or resistive memories (RRAM, PCM). Familiarity with compact modeling is an asset.

- System-level design and simulation: Experience with architecture-level simulation frameworks and hardware/software co-design methodologies. Knowledge of RISC-V ecosystems is a plus.

- Application domains: Familiarity with deep neural network inference workloads and/or digital signal processing pipelines, particularly in the context of approximate or energy-constrained computing.

- Programming: Proficiency in HDL (Verilog, VHDL, Verilog-A) and scripting languages (Python, Shell) for design automation and simulation.

Soft skills: Scientific leadership, ability to coordinate with PhD students and international partners, strong publication record consistent with career stage, and excellent written and oral communication in English.

Language: Fluent scientific English is mandatory. French is not required but is welcome.

title: Sales Engineering Manager Core - Mainland Europe
description:
Who we are 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 

About the role: 

Samsara is seeking an experienced and results-driven Sales Engineering Manager to focus on our Enterprise Core business in Mainland Europe (DACH & France). You should have experience managing and ideally growing a dispersed sales engineering team in a high-performance environment. Our Sales Engineering team is full of problem solvers and tinkerers who are not afraid to get their hands dirty (literally) and play a critical role in demonstrating and communicating the value of Samsara’s platform with our largest customers.

You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

- You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact. 

- You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value trust and human relationships built over time.

- You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and inspired to go farther than you have before. 

- You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will: 

- Manage individual and team performance ensuring our partnership with sales, product, support, and customer success teams are productive and efficient

- Work with Account Executives and Regional Sales Directors on account planning, strategy, and sales call activity

- Manage escalations (product issues, feature requests, etc.) in a pre-sales environment

- Participate in customer/prospect calls as a trusted advisor

- Partner with other Sales Engineering leaders to improve the overall Sales Engineering organization at Samsara

Minimum requirements for the role: 

- B.S. degree in Computer Science or similar

- 5+ years of sales engineering management experience

- Experience with Software Product sales: Infrastructure, SaaS

- Knowledge in one or more of these areas of expertise: IoT, Networking / Security, SaaS, Cloud Technologies, or Physical Security

- Strong technical and business acumen

- Excellent communication, customer service, and interpersonal skills 

- Ability to partner with a broad coalition of stakeholders, ranging from sales, product, marketing, support, and customer success, and from individual contributors to executive team members across the organization

- Demonstrated leadership, creativity, and problem-solving abilities

- Excellent presentation and organizational skills

- Ability to work in a fast-paced dynamic environment

- Ability to travel as needed

- Location: Remote, Germany or Remote, France 

- Language requirement: Fluent German or Fluent French 

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. 

Belonging at Samsara 

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity 

We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers 

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Your role 

As part of the French B2B team, you will be responsible for building and developing a strong and consistent experience for our healthcare professional network, particularly through congresses, events, training and other engagement opportunities.

You will work closely with the Regional Managers to identify opportunities and needs from the field and build an event strategy that maximizes the quality and impact of these interactions.

- Develop experience and engagement formats tailored to healthcare professionals, including trainings, workshops, webinars, breakfasts and regional events, based on needs identified in the field

- Maximize acquisition and conversion by working with Regional Managers to identify network activation needs, turning common needs into scalable initiatives and ensuring continuity between events, activation and follow-up

- Build a differentiated healthcare professional experience by designing the professional journey before, during and after each event to strengthen engagement with Sunday Natural

- Measure and optimize performance by analyzing attendance, lead quality, conversion, engagement and ROI to identify the highest-performing events and continuously improve our event strategy

Your profile

- You have a scientific background or degree in nutrition, biology, healthcare or a similar field and you have initial experience in marketing, event or project management 

- You have a strong ability to understand and communicate scientific topics in an accessible way and feel comfortable discussing scientific subjects with different stakeholders

- You are organized, autonomous and have strong project management and coordination skills , with the ability to manage multiple events and stakeholders simultaneously

- You have a business-oriented mindset and are able to assess the relevance of opportunities, prioritize investments and measure their impact 

- You enjoy working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Brand and Product teams and are able to turn field needs into relevant and scalable experiences 

- Fluency in French and English (written and spoken)

Please note: As English is our company language, internal communication and initial interviews will take place in English.

What we offer 

- An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients

- We offer 25 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year

- We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad

- You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas

- Inviting office spaces with access to plenty of organic teas and superfoods from around the world

- We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day

Apply with your CV and cover letter. 

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. title: Business Development Manager
description:
Grosse Veränderungen beginnen mit Menschen, die mehr erreichen wollen. 

Wie kommen Mitarbeitende zur Arbeit? Warum stehen Firmenautos ungenutzt herum, während Parkplätze knapp sind? Und wie wird nachhaltige Mobilität zur attraktivsten Wahl?

Bei Urban Connect machen wir aus diesen Herausforderungen konkrete Lösungen. Wir verbinden geteilte E-Bikes und Firmenautos, öffentliche Verkehrsmittel, Mobilitätsbudgets und digitales Parkplatzmanagement auf einer Plattform. Damit helfen wir Unternehmen, Kosten zu senken, Ressourcen besser zu nutzen und ihren Mitarbeitenden mehr Freiheit zu geben.

Unternehmen wie Roche, Google, SWISS und Lonza setzen bereits auf uns. Unser Anspruch geht weiter: Wir wollen die Art verändern, wie Unternehmen Mobilität organisieren. Und wir bieten das Betriebssystem, das dies möglich macht. 

Um diese Vision zu verwirklichen, suchen wir eine neugierige, unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Energie und gutes Urteilsvermögen mitbringt und mit uns das Unternehmen und die Mobilitätsbranche voranbringen möchte.

Deine Rolle: echte Verantwortung, spürbare Wirkung 

Du möchtest ein Unternehmen mitgestalten, anspruchsvolle Probleme lösen und sehen, was deine Arbeit bewirkt.

Als Business Development Manager arbeitest du eng mit unserem Sales- und Account-Management-Team sowie mit Product, Technology und Operations zusammen. Du entwickelst aus Kundenbedürfnissen, Daten und Marktkenntnissen überzeugende Mobilitätslösungen und konkrete Wachstumschancen.

Du verantwortest Projekte, bringst eigene Ideen ein und treibst ihre Umsetzung voran. Wir erwarten, dass du von Anfang an durchdachte Fragen stellst, erkennst, wo du einen Beitrag leisten kannst, und ins Handeln kommst. Dabei unterstützen dich Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die wollen, dass du erfolgreich bist.

Was du bei uns bewegst 

- Aus Daten Chancen machen: Du analysierst Nutzungs- und Marktdaten, etwa zur Auslastung von Fahrzeugen und Parkplätzen, und entwickelst daraus umsetzbare Empfehlungen für bessere betriebliche Mobilitätslösungen.

- Eigene Projekte vorantreiben: Du verantwortest Projekte wie Produktanalysen, die Bewertung von Geschäftschancen und die Entwicklung betrieblicher Mobilitätskonzepte. Du definierst nächste Schritte, bringst die richtigen Menschen zusammen und erzielst Ergebnisse.

- Das Produkt verstehen: Du entwickelst ein praxisnahes Verständnis unserer Plattform, der Kundeneinrichtung, Buchungen, Abrechnungen und Integrationen. So gestaltest du Lösungen mit, die wirtschaftlich und operativ funktionieren.

- Mit KI besser arbeiten: Du setzt KI-Tools gezielt ein, testest neue Anwendungen und verbesserst die Qualität und Effizienz unserer Recherchen, Analysen und Prozesse.

- Wachstum vorantreiben: Du identifizierst potenzielle Kunden, verstehst ihre Herausforderungen und arbeitest mit dem Commercial-Team daran, neue Kunden zu gewinnen und bestehende Partnerschaften auszubauen.

- Überzeugend argumentieren: Du erstellst klare Präsentationen, fundierte Business Cases, überzeugende Angebote und aussagekräftige Kundenreviews, die den Mehrwert unserer Lösungen sichtbar machen.

- Für Fortschritt sorgen: Du setzt klare Prioritäten und hältst Kundeninformationen und nächste Schritte in HubSpot aktuell. Du hältst Zusagen ein und gehst Hindernisse frühzeitig an.

- Teams verbinden: Du klärst technische und kommerzielle Fragen gemeinsam mit Product, Operations und Technology und leitest daraus verständliche Empfehlungen für Kunden und das Team ab.

- Den Status quo hinterfragen: Du erkennst Verbesserungspotenzial, hinterfragst Annahmen und machst aus kreativen Ideen konkrete Verbesserungen.

Was du mitbringst 

- Einen sehr guten akademischen Leistungsausweis, beispielsweise in Betriebswirtschaft, Volkswirtschaft, Data Science oder Ingenieurwissenschaften. Wissbegierde, Kreativität und nachweisbare Leistungen sind uns wichtiger als eine bestimmte Studienrichtung.

- Relevante praktische Erfahrung im Business Development, in der Beratung, in einem Technologieunternehmen oder im unternehmerischen Umfeld. Du kannst zeigen, welche Projekte du verantwortet und welche Ergebnisse du erzielt hast.

- Analytisches Denkvermögen, einen sicheren Umgang mit Excel und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Ideen und Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und klar und einfach zu erklären.

- Grosses Interesse an der Mobilität der nächsten Generation und an den Technologien, Geschäftsmodellen und Verhaltensänderungen, die die Branche prägen. Idealerweise kennst du die betriebliche Mobilitätslandschaft bereits und hast Ideen, wie sie sich verbessern lässt.

- Gutes Urteilsvermögen: Du kannst Zielkonflikte abwägen, Wesentliches priorisieren und vorankommen, ohne auf vollständige Informationen zu warten.

- Tatkraft und einen kreativen Zugang zur Problemlösung. Du entwickelst Vorschläge, überprüfst Annahmen und findest Wege, Dinge voranzubringen.

- Technologieaffinität und praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude oder Copilot sowie das Urteilsvermögen, deren Ergebnisse kritisch zu prüfen.

- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse. Französisch ist ein grosser Vorteil.

Besonders wichtig ist uns deine Haltung. 

Du bringst Begeisterung, Ehrgeiz und eine lösungsorientierte Einstellung mit. Du lernst schnell, stellst durchdachte Fragen und übernimmst Verantwortung für Ergebnisse. Du achtest auf Details und suchst laufend nach Wegen, gute Arbeit noch besser zu machen.

Du bist selbstbewusst genug, eine Idee zu hinterfragen, und offen genug, deine Meinung zu ändern. Die beste Lösung und der Erfolg des Teams sind dir wichtiger als persönliche Anerkennung. Du suchst Feedback, teilst dein Wissen und arbeitest gerne mit Menschen zusammen, die das genauso halten.

Du probierst Neues aus, gehst bewusst Risiken ein und lernst aus Fehlern. Wenn du auf ein Problem stösst, ergreifst du die Initiative und beziehst andere ein, wenn es sinnvoll ist.

Was dich bei uns erwartet 

Hohe Ansprüche – und kluge, herzliche Menschen, die dich fordern und weiterbringen. 
Wir arbeiten ambitioniert, geben direktes, konstruktives Feedback und unterstützen uns gegenseitig. Exzellenz zeigt sich bei uns im Alltag: in durchdachten Lösungen, sorgfältiger Umsetzung und dem Willen, kontinuierlich besser zu werden.

Eine Rolle, die das ganze Unternehmen verbindet. 
Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Vertrieb, Customer Success, Technologie und Operations und hilfst dabei, aus Ideen Lösungen zu machen, die Kunden schätzen.

Verantwortung und Raum für Initiative. 
Gute Ideen finden bei uns schnell Gehör. Du übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, Dinge voranzubringen, kannst auf die Unterstützung des Teams zählen und gestaltest mit, wie wir arbeiten.

Die Möglichkeit, mit Urban Connect zu wachsen. 
Mit deinen Ergebnissen und Fähigkeiten wächst auch dein Verantwortungsbereich. Du hast die Chance, die nächste Entwicklungsphase unseres Unternehmens mitzugestalten.

Dazu kommen:

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein schönes Büro in Zürich.

- Ein monatliches Mobilitätsbudget sowie Zugang zu unseren E-Bikes und geteilten E-Autos.

- Ein motiviertes Team, das gerne gemeinsam und überwiegend vor Ort arbeitet, Wissen teilt und Erfolge zusammen feiert.

Bereit, etwas zu bewegen? 

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar persönliche Zeilen: Warum Urban Connect? Was begeistert dich an der Zukunft der Mobilität? Und was hast du selbst in die Hand genommen und verbessert? 

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

title: Erfahrener SAP Personalberater / Headhunter - Schwerpunkt Kandidatengewinnung

- Gutes Verständnis der SAP-Welt: Du weisst, was einen FI/CO-Berater von einem EWM-Spezialisten unterscheidet

- Die richtige Mischung aus Ausstrahlung und Hartnäckigkeit, am Telefon wie im persönlichen Gespräch

- Eine Art, die Menschen öffnet: Kandidaten rufen dich zurück, weil sie gerne mit dir sprechen, und hören dir auch nach dem dritten Nein noch zu

- Humor, Drive und die Gelassenheit, auch in hektischen Phasen den richtigen Ton zu treffen

- Stilsicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch

Was wir dir bieten

- Ein kleines, eingespieltes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und echtem Teamspirit

- Ein super modernes Office in Zürich-Greencity mit neuester IT

Was du sonst noch wissen solltest 

Bei uns ist jeder Tag anders, die Pace ist hoch, und Kandidaten wie Unternehmen erwarten eine Beratung auf höchstem Niveau. Dafür brauchst du Fokus, Engagement und Freude an Menschen. Unser Antrieb: SAP-Spezialisten in die Rolle zu bringen, in der sie wirklich wachsen, und dabei selbst jeden Tag besser zu werden.

Auf deine Kontaktaufnahme freuen wir uns.

title: Research Engineer, Index Intelligence
description:
Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

We crawl the web continuously and cannot keep all of it, refresh all of it, or spend a GPU on all of it. Something has to decide which pages are worth indexing, which links are worth following, which pages say the same thing as pages we already have, what has gone stale, and what we should never have picked up. These decisions are worth more than most ranking work. The cheapest way to improve search is to stop indexing pages nobody should ever retrieve, and to start indexing the ones we are missing. Today they run on a mix of learned signals and thresholds someone picked.

We are looking for a research engineer to own the signals behind those decisions, and the decisions themselves.

Desired Experience 

- You are comfortable owning a problem with no ground truth, where the first job is defining what the right answer means

- Hands-on ML experience with classifiers, rankers and calibration, plus strong data instincts at web scale

- You think in end-to-end impact. A signal only counts if a decision changes and search gets better

- You like working across teams. Crawling, indexing and retrieval all consume what you build

- You care about the problem of finding high quality knowledge and recognize how important this is for the world

Example Projects 

- Make parsing work on the pages where it currently does not, and prove the improvement rather than assert it

- Teach a model to judge page quality, and get everyone to agree on what quality means well enough to supervise it

- Work on credibility and misinformation as a modelling problem: what a page claims, whether it is a reliable source of it, and whether it was written for a reader or for a crawler

- Decide whether two documents are semantically the same or genuinely different, so we can deduplicate the web without collapsing pages that a user would want to see separately

Search quality is bounded by what we understand about a page. Before anything can be retrieved, something has to work out what the page actually says. That means parsing it into the parts that are content and the parts that are furniture, classifying what kind of page it is and what it is about, telling whether the page is usable at all, extracting when it was published, judging how good it is and whether it can be trusted, and working out whether it says anything that a page we already have does not. All of this has to work on every page on the web, in every language, in every shape the web comes in.

Some of this is classic document understanding. Some of it is much more open. Credibility and misinformation, AI-generated and machine-spun content, and pages written to be found rather than read are all unsolved, and search results are only as trustworthy as our answers to them.

We are looking for a research engineer to work on this. There is a lot of room to do it well.

Desired Experience

- You are comfortable with problems where the ground truth does not exist yet and defining it is part of the job

- You care about the problem of finding high quality knowledge and recognize how important this is for the world

- Work on credibility and misinformation as a modelling problem: what a page claims, whether it is a reliable source of it, and whether it was written for a reader or for a crawler

title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine – Query Engine
description:
Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness.

In this role, you'll own the query engine that searches hundreds of billions of claims across a variety of retrieval backends, from a distributed graph database to vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial indexes.

This is greenfield work with a massive scope. No off-the-shelf system answers precise questions over hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims at agent speed, so you'll make foundational decisions, from storage layout and indexing across engines to the query language and the planner that routes work between them, that every query depends on.

What you'll do

- Own storage and indexing across backends: data layout, partitioning and indexes for graph, vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval, with bulk snapshot builds and live ingest that never take the system down.

- Decide how best to search: cost-based planning from cardinality estimates that chooses, for each question, which backends to use, in what order and how to join their results, executed as traversals, retrievals, filters and aggregations in one plan.

- Make it fast at scale: serve thousands of queries per second, profiling and cutting p50/p99 latency, memory and cost per query under high concurrent load, from on-disk layout to network fan-out.

- Keep answers consistent while the data converges: the graph is fed by live updates and bulk snapshots at once and is eventually consistent by design, so you'll own what a query may see while it converges: consistent snapshot promotion, ordered application of live updates and stable pagination across versions.

- Measure precision and completeness: end-to-end checks every deployment must pass, plus evals and metrics that show when a plan returns wrong results or misses ones it should have found.

What we're looking for

- You've worked deep inside a distributed database, query engine, search engine or storage system.

- Strong grasp of indexing, query planning and optimization, and storage formats.

- Solid grasp of distributed systems fundamentals: consensus, replication, sharding and fault tolerance.

- Strong in a systems language (Go, Rust or C++).

- You profile before you optimize, and you've shipped measured latency wins in production.

- You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale.

Bonus

- Graph databases, or combining vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval

- Compilers, query language design or cost-based optimizers

Example projects

- Build a system that retrieves and reasons over everything known about any company or person in the world, answering any factual question precisely and completely.

- Answer precise multi-hop questions over hundreds of billions of claims at thousands of QPS with interactive latency.

- Build a planner that picks the right mix of graph, vector, full-text and geospatial retrieval for any question, and proves it chose well.

- Make new knowledge queryable seconds after it's synthesized, without ever serving an inconsistent result.

title: Softwarearchitekt – HMI / Automatisierungstechnik (w/m/d)
description:
Du willst nicht einfach irgendeine Code‑Rolle übernehmen. Du willst die technische Gesamtarchitektur von industriellen Bedienoberflächen bestimmen.

Hier geht es nicht um reine UI‑Entwicklung. Hier geht es um Security‑by‑Design nach IEC 62443, Skalierbarkeit und die Integration in komplexe Anlagen.

5 Jahre HMI‑Erfahrung, 2 Jahre in einer architekturverantwortlichen Position und gelegentliche Kundenreisen sind für dich Normalität.

Unser Kunde

Der Kunde ist ein mittelständisches Unternehmen im Bereich Automatisierungstechnik und Maschinenbau, das weltweit industrielle Anlagen und Steuerungssysteme liefert. Mit mehreren Standorten in der Schweiz und Europa entwickelt das Unternehmen integrierte Softwarelösungen, darunter eine einheitliche HMI‑Plattform für seine Produkte. - Technische Führungsrolle mit direktem Einfluss auf die Produktarchitektur

- Vielfältige Industrieprojekte von Maschinen‑ bis Anlagenbau

- Entwurf, Dokumentation und Weiterentwicklung der HMI‑Softwarearchitektur (Schichten, Module, Schnittstellen)
- Auswahl und Bewertung von HMI‑Frameworks und Tools (Qt/QML, WinCC Unified, TIA Portal, Web‑HMI)
- Definition von Architekturprinzipien, Design‑Patterns (z. B. MVVM) und Coding‑Guidelines
- Aufbau wiederverwendbarer Komponentenbibliotheken und Bedienbausteine
- Konzeption der Anbindung an Steuerungen über OPC UA, Profinet, Modbus oder MQTT
- Umsetzung von Security‑by‑Design, Rollen‑ und Rechtekonzepten nach IEC 62443
- Fachliche Anleitung und Coaching des HMI‑Entwicklungsteams
- Mitgestaltung von CI/CD‑Pipelines, Versionsverwaltung und Release‑Prozessen
Dein Profil

- Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der HMI‑ oder Embedded‑Softwareentwicklung
- Davon mindestens 2 Jahre in einer architekturverantwortlichen oder leitenden technischen Rolle
- Praktische Erfahrung mit C++ (modern), Qt, QML, WinCC Unified und TypeScript/JavaScript
- Sicherer Umgang mit OPC UA, MQTT, Profinet und feldbasierten Kommunikationsprotokollen
- Kenntnisse in Security‑Standards IEC 62443 und Erfahrung in deren Umsetzung
- Verhandlungssichere Deutsch‑ und Englischkenntnisse (C2)
Was hier nicht funktioniert

- Job‑Hopper – häufige Wechsel sind ein Dealbreaker
- Nur Front‑End‑Entwickler ohne Embedded‑Erfahrung – fehlt das Systemverständnis
- Kein Interesse an Security – du vernachlässigst IEC 62443‑Anforderungen
- Unflexibel – keine Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Kundenreisen
- Mangelnde Kommunikationsfähigkeit – du kannst technische Konzepte nicht verständlich vermitteln
Deine Benefits

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

- Du bestimmst die technische Zukunft der HMI‑Plattform eines Innovationsführers
- Du kombinierst tiefes Fachwissen mit strategischer Gestaltungskraft
- Du arbeitest in einem internationalen Umfeld mit Projekten von Bern bis in die ganze Schweiz
Viel Verantwortung, viel Gestaltung, wenig Ausreden. Für manche ein Albtraum. Für die Richtigen: genau das, was sie suchen.

Bereit?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt als Softwarearchitekt – HMI / Automatisierungstechnik (w/m/d).

Egal ob dein Titel Lead HMI Engineer, HMI Architect, Embedded UI Architect, Senior HMI Developer heißt: Entscheidend ist nicht der Titel. Entscheidend ist, ob du mindestens fünf Jahre HMI‑Erfahrung mitbringst und Sicherheit nach IEC 62443 in der Praxis umsetzen kannst.

title: Stage consultancy in het publieke domein
description:
24-38,75 uur per week | Utrecht | Hybride | Transformatie van Openbaar Bestuur | €600 | WO 

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot 

Berenschot is op zoek naar een masterstudent die stage wil lopen bij de adviesgroep Openbaar Bestuur. Heb jij affiniteit met bestuurlijke vraagstukken en interesse in het adviesvak? Vind jij het leuk om mee te draaien in adviesprojecten en heb je een sterk organisatorisch vermogen? Dan is deze stage iets voor jou! Werken voor Berenschot betekent werken aan maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Wij helpen verschillende organisaties in het publieke domein met allerlei uitdagingen. Ook organiseren we regelmatig bijeenkomsten, kennissessies en meetings met een maatschappelijk tintje. Je leert veel over het dynamische speelveld waarin wij werken, doordat je direct meewerkt aan uitdagende opdrachten en een actieve bijdrage levert aan de genoemde activiteiten. Je komt terecht in een ambitieus en gedreven team met veel ervaring in het publieke domein. Dit team focust zich voornamelijk op strategie, samenwerking en organisatieontwikkeling in het openbaar bestuur. Zie je jezelf na de stage in het adviesvak? Dan zijn er mogelijkheden om te solliciteren op een traineeship. 

Dit ga je doen 

Overheden staan voor uiteenlopende uitdagingen, van de energietransitie tot het verbeteren van de woningmarkt. Berenschot helpt ministeries, provincies, gemeenten en waterschappen om deze uitdagingen aan te gaan. Als stagiair(e) draag je bij door: 

- Mee te draaien met de Gideonsbende, waar je helpt bij de organisatie van leergangen en inspiratiesessies. 

- Actief mee te werken aan opdrachten, zodat je het speelveld en de spelers binnen het publieke domein leert kennen. 

- Samen met collega-consultants naar klanten te gaan en te leren van hun vraagstukken. 

- Onderzoek te doen en vraagstukken te analyseren, ter ondersteuning van het advieswerk. 

- Leermodules en events te organiseren, waarbij je contact onderhoudt met sprekers en locaties. 

Tijdens je stage word je intensief begeleid door een adviseur, zodat je je professionele vaardigheden ontwikkelt en leert hoe concepten en theorieën toegepast worden in de praktijk. Ook het uitvoeren van een afstudeeronderzoek is mogelijk. In dat geval bespreken we graag met elkaar hoe we het afstudeeronderzoek zo goed mogelijk kunnen laten aansluiten op ons advieswerk en vice versa. 

Quote 

"De kracht van samenwerking in het publieke domein inspireert mij dagelijks om innovatieve en waardevolle oplossingen te bieden voor maatschappelijke uitdagingen." – Senior consultant publieke sector 

Hier kom je terecht 

Berenschot is een onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid vanaf dag één krijg je de kans om te ontdekken waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen. 

Dit zijn je directe collega's 

Je gaat werken binnen de adviesgroep Openbaar Bestuur, specifiek in het team Strategie, Samenwerking en Organisatieontwikkeling. Dit team bestaat uit twintig gedreven adviseurs met specialisaties in bestuurskunde, rechten, technologie en innovatie. We houden ontwikkelingen in de maatschappij, politiek en economie nauwlettend in de gaten en schakelen direct in bij grote opgaven. We werken in wisselende teams, zodat altijd de juiste expertise beschikbaar is. Naast hard werken, wordt er veel gelachen. 

Binnen Berenschot hebben we een Gideonsbende: vrije denkers en jonge mensen die evenementen organiseren die normaal niet tot stand komen. Denk aan leergangen voor bestuurders en topambtenaren met de titel ‘Taaie thema’s en duivelse dilemma’s in het openbaar bestuur’. Daarnaast organiseren we onze eigen schaduwverkiezingen (inclusief uitslagenevenement) parallel aan die van de Tweede Kamer, provincies/Waterschappen of gemeenteraden. Verder organiseren wij allerlei andere bijeenkomsten, zoals een adviesmarathon voor het oplossen van vraagstukken van kleinere maatschappelijke organisaties. 

Dit neem je mee 

- Je volgt een master (technische) bestuurskunde, management van de publieke sector, politicologie, bedrijfskunde, economie, sociologie of een vergelijkbare richting. Staat jouw studierichting hier niet bij, maar heb je wel affiniteit met het openbaar bestuur en een maatschappelijke drive? Solliciteer dan ook zeker! 

- Je hebt een sterk conceptueel en analytisch vermogen, bent nieuwsgierig en staat stevig in je schoenen. 

- Je bent creatief, goed in organiseren en werkt graag in teamverband. 

- Je bent gedurende je stage ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling. 

Dit bieden we jou 

Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke werkomgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners, wat ons de vrijheid geeft om te ondernemen en ons in te zetten voor maatschappelijke thema’s. We hebben een informele cultuur, korte communicatielijnen en volop kansen voor persoonlijke en professionele groei. Daarnaast bieden we: 

- Een stagevergoeding van € 600,- bruto per maand op basis van fulltime. 

- Een laptop. 

- Persoonlijke begeleiding gericht op jouw professionele en vakinhoudelijke ontwikkeling. 

- Een inspirerende werkplek in Utrecht en hybride werkmogelijkheden. 

- Veel stagiairs zijn na hun stage aan een traineeship bij Berenschot begonnen – bij goed presteren biedt deze stage uitstekende kansen voor jouw carrière. 

Stageplusprogramma 

Naast je stage kun je deelnemen aan het Stageplusprogramma van Berenschot: een opleidingsprogramma van circa 3,5 maand dat trainingen biedt op het gebied van advieskennis, -vaardigheden en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Dit vraagt gemiddeld één dagdeel per twee weken. Via deze link lees je meer over het programma . Alles over ons stageplusprogramma | Berenschot 

Solliciteer meteen 

Wil jij ook een trotse Berenschotter worden? Solliciteer direct! Stuur je cv en motivatie naar Mariëlle Boer. Vragen? Neem contact op met Mariëlle Boer via WhatsApp (06 10487159) of per mail ( ). 

Heb je inhoudelijke vragen over deze vacature? Collega Florian Rosenm ö ller beantwoordt al jouw vragen met plezier. Bel of WhatsApp Florian Rosenm ö ller via (0 6 30364562) . of stuur een e-mail naar Vergeet in je motivatie niet te vermelden voor welke periode je een stage zoekt en hoeveel uur per week je beschikbaar bent . Dan kunnen we je sollicitatie zo goed mogelijk beoordelen. 

Zo ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit 

Na je sollicitatie ontvang je binnen een werkweek een reactie. Bij een positieve uitkomst nodigen we je uit voor een kennismaking collega-adviseurs en je toekomstige manager. Sluit dat goed aan? Dan krijg je snel een concreet aanbod en verwelkomen we je graag in ons team als nieuwe Berenschotter! 

Vooruitgang begint bij jou – waar wacht je nog op?

title: IAM Software Engineer
description:
As an IAM Software Engineer , you’ll focus on Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions. Your work combines technical analysis, platform configuration, low-code implementation, integration, testing, and troubleshooting, with custom coding where needed. You’ll work closely with engineers, architects, consultants, and customer teams to deliver secure, reliable solutions. 

You’ll join an engineering delivery team of around 8–12 people, working across customer assignments in two-week sprints, often with a specific sprint focus. Our ‘you build it, you run it’ approach combines implementation, ongoing improvement, and troubleshooting after delivery, supported by senior engineers in your own and neighbouring teams doing similar work.

- Translate customer needs into technical designs and engineering tasks , working with architects, security engineers, and customer stakeholders to meet security, compliance, scalability, and maintainability requirements. 

- Troubleshoot complex IAM issues , identify root causes, and implement lasting improvements that reduce recurrence and security risk. 

- Improve automation and delivery practices , using PowerShell and CI/CD where appropriate to make implementation and ongoing changes more reliable. 

- Share knowledge and support junior engineers through mentoring, design sessions, and reviews of configurations, integrations, and code. 

The impact you’ll have 

Your engineering work will help leading organizations manage access confidently, protect sensitive data, and comply with evolving regulations. By building reliable IAM solutions and improving delivery practices, you’ll contribute to technical strategy and help the team deliver more effectively—strengthening client security and trust in the digital landscape. 

What we can offer you 

Autonomy in your work and support for your career development. 

- Permanent, full-time contract (40 hours per week)

- Work outside normal hours is rare (currently fewer than five occasions per year) and always discussed in advance. 

- Typically, 5–15 learning days per year for your development, including certifications and events. Training and associated costs are agreed individually rather than through a fixed training budget. 

- 30 days of annual leave: 25 flexible days and 5 fixed company days. 

- Variable team bonus and annual profit distribution 

- Mobility budget or company lease car 

- Private pension scheme 

- Home office setup budget and monthly remote work allowance 

- Regular team and company social events 

What you’ll bring to the team 

Core experience and skills 

- 3–6 years in software or platform engineering, including at least one year designing and implementing IGA solutions such as Omada Identity or Microsoft Entra ID Governance. 

- Experience in solution design, configuration, API integration, testing, and deployment, using Git and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps). 

- Practical C# and SQL experience to troubleshoot and extend IAM solutions where needed. 

- Strong analytical, design, and problem-solving skills, with a deep understanding of software security and the ability to turn security and compliance requirements into practical solutions. 

- A relevant bachelor’s degree (e.g., computer science or information security), or equivalent experience. 

How you work 

- Strong collaboration, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with a structured, proactive approach and the ability to drive work independently. 

Practical requirements 

- English at C1 and Dutch at B2 or higher, written and spoken. 

- Client-site travel is within the Netherlands, with current major clients in the Randstad. You’re able and willing to travel to those sites and our Waardenburg office; no driver’s license is required. 

- Currently residing in the Netherlands and eligible to work here. 

Nice to have 

- Azure experience. 

- AI-assisted tools for analysis, configuration, testing, documentation, or coding. 

- Relevant certifications, e.g., Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate, Omada Certified Engineer, or CISSP.

SITS | Traxion specializes in Identity & Access Management, with 24 years of consulting experience and a team of 120 specialists. We work with organizations across sectors, including Schiphol Group, dsm-firmenich, Gemeente Rotterdam, Belastingdienst, E.ON, and Ayvens.

title: Enterprise Account Executive III - Netherlands
description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. 

We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to build Camunda’s Dutch Government market. This is a territory-building role for a disciplined, consultative seller who can create demand, shape strategic opportunities, and guide complex buying groups through to executive-level decisions. You will own the full sales cycle across a focused set of government accounts, from account strategy and first conversation through business case, procurement, negotiation, close, and expansion.

You will combine commercial ownership with public-sector credibility. The successful candidate will be comfortable engaging senior civil servants, CIO and transformation leaders, procurement, security, architecture, and business stakeholders. You will translate government priorities into a compelling value case for process orchestration, automation, and agentic workflows, while navigating formal procurement processes and the governance expectations of public-sector customers.

What you will own

- Own the Dutch Government territory and create a clear account and coverage strategy across priority national and public-sector organizations.

- Build and maintain a healthy, self-generated pipeline, targeting at least 2.5x pipeline coverage through focused outbound activity, executive engagement, partner collaboration, and market development.

- Develop relationships across complex buying groups, including CIOs, CTOs, transformation leaders, enterprise architects, process owners, procurement, security, legal, and executive sponsors.

- Lead the full enterprise sales cycle: discovery, qualification, value engineering, technical evaluation, business case, procurement, commercial negotiation, and close.

- Apply MEDDICC consistently to create deal clarity, strengthen qualification, identify gaps early, and improve forecast reliability.

- Build business cases connected to public-sector outcomes such as service quality, operational efficiency, transparency, resilience, compliance, and cost control.

- Coordinate account teams across Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Professional Services, Marketing, Product, Legal, Finance, and leadership.

- Developa partner-first motion with relevant global system integrators, regional partners, and public-sector specialists.

- Expand successful customer relationships by identifying adjacent processes, departments, agencies, and use cases after the initial land.

- Maintain accurate account, contact, opportunity, and forecast data in Salesforce as the single source of truth.

- Share market intelligence on government priorities, procurement dynamics, competitors, partners, and customer needs to improve Camunda’s Dutch public-sector go-to-market strategy.

What success looks like

First 30 days 

- Build a working understanding of Camunda’s platform, value proposition, sales methodology, customer evidence, pricing approach, and public-sector references.

- Align with internal stakeholders on territory priorities, account ownership, partner coverage, and available sales resources.

- Produce an initial account segmentation and stakeholder-mapping plan for the Dutch Government territory.

- Establish a repeatable operating cadence for pipeline creation, deal inspection, forecasting, and cross-functional account-team collaboration.

First 90 days 

- Complete strategic account plans for the highest-priority government accounts, including business priorities, buying groups, whitespace, partners, competition, and next actions.

- Create qualified pipeline through a balanced mix of net-new opportunities, partner-sourced activity, executive introductions, and expansion plays.

- Develop a strong network of relevant government and ecosystem stakeholders, with clear relationship and meeting objectives.

- Demonstrate consistent MEDDICC qualification and accurate Salesforce hygiene across active opportunities.

- Identify the most relevant public-sector use cases and value narratives for Camunda’s Dutch market development.

First 180 days and beyond 

- Establish a credible, repeatable pipeline engine for the Dutch Government market.

- Progress strategic opportunities through well-defined qualification, value validation, technical evaluation, procurement, and commercial stages.

- Win new government logos and create expansion paths into additional departments, agencies, or processes.

- Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors and public-sector ecosystem partners.

- Contribute actionable market insight that improves Camunda’s positioning, messaging, partner strategy, and investment decisions in the Netherlands.

- Deliver against quota while protecting long-term customer value, adoption, and expansion potential.

What you will bring

Must-haves 

- 5+ years of success in a quota-carrying enterprise software or SaaS Account Executive role, owning complex deals end to end.

- Demonstrated experience selling into the Dutch Government or another highly regulated public-sector environment, with a clear understanding of formal procurement, security, legal, and governance requirements.

- A track record of creating pipeline through proactive outbound activity and converting multi-stakeholder opportunities into material, preferably multi-year, contracts.

- Strong command of MEDDICC or a comparable enterprise sales methodology, with the discipline to qualify rigorously, manage mutual action plans, and forecast accurately.

- Executive presence and communication skills in Dutch and English, with the ability to connect operational problems to strategic, financial, and citizen-impact outcomes.

- A collaborative, customer-focused, and resilient approach aligned with Camunda’s FAITH values and global-first way of working.

Nice-to-haves 

- Experience selling process automation, workflow, orchestration, integration, business transformation, or adjacent enterprise technology.

- Existing relationships across Dutch ministries, executive agencies, municipalities, provinces, public-service organizations, or government-focused partners.

- Experience working with global system integrators, regional implementation partners, or public-sector framework agreements.

- Familiarity with Camunda, BPMN, DMN, process orchestration, cloud platforms, or agentic automation.

- Experience creating quantified value cases for service modernization, compliance, operational resilience, or cost reduction.

Why this role matters now

Dutch public-sector organizations are under pressure to modernize services, improve efficiency, operate securely, and coordinate increasingly complex technology and regulatory environments. Process orchestration gives them a way to make that complexity visible and manageable while connecting people, systems, and automation.

This role is an opportunity to shape a market rather than inherit a mature patch. You will have the ownership and visibility to define where Camunda can create the greatest public value, build the ecosystem around those opportunities, and establish a durable foundation for growth in the Netherlands.

You will join a global, distributed team that values initiative, transparency, customer impact, and practical collaboration. The role offers the chance to work at the intersection of public-sector transformation, enterprise technology, process orchestration, and the next generation of agentic automation.

description:
Ben jij analytisch sterk en wil je impact maken binnen een internationale organisatie? Dan moeten we jou hebben! 

Jouw rol 
Bij Heras krijg je de kans om als stagiair bij te dragen aan het Nimble-programma: een strategisch verbeterprogramma gericht op het vereenvoudigen en automatiseren van bedrijfsprocessen. Als stagiair werk je aan het verbeteren van processen binnen domeinen zoals sales, projecten in nieuwbouw en finance. Je analyseert hoe processen vandaag werken en vertaalt dit naar slimme oplossingen met behulp van Power BI en Power Automate. Je levert concrete procesverbeteringen, procesbeschrijvingen, automatiseringen en Power BI dashboards voor operationele en financiële sturing aan alsmede werkende Power Automate flows. Tenslotte lever je een meetbare bijdrage aan efficiëntie (bijv. tijdbesparing of minder fouten).

Jouw werkzaamheden 

- In kaart brengen van huidige processen en knelpunten.

- Automatiseren van handmatige processen met Power Automate.

- Ontwikkelen van dashboards en rapportages in Power BI (zonder daadwerkelijk programmeren).

- Verbeteren van datakwaliteit en inzicht in KPI’s.

- Samenwerken met business teams en IT-specialisten.

Benieuwd naar de ervaringen van een stagiair bij Heras? De eerste indruk: dynamisch in plaats van stoffig - Heras Nederland 

Wie zijn wij? 
Heras is een vooraanstaand Europese totaalleverancier van permanente perimeter protection oplossingen. Wij opereren vanuit meer dan 24 landen en hebben meer dan 1100 hoogopgeleide experts in dienst. Opgericht in 1952, vervult en overtreft Heras de beveiligingsbehoeften van klanten in heel Europa. Het is dankzij deze staat van dienst, samen met het blijvend groeiende vakmanschap van onze medewerkers, dat wij ons experts in perimeter protection kunnen noemen. 

Onze cultuur, werksfeer & waarden 
Wij hebben binnen Heras een informele, open en toegankelijke cultuur. We zijn trots op ons werk, producten en dienstverlening. We hebben een no-nonsense mentaliteit, tonen ondernemerschap, zijn energiek en werken allemaal gedisciplineerd volgens de drie kernwaarden; betrokkenheid, betrouwbaarheid en deskundigheid. Heras is gewaardeerd op een Ecovadis Zilveren Ster en dat plaatst ons bij de duurzaamste 15% bedrijven van Nederland. Onze doelstelling is streven naar Goud in de komende jaren en volledig CO2 neutraal zijn in 2050. Wil je hier meer over weten? https://www.heras.nl/over-heras/kwaliteit-en-veiligheid/

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Looking for a new adventure? You’ve come to the right place. 

We're an Amsterdam-based team of 95+ (and counting) with 20+ nationalities amongst us! A varied bunch of “Citizens of The World” with a wide range of skills and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our travel belts. And we have something important in common (other than our very well-worn passports): We want to change the way people travel. 

And that's exactly what we're doing, with the travel app to plan, track, and relive trips in a smart and beautiful way.

Polarsteps has over 22 million users already, but, for us, this is just the beginning. We have big plans for the future, and so we need even more talented and enthusiastic people to help us on our journey.

Want to know more about us? Here you go.

Your expedition: Product Design at Polarsteps 

We’re a small team, doing big things. 

At Polarsteps, everyone, our CEO, support specialists, developers, product managers, and more, cares about design. It’s part of our DNA and embedded in every discussion. This gives you, as a Product Designer, the opportunity to make full use of your skills and craft your designs to perfection.

Our relatively small team consists of like-minded design enthusiasts who can geek out over the nitty-gritty details–corner radius, shadows, colors–for hours. We are big on collaboration, challenge each other, and make meetings as fun as they are productive. We dream big, move fast and welcome ideas, from anyone.

Your itinerary 

What your journey at Polarsteps will look like on a typical day. 

Lead the design of our “Digital Relive” team, focused on one of travel’s most meaningful moments: looking back on it all. We’re building new ways for travelers to relive their trips, both on the road and once they’re home, from in-app experiences to shareable formats like Trip Reels and Map Video.

You will:

- Oversee the full product lifecycle of concepting, prototyping, and iterating based on design reviews, user testing, feedback, and data like share rates.

- Implement and maintain the existing design & brand guidelines while also creating and adapting guidelines to elevate the overall Polarsteps design, including the look and feel of our shareable formats.

- Own your product pillar, while maintaining close collaboration with the other pillars. Proactively ask for and share feedback to keep our product smooth, consistent, and awesome.

- Collaborate with Product Managers and Engineers to ensure your designs are well-specced and built as intended, down to the last pixel and color.

The equipment in your backpack 

What we’re hoping you’ll bring with you. 

✅ Being a seasoned professional with 5+ years of experience designing lovable products;
✅ A strong portfolio, with shipped designs, that demonstrates end-to-end (hybrid UX and UI) product design, with a strong visual eye for typography, layout, and storytelling;
✅ Experience designing for native mobile apps;
✅ Hands-on experience with user insights and testing, like A/B tests and usability studies;
✅ A proactive mindset, with a passion for getting involved in the entire product development process, thinking and problem-solving like a product manager;
✅ Fluency in modern design tools such as Figma/Sketch or similar;
✅ Experience in prototyping tools such as Principle/Protopie or similar;
✅ Skills in partnering with engineers to drive QA processes and uphold implementation fidelity;
✅ A genuine interest in motion, video, and visual storytelling, and the curiosity to grow in it. You don’t need to be an After Effects pro, but you get excited about how things move and feel.

Bonus points if you have: 

✨ Hands-on experience with motion or video tools (like After Effects or Premiere), or with designing for social platforms like Instagram and TikTok. Not a dealbreaker if that’s not your world yet; it’s something we’re happy to grow together.

1st class extras 

Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet. 

- Salary range: Between EUR 75.000 - 90.000 gross per year incl 8% holiday allowance (based on 40 hours/week). Where you land in the range depends on your experience and skills, assessed during the interview process.

- Equity: You'll be able to participate in our Polarsteps SAR Plan.

- A yearly free flight or train ride to a random location! Give our Teleporter a spin here. 

- A shiny new MacBook to work your magic on.

- Hybrid working, our way. Work from home and the office, we ask everyone to be in the office 2 days a week. It’s how we stay flexible, focused, and meaningfully connected in person.

- An extensive home office set-up, everything from noise-canceling headphones to a standing desk.

- 30 days of vacation (for adventures or sitting on the couch, it's up to you)

- Two paid Culture Days for days that are important to you but not recognized by the official Dutch calendar.

- The option to switch up your Zoom background by working from another country for up to 8 weeks a year.

- A personal development budget for that curious mind of yours!

- A pension plan to help you save for those around-the-world retirement trips.

- Delicious daily team lunches.

- Awesome monthly parties, as well as team trips away.

- A lively office in downtown Amsterdam, with travel costs reimbursed.

- Free Polarsteps Travel Books to contain all your far-flung adventures.

At Polarsteps, we believe the best products are built by people as diverse as the travelers using our apps! That's why we specifically encourage people underrepresented in the tech industry to apply for a role with us. Because we believe that diversity, be it age, race, sexual orientation, physical ability, ethnicity, or gender identity, makes both the world and the workplace better.

Think this is the path for you? Find out more about how we hire.

Quantitative Trader | Crypto Options
description:
BlockTech is hiring a Quantitative Trader to join its options trading team in Amsterdam. In this role, you'll take ownership of our trading systems and bring new direction to the desk.

We trade crypto derivatives and spot markets across global venues, 24/7. Our traders don't just watch the systems. They own them end-to-end.

About BlockTech 

BlockTech is an algorithmic trading firm headquartered in Amsterdam, with a second office in Singapore. We specialize in market making and trade cryptocurrency derivatives and spot markets globally, using our own capital. We're growing fast and expanding into new markets.

Our traders work side by side with quantitative researchers and engineers. Research, engineering, and trading happen a few meters apart, so the path from a market read to live PnL is short.

What will you do? 

You'll own the systems that trade our capital, from day-to-day operation to the strategies that come next. As a senior trader, you'll also use what you've learned elsewhere to shape where the desk goes.

You will:

- Own the systems. Monitor, operate, and tune our automated trading systems in live markets.

- Manage the risk. Manage positions and risk, adjusting pricing and parameters as market behaviour shifts.

- Set new directions. Bring new ideas to the desk, drawing on your previous experience.

- Build new strategies. Develop and deploy new strategies together with quantitative researchers and engineers.

- Spot what’s next. Identify and research new business opportunities as markets change.

What we're looking for 

You'll need:

- A strong academic background in a quantitative field such as mathematics, physics, statistics, or computer science.

- 3+ years of quantitative trading experience.

- Proficiency in Python, with excellent numerical and algorithmic skills.

- Focus and sound judgment behind the screen when markets get busy.

Bonus points for:

- Experience at a proprietary trading firm or hedge fund, particularly with mid-frequency strategies, prediction markets or DeFi.

You don't need: crypto experience. If you've successfully traded derivatives on other asset classes and want to bring that experience to BlockTech, we want to hear from you.

Pay, location, and relocation 

- Compensation: a competitive base salary plus a very attractive performance bonus based on individual and company results.

- Trading fund: strong performers get the opportunity to buy into the trading fund.

- Location: On-site on our trading floor in Amsterdam

- Visa: BlockTech sponsors the Dutch highly skilled migrant visa.

- Relocation: All-in relocation package and Dutch classes for international hires. Eligible hires may qualify for the 30% ruling.

What else is in it for you 

- Pension plan, company laptop, and home internet reimbursement

- An extensive in-house training program and an annual learning and development budget

- An environment that embraces AI, both to speed up your work and to advance our systems

- Gym reimbursement and sports during working hours: kickboxing, CrossFit, fitness, and soccer

- Weekly Friday drinks, monthly outings, quarterly sports competitions, and two trips abroad a year

- Daily breakfast and warm lunch, plus snacks and drinks all day

How we work 

We're a team of trading and tech enthusiasts with a flat hierarchy. Have an idea today, and it can ship tomorrow. The best idea wins, whoever it comes from.

This role comes with a high degree of autonomy. You'll own hard problems from concept to production and solve them your way. We promote reverse leadership, give everyone an equal playing field, and invest in personal and professional development.

Our culture 

At our core, we are a team of passionate trading and tech enthusiasts committed to revolutionizing trading through automation. Our collaborative approach ensures that everyone contributes to achieving our ambitious goals.

In this role, you will be both challenged and stretched, with ample opportunities for growth and development, both within and beyond your main responsibilities.

We invest in our people by offering competitive compensation and benefits, fostering innovation, and celebrating success. Our commitment to personal development transcends traditional norms; we provide an equal playing field, promote reverse leadership, and offer boundless growth opportunities for all our employees.

Join us to unlock your potential and drive innovation in the exciting world of algorithmic trading.

title: Growth Engineer (Intern)
description:
👷🏻‍♀️ What we do 👷🏻‍♀️

At Emidat, we are building the first climate-native product management system for building material manufacturers.

Emidat aims to decarbonise building materials, making up 11% of global GHG emissions. We collect data from physical production processes, generate a digital product passport with verified environmental data and make it usable along the value chain. In short: One solution to assess, design, buy, sell and manage products - with environmental impact at the core. 

Embodied carbon is emitted on day zero and can never be reduced later, while global floor area is set to double by 2060. From January 2026, EU regulation (CPR) requires verified environmental data. 430,000 manufacturers will need it, and only about 2,500 have it today. That gap is our market. 

Find out more about us, the team and our values here. 

What you will work on 

Your mission 

Drive initiatives that grow Emidat. In Growth we prioritise by one question: does this bring in new customers? As a Growth Engineer Intern you work across our four growth functions that sits closest to that answer; 1. Growth Engineering, 2. Growth Marketing, 3. Sales Development and 4. Partnerships

Topics you might work on: our automated campaign planning and lead development process, and the automations behind it. Our mapping of the total addressable market (TAM) and the GTM analysis sheet we use to decide which segments and countries to go after. Our industry get-togethers, for example expert exchanges and C-level breakfasts, from the invite list to the follow-up. LinkedIn posts and customer case studies, which means talking to manufacturers who use Emidat and turning what they tell you into material our sales team can send. 

This internship is ideal for someone who has future aspirations to ‘found’ a company. Building a revenue function is one of the most difficult parts of founding, and during your internship, you’ll get insights into how demand is created, how a pipeline is built, and how AI actually optimises a go-to-market team. You will work on initiatives with the leads of each growth function, including our Head of Growth. We expect you to work independently, form your own view on what to prioritise, and challenge us when you think we have it wrong.

During your Internship, you will: 

Joining our Growth team involves:

- Own our Campaign Process: Run and sharpen the automated workflow that qualifies and enriches our target accounts, and take responsibility for the pipeline our SDR team works from.

- Map our Market: Extend our TAM mapping into every new geography we enter, and keep our view of the relevant manufacturers, associations and registries current - so the commercial team always plans against a reliable picture of who is worth targeting.

- Turn Data into Decisions: Build and maintain the reporting our team steers by, from campaign performance to pipeline health. Translate data into clear, actionable insights and own the data quality that makes those numbers trustworthy.

- Organise our industry get-togethers: Organise formats like the BAU Dinner, our C-level AI Breakfasts and the Climate Native Summit end-to-end - guest list, invitations, on-site logistics and follow-up - turning each one into a reliable source of senior conversations.

- Build Our Market Presence: Draft posts for our company page and keep our content calendar running: webinars and event announcements, product news, new joiners, and the pieces that build our positioning in the market.

CRM: Hubspot

Automation: N8N, Clay

Outreach: Lemlist , LinkedIn Sales Navigator

AI Tooling: Claude Co-work/Code
Content & design: LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Figma

Messaging: Slack & Google Workspace

Minimum Requirements 

- Language: Fluent (C2/Native) in German and business fluent (C1+) in English.

- Data-Driven System Integration: Proven ability to interpret complex performance data, generating actionable insights that directly inform strategy. You must be able to effectively bridge data analysis with our internal tech stack to drive business outcomes.

In dieser Rolle leitest du eigenverantwortlich die Erstellung von medizinischen Online-CME-Fortbildungen. Warum AMBOSS? 

AMBOSS ist ein starkes und effizientes Lerntool für das Medizinstudium und Hilfsmittel für ärztliche Entscheidungen im Klinikalltag, das Ärzt:innen weltweit zur bestmöglichen Patientenversorgung befähigen will.
