title: Lead Tech SRE
description:
About Kestra

Kestra is the universal orchestration platform : open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems.

Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide , including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole , Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars , hundreds of contributors, and a fast-growing global community.

About the role

Kestra Cloud is our fully managed SaaS edition of Kestra. Each customer gets a dedicated Kestra instance on dedicated infrastructure, so the platform is a fleet of isolated stacks rather than one shared cluster. It is in Beta today, running production workloads for early customers, with General Availability planned for 2027. Each instance runs arbitrary user code (scripts, containers, queries against their own systems) through hundreds of plugins, and the fleet grows with every new customer. Provisioning, upgrading, and observing dozens to hundreds of identical stacks without drift is the core problem.

We're looking for a Lead Tech SRE to own Kestra Cloud end to end: the architecture and specs, the delivery, the monitoring, and the continuous improvement of the platform. You decide how the platform should evolve, write it down, split it into work, and ship it with your team.

You would lead a team of three, yourself included. That means you stay hands-on (a large share of your week is Terraform, Kubernetes manifests, and incident work) while setting the technical direction, reviewing designs, and dispatching work to two SREs.

You work closely with the CTO, the platform engineering teams building the Kestra core, and our security engineer. This is an engineering leadership role, not a people-management-only one. 

What you would do

Architecture & specs 

- Own the target architecture of Kestra Cloud on GCP: the per-customer dedicated stack (cluster, network, databases, queues), how it is templated and versioned, regions, and the path from Beta to GA.

- Write the specs (design docs, RFCs, ADRs) that turn product needs into infrastructure work, and defend the trade-offs: cost per customer vs isolation level, GCP project vs cluster vs node pool per customer, managed service vs self-run.

- Define SLOs and error budgets per service and per tier, and make them the basis for prioritization.

Delivery 

- Break specs into work and dispatch it across the team, then review and unblock. You set the bar for Terraform modules, Helm charts, and GitOps conventions.

- Automate the customer instance lifecycle : provisioning, upgrades, scaling, backups, migration, and decommissioning, with no manual steps.

- Own the release path of Kestra Cloud with ArgoCD and GitHub Actions: progressive rollouts, rollback, and upgrade safety across the whole fleet of customer instances.

Monitoring & operations 

- Build the observability stack (metrics, logs, traces, alerting) so that issues are caught before customers report them.

- Run on-call and incident response for the team: rotation, runbooks, blameless postmortems, and follow-ups that actually ship.

- Plan capacity for a workload that is bursty by nature, and keep autoscaling honest.

Continuous improvement 

- Drive cost efficiency (FinOps) on GCP: per-customer cost visibility, right-sizing, committed use, and spot where it fits.

- Harden the platform with our security engineer: network policies, workload identity, secrets, and audit trails toward SOC 2 expectations.

- Feed back into the product : when Kestra itself makes the cloud hard to run, you write the issue, propose the fix, and work with core engineering to land it.

Our Tech Stack

- Cloud : GCP (GKE, Cloud SQL, GCS, Cloud Load Balancing, IAM / Workload Identity)

- Infrastructure as Code : Terraform, Helm

- Orchestration : Kubernetes, Docker

- Deployment & Repository : GitHub Actions, ArgoCD

- Monitoring & Logs : OpenTelemetry, Elastic, Prometheus, Grafana

- Datastore : PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch

- Queuing : Redis, Kafka, AMQP

- Programming language : Java, TypeScript (you read it; you don't need to write it daily)

What we are looking for

- 8+ years in SRE, platform, or infrastructure engineering , including at least 2 years leading the technical direction of a team or a platform.

- Deep, production-grade Kubernetes expertise : you have operated fleets of clusters at scale and know where they break (upgrades, configuration drift, networking, resource sizing).

- Strong Google Cloud experience : GKE, IAM, networking (VPC, private clusters, load balancing), and managed data services. Equivalent depth on AWS or Azure is not a substitute here.

- Expert Terraform : you have designed module structures and state layouts that scale to many identical customer environments, not just written resources.

- Proven ability to architect, spec, and dispatch : you can show design docs you wrote, explain the trade-offs you made, and describe how you split the work and delivered it.

- Real on-call and incident experience , including running postmortems and turning them into durable fixes.

- SaaS operations background : you have run a product for paying customers, with SLOs that mattered.

- Fluent in English and comfortable working autonomously in a fully remote environment.

- Pragmatism: you pick the boring solution when it works and can explain why.

Nice to have

- Experience running workloads that execute untrusted or user-defined code (sandboxing, gVisor, node pool isolation).

- Built or operated a fleet control plane for per-customer environments (Kubernetes operators, Crossplane, GKE Fleet / Config Sync, or custom provisioning services).

- FinOps practice on GCP: per-customer cost attribution, committed use discounts, spot node pools.

- Exposure to SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audits from the infrastructure side.

- Familiarity with workflow orchestration (Kestra, Airflow, Temporal, or similar) or the JVM in production.

Your first six months

- Month 1 : take over the current architecture, audit the current Kestra Cloud architecture, and map the gaps between Beta and GA.

- Months 2 to 3 : publish the GA architecture spec and the SLOs, agree on them with the CTO, and turn them into a roadmap the team can execute.

- Months 4 to 6 : deliver the first GA milestones (one-click provisioning of a customer instance, observability coverage, safe upgrade path) with your two SREs.

- After month 6 : drive continuous improvement of the platform, including a re-architecture of the first version of Kestra Cloud based on what Beta and the first GA customers taught us.

Perks & Benefits

- Work from anywhere : We're a remote-first company, so you can work from wherever feels like home. Plus, you'll have access to coworking spaces worldwide if you ever need a change of scenery.

- Health coverage : From medical support, dental, and vision, we've got you covered.

- Home office setup on us : We'll provide all the equipment you need to work comfortably.

Our Hiring Process

We aim to move quickly (2-3 weeks), but we can adjust the timeline if needed.

- Intro call with our CEO (30 min)

- Technical scenario / Practical assessment (2 hours, asynchronous: write a short design spec for a Kestra Cloud scenario on GKE and Terraform, including how you would split the work across a team of three)

- Architecture review with our CTO, walking through your spec and the trade-offs (45 min)

title: Lead Legal Counsel, Regulatory and Financial Services
description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

Our vision 

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

About us 

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor .

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings 

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

We are currently operating approximately 30k business accounts under a BaaS model with Swan.

The role of Financial Services in our strategy is set to grow, both in terms of revenue and product contribution, to serve our 800k current customer base.

As such, we are initiating a process to get licensed as Etablissement de paiement et Société de financement. Our ambition is to start onboarding new customers by mid 2027 before starting migrating existing customers.

To meet this ambition, we are starting to hire our Tech, Product, Compliance, Legal and Ops leaders.

We are looking for a Lead Legal Counsel to drive the legal function of our Financial Services activity and build our regulatory legal team. 

From the day you join until we are fully licensed, you will structure and execute the legal path to authorization: interpret requirements, translate them into an internal plan, and ensure deliverables are complete, consistent, and aligned across teams. You will help define the target operating model (intra-group and outsourced) and ensure it is legally defensible and well documented for the application.

After licensing, you will shift from “building the file” to running and scaling the legal function of the regulated entity: ensuring ongoing compliance with ACPR expectations, enabling product growth safely, and keeping the operating model (including outsourcing) continuously audit-ready. You will own the legal oversight of day-to-day legal and corporate matters (policies, governance, reporting support, inspections), lead the legal work for launching new regulated products and entering new partnerships, and manage the legal aspects of onboarding and migrating customers to the licensed subsidiary (terms, communications, complaints/conduct risk).

This is a greenfield project with high autonomy and responsibility, and the opportunity to shape the legal culture of a fast-growing fintech while managing and mentoring an experienced Legal Counsel, with the ambition to scale the team further as the business grows. 

Organisation & Reporting 

You will be part of the core Legal Department. Your reporting line will be Stanislas, our General Counsel.

You will manage a seasoned Legal Counsel and will be responsible for planning the future growth of the Financial Services Legal team. You will also partner closely with our Financial Services Chief Compliance and Risk Officer, Chief Operational Officer and the contract team.

Mission & Objectives 

Team Leadership & Structuring 

- You manage, mentor, and develop your team member(s), fostering a high-performance, autonomous, and pragmatic legal culture. 

- You structure the team’s workload and roadmap, delegating effectively while remaining deeply hands-on. 

- You anticipate future hiring needs and actively participate in scaling the regulatory legal team. 

Corporate and governance You design, document and run the legal aspects of corporate governance: delegation of powers, board/committee charters, conflicts management, inter-company arrangements on payment services outsourcing, governance narrative for the ACPR reports, and ongoing legal compliance cadence once authorized.

Products, contracts and customer legal architecture 

- You own the legal design of the FS product perimeter (payments services, account services, credit/financing products as applicable).

- You work with the contractual team (Roland) on the associated contractual framework: customer terms, disclosures, pricing documentation, complaint handling language, and operational/legal flows (including KYC/AML handoffs, incident handling and customer communications).

Outsourcing / BaaS transition & vendor contracting You own legal matters relating to critical outsourcing and third-party reliance (including existing BaaS arrangements): contract negotiation, regulatory outsourcing clauses, audit/access rights, sub-outsourcing controls, exit plans, SLAs, data protection allocation, operational resilience expectations, and documentation suitable for ACPR scrutiny.

Migration readiness In close collaboration with the operation team (Maxime), you lead the legal plan for migrating customers from Swan (sequencing, consent/novation approaches, customer communications from a legal standpoint, continuity of mandates, handling of incidents/complaints, and safeguards to minimise conduct risk).

Privacy and Security In close coordination with our DPO (Léa) and security stakeholders, you ensure that our Financial Services operating model address data processing roles, cross-border flows (if any), retention, incident response, recordkeeping, and contractual protections with key providers.

Regulatory engagement support & internal enablement 

- Until we are fully licenced, you help prepare ACPR interactions (Q&A packs, position papers, meeting preparation).

- Once authorized, you own the relationship with ACPR from a legal perspective, supporting the CCRO with legal opinions, advisory etc.

- You train internal stakeholders on the legal/regulatory constraints that shape product and operations, and build a “legal-by-design” approach for Financial Services.

Culture, Training & Advisory You will be expected to operate as an owner, not a “support function,” and to produce pragmatic, regulator-ready outcomes.

About you 

- You have 8+ years of relevant experience, including in-house legal experience at a regulated entity (payments, EMI/PI, bank, lending/consumer credit, factoring, etc.), fintech, or BaaS.

- You have a proven track record or a strong aptitude for managing, mentoring, and developing team members in a fast-paced environment. 

- You have substantial experience in regulated financial services legal work, and you are comfortable owning cross-functional programmes.

- Senior legal expert in a French ACPR-regulated entity (établissement de paiement, établissement de crédit, société de financement or similar).

- Hands on contract experience and knowledge about our regulatory environment (arrêté du 3 novembre 2014, PSD2, DORA, EBA Guidelines, etc).

Skills & mindset 

Technical strengths You can credibly lead on :

- ACPR/European regulatory frameworks for payments and/or lending/financing;

- Outsourcing and third-party risk legal frameworks in regulated environments;

- Governance and regulated-entity corporate law basics.

Soft skills 

- Player-coach mentality: capable of executing complex individual contributions while guiding and empowering your team. 

- You can work fast without losing rigour.

- Strong pedagogy: able to explain complex regulatory legal topics to product managers, engineers and founders in simple, actionable terms.

- Pragmatic, impact-driven approach, capable of operating under strong regulatory constraints without blocking innovation.

- Very strong written and oral communication skills in both French and English.

Languages, presence and location

- Fluent French and English are mandatory.

- Based in France, with a strong preference for Paris.

- Regular on-site presence in Paris is expected. Partial remote is possible. This is not a fully remote role.

Recruitment Process

1. Interview with Lucie (30-45 min), Senior Recruiter

2. Interview with Stanislas (1h), Head of Legal, Risk & Compliance

3. Case Study with Stanislas & Maxime (1h)

4. Last round with Laurent and Felix (45 min) 

What do we do to make your work life easier 

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries. 

Who are we looking for ? 

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

-To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

-To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

-Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

Important information for candidates

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

title: Quantum Software Engineer
description:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include a very energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions 

Description of the Project 

We are looking for a Quantum Software Engineer to develop the future software stack for controlling utility-scale quantum computers. At the interface of the theory and engineering teams, this ambitious project aims to develop internal tools to streamline the operation of logical quantum circuits on Quandela’s spin-photonic quantum computers.

This position requires a strong understanding of quantum computing protocols on real hardware, strong software engineering skills and proficiency with AI tools.

Your Key Responsibilities: 

- Develop a new compilation stack translating high-level quantum circuits into hardware-aware pulse schedules optimized for our photonic quantum computers.
- Drive long-term architectural strategy, technical roadmap, and cross-organizational alignment.
- Contribute to the development of a digital twin, receiving hardware instructions to simulate the behavior of our future QPUs.
- Stay up to date with the latest developments in quantum software.
How You’ll Grow: 

- 3 months. By the end of the first quarter, you are expected to have a grasp over Quandela’s roadmap and specific approach to quantum computing. You understand how user operations are currently compiled to machine instructions and how that is expected to evolve
- 6 months. By the end of the first semester, you have a firm understanding of Quandela’s technology and are already a key contributor to the compiler codebase for the near future
- 12 months. You have a long-term vision over the quantum software’s activities, and are the owner of one or more work packages for strategic projects.
Requirements 

What we're looking for: 

- Master’s, or PhD in Quantum related field.
- 2/4+ years of relevant experience in quantum software, quantum hardware automation, or related topics.
Must-have: 

- A good understanding of photonic-based quantum computing.
- Strong proficiency in python.
- Experience working at the interface of software, experimental hardware, and theory teams in the industry or academia.
- Collaborative mindset, able to serve as a bridge between various teams.

Important, but you can grow here: 

- Proficiency in at least one system language (C++ or Rust)
- Exposure to the quantum computing frontends and related ecosystem (e.g. cirq, qiskit, openqasm, cuda-q).
- Hands-on experience with quantum photonic systems.
- Familiarity with compilation mechanisms such as LLVM or compilation to microcode.

Benefits 

- Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience 
- Profit-sharing & company savings plan
- 100% health coverage (Alan)
- 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
- Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
- Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer: 

- A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
- A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
- A hybrid work model (3-4 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris or 1 to 2 days remotely)
- Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

title: Photonic Integrated Circuit Designer Intern (H1/2027)
description:
About Quandela 

Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors.

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀

Description of the Team 

The internship will be conducted in the Photonic Integrated Circuits (PICs) department ofQuandela. The PICs team works on the production and development of the optical processors of Quandela quantum computers, having in mind performance and scalability.

In detail, the team members carry out electromagnetic and thermal simulations to estimate the performance of the integrated components, prepare PICs layouts to be fabricated in collaboration with external foundries, and take care of both the characterization and the packaging of the fabricated devices.

Your Key Responsibilities 

Depending on your experience and the duration of the internship, your work may involve deepening the understanding of existing building blocks, exploring new functionalities or tools, or developing advanced modeling approaches for testing. In particular, the goal of this internship will be to either bridge the gap between fabrication and design, or to evaluate new architecture for quantum processing unit (QPU).

In this role you will be using standard electromagnetic simulations and/or circuit modelling by means of commercial software like Lumerical FDTD, FDE, EME or free-tools (gdsfactory, tidy3d, meow, sax..).

Requirements 

- Enrollment for the whole duration of the internship in a MSc in Physics, Telecom/Electronics Engineering, Photonics, Quantum Technologies or related fields. This position is only valid with an Internship Agreement. 
- Minimal duration is 5 months. Shorter internship will not be accepted.

- General knowledge of integrated photonics modelling and layout

title: Principal Application Engineer

title: Laboratory technician
description:
About Orakl Oncology 

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine , helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them - and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

The company is growing fast, and we are now seeking the best talents to come and join our exciting and ambitious team in the fight against cancer - join us!

Position overview 

Orakl Oncology works on a large cohort of patient-derived organoids (PDO) to predict clinical outcomes of patients and derisk clinical trials. We are looking for a dynamic and motivated Lab Technician to help us execute large-scale drug screening assays on our semi-automated platform, either for internal or external projects. In this position, you will:

- Actively participate in our commercial contracts: you will take care of numerous PDOs of interest and perform drug screening assays to generate high-quality, robust datasets. These results will be leveraged by our data science and computational biology teams to deliver actionable insights and decision-support data to our partners.

- Work on the expansion of the Orakl biobank: you will work on patient specimens and organoid cell lines to increase the amount of data collected, thus improving our understanding of cancer.

- Contribute to the optimisation procedures at Orakl: you will bring new ideas and approaches to improve automation and accelerate workflows in both 3D cell culture and drug screening experiments.

- Ensure smooth laboratory operations: you will play a key role in laboratory maintenance, documentation, and traceability of activities, while proactively anticipating the needs for consumables and reagents.

Required qualifications 

- BSc (or equivalent degree such as BTS, BUT, Licence) in cellular biology, biotechnology or any related discipline.

- Hands-on experience in mammalian cell culture, 3D cell culture and preferably organoid culture.

- Hands-on experience in drug screening assays or viability assessment assay.

- Exceptional attention to detail and organisational rigour.

- Flexibility, and a taste for overcoming operational challenges.

- A genuine enthusiasm and passion for teamwork and learning.

- As part of an international team, ability to communicate clearly in English

- Genuine curiosity for cancer biology.

- Strong collaboration and communication skills to interact in an interdisciplinary setting with biologists, ML engineers and researchers.

- Previous experience working in cancer biology

- Fluent in English

Recruitment process 

- HR Call (15 minutes call) – An initial discussion to better understand your background, experiences, and motivations.

- Technical Interview (45 minutes call) – A deep dive into your technical skills and expertise relevant to the role.

- Lab Case (Around 90 minutes) - You will be directly manipulating in our labs to demonstrate your ability to follow a specific protocol and to work under aseptic conditions.

- Founder Interview: As final step of our recruitment process, you will meet the CTO of Orakl Oncology in person at our office. This meeting is an opportunity for the founders to assess cultural fit and ensure alignment with our company values.

title: Senior/Lead Lifecycle Marketing Manager (Full Remote - France)
description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship 

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World 

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next 

At EverAI , we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting , we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform , redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first .

And we’re only just getting started! 

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership 

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO) 

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23 

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM 

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands) 

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth 

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) 

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A 

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone) 

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited) 

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited) 

Your Role

More than 50 million people already use EverAI’s products, and we’re growing toward 100 million.

The audience is already here. The opportunity is what happens next. 

We’re hiring a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager to take CRM to an entirely new level. Your mission is clear: turn it into a major revenue channel by converting more users, increasing repeat purchases, and giving people compelling reasons to keep coming back.

You’ll own everything within CRM, from onboarding and first purchase to retention and reactivation, across email, push notifications, in-product messaging, and promotions.

You’ll report directly to Thomas Lacroix, our Co-founder and CMO , with the freedom to rethink journeys, test ambitious ideas, and build the CRM playbook that gets us there.

At our scale, even small improvements can influence millions of user journeys and create significant growth.

If you’re looking for more than a campaign-management role, this is your opportunity to drive measurable growth at exceptional scale. 

Your Responsibilities

- Own one of EverAI’s biggest growth opportunities: lead the strategy and execution across the full CRM lifecycle, from onboarding and conversion through repeat purchasing, retention, and reactivation

- Find the growth hiding in our user base: use behavioral data to uncover where users lose interest, stop engaging, or miss an opportunity to purchase

- Crack the first-purchase challenge: create onboarding, abandoned-payment, offer, and follow-up journeys that turn more registered users into paying customers

- Keep users coming back: increase token purchases, repeat purchasing, retention, reactivation, and LTV through smarter segmentation, personalization, and timing

- Test big ideas quickly: build experiments, measure what genuinely moved the numbers, scale the winners, and turn each result into the next opportunity

- Make ambitious CRM ideas possible: work directly with Product, Data, Engineering, and Creative to improve the tooling, tracking, messages, offers, and reporting behind the channel

Your Qualifications

- You’ve scaled CRM before: you can show significant improvements you personally drove in revenue, conversion, repeat purchases, retention, reactivation, or LTV, with real numbers

- You understand consumer growth: you’ve worked in a high-volume B2C subscription business, where CRM had a direct effect on revenue

- You think like a builder: you do not stop at recommendations; you can personally create segments, journeys, experiments, campaign logic, and performance analysis

- You know how to find and prove what works: you can turn user behavior into ideas and use testing, control groups, attribution, and incrementality to validate the results

- You move quickly and take ownership: you are comfortable building without a finished playbook, deciding what matters most, and creating momentum without waiting for perfect information

- You communicate clearly and work across teams: you collaborate directly with technical, creative, and commercial stakeholders in English

- You are comfortable with our product category: you can confidently work on products powered by uncensored AI models and content

Bonus points

- You have worked in iGaming, free-to-play gaming, fintech, consumer subscriptions, or high-frequency e-commerce

- You have experience with token, credit, virtual-currency, bonus, or repeat-deposit models

- You have built or redesigned CRM in a fast-scaling company

- You use AI to improve analysis, personalization, experimentation, or content development

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth : From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation : We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact : Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership : A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team : 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies , with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core : Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology , ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech , led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies . We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

description:
Ingénieur Fabrication / Adjoint Responsable Fabrication – Chaudronnerie Nucléaire (H/F) 

- Référence : 261828S 

- Démarrage : Immédiat 

- Durée : Long Terme - Mission de 12 mois, avec intégration en CDI client ensuite 

- Type de contrat : Freelance ou CDIC 

- Zone géographique : Île-de-France (78) 

- Déplacements possibles : Oui, déplacements réguliers en Normandie et dans les Hauts-de-France 

Contexte de la mission 

Dans le cadre d'un projet majeur du secteur nucléaire, nous recherchons un Ingénieur Fabrication / Adjoint Responsable Fabrication spécialisé en chaudronnerie nucléaire pour accompagner la structuration, la mise en place et le pilotage d'activités de fabrication d'équipements chaudronnés, notamment en acier inoxydable. 

La mission s'articule autour de deux sites de fabrication présentant des niveaux de maturité différents : le premier dispose déjà d'une expertise et d'une expérience confirmées en fabrication INOX, tandis que le second n'a encore jamais réalisé ce type de production. 

L'objectif est d'accompagner le déploiement de cette nouvelle activité sur le second site, en s'appuyant sur les savoir-faire existants, tout en assurant la coordination, la transmission des compétences et l'harmonisation des méthodes de fabrication entre les équipes. 

Cette mission nécessite une forte présence terrain, une solide expertise technique en chaudronnerie nucléaire et d'excellentes capacités de communication et de pédagogie pour fédérer les équipes et accompagner le changement. 

Missions 

- Piloter et coordonner les activités de fabrication d'équipements chaudronnés destinés au secteur nucléaire. 

- Participer à la mise en place et à l'organisation des ateliers de fabrication. 

- Accompagner le déploiement d'une nouvelle activité de fabrication INOX sur un site industriel n'ayant jamais réalisé ce type de production. 

- S'appuyer sur l'expertise du site maîtrisant déjà la fabrication INOX pour faciliter le transfert de savoir-faire et de bonnes pratiques vers le second site. 

- Assurer la coordination technique et opérationnelle entre les deux sites de fabrication. 

- Définir et mettre en œuvre les premières lignes directrices et les méthodes de fabrication. 

- Concevoir, définir et mettre en place les gabarits et outillages nécessaires à la fabrication. 

- Accompagner la fabrication d'équipements chaudronnés en acier inoxydable, notamment à partir de tôles de 4 mm d'épaisseur. 

- Assurer le pilotage opérationnel et l'accompagnement technique des équipes de fabrication. 

- Participer activement à la formation des équipes et à leur montée en compétences sur les procédés de fabrication INOX. 

- Favoriser la communication, le partage des connaissances et l'harmonisation des pratiques entre les équipes des différents sites. 

- Structurer et formaliser les méthodes de fabrication ainsi que la documentation technique associée. 

- Élaborer et mettre à jour les documents nécessaires au suivi et à l'organisation de la production. 

- Apporter un appui technique et méthodologique aux équipes afin de garantir le bon démarrage des activités de fabrication. 

- Accompagner les équipes dans l'adoption des nouvelles méthodes et pratiques industrielles. 

- Formation technique de niveau ingénieur ou expérience significative en fabrication industrielle et chaudronnerie. 

- Minimum 10 ans d'expérience professionnelle en fabrication industrielle et chaudronnerie, principalement acquise dans le secteur nucléaire. 

- Expérience confirmée en pilotage de fabrication chaudronnée dans un environnement nucléaire. 

- Solide expertise technique en fabrication d'équipements chaudronnés en acier inoxydable. 

- Bonne connaissance des procédés de fabrication et de transformation de tôles INOX. 

- Expérience dans la mise en place, l'organisation ou le développement d'ateliers de fabrication. 

- Capacité à définir des méthodes de fabrication, des gammes opératoires et des gabarits de production. 

- Maîtrise de la documentation technique et des méthodes de fabrication industrielles. 

- Bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques, notamment du Pack Office, pour la rédaction, la structuration et le suivi documentaire. 

- Expérience en encadrement fonctionnel, pilotage et accompagnement d'équipes de production. 

- Capacité à transmettre ses connaissances, à former les équipes et à accompagner leur montée en compétences. 

- Excellent communicant, capable de créer du lien entre les équipes, de faciliter les échanges entre les sites et de faire adhérer les collaborateurs aux nouvelles méthodes de travail. 

- Qualités pédagogiques, sens de l'écoute et capacité à fédérer des équipes présentant différents niveaux d'expertise. 

- Autonomie, rigueur, sens de l'organisation et capacité à structurer une activité industrielle en phase de démarrage. 

- Forte orientation terrain, esprit d'initiative et capacité à intervenir dans des environnements industriels exigeants. 

- Maitrise de la norme NF EN 1090.

title: AI Product Concept Designer & Interior Stylist – Home Décor (Part-/Full-time)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Product Concept Designer & Interior Stylist – Home Décor (Part-/Full-time) based in France. 

In this fully remote role, you will combine creative vision, interior design expertise, and advanced AI image-generation skills to develop distinctive, commercially promising home décor products. You will transform emerging design trends and customer preferences into original product concepts and compelling visual experiences. A key part of your work will involve creating photorealistic interior scenes that showcase products with accurate materials, textures, colors, and proportions. You will collaborate with designers to refine concepts and prepare product visuals for e-commerce launches. By balancing aesthetics with commercial potential, you will help shape an attractive product portfolio for a premium home décor brand serving online customers. This long-term freelance opportunity offers the flexibility to work part-time or full-time while contributing directly to product innovation and digital merchandising. It is ideal for a visually driven creative professional who understands how to turn inspiring design ideas into products customers want to buy.

Accountabilities 

- Product concept development: Research interior design trends, competitor offerings, and customer preferences to identify new home décor opportunities and develop original, commercially viable product concepts.

- AI-powered concept visualization: Use advanced generative AI tools to explore, visualize, and refine new physical product ideas, translating creative concepts into compelling visual representations.

- Interior styling and scene creation: Place existing and proposed products into realistic, aesthetically cohesive AI-generated interiors that reflect different design styles, including Japandi, organic modern, and coastal interiors.

- Photorealistic product imagery: Produce high-quality lifestyle and product visuals for e-commerce websites, ensuring generated images accurately represent the original products' shapes, proportions, materials, colors, and textures.

- Visual quality and consistency: Maintain high standards of realism, composition, lighting, and styling across all creative outputs, ensuring that product details remain faithful to the intended designs.

- Trend research and opportunity identification: Monitor emerging interior styles, materials, product categories, and customer preferences to uncover opportunities for new product development and commercial growth.

- Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with designers and relevant team members to refine concepts, incorporate feedback, and prepare product designs and visual assets for launch.

- Commercial evaluation: Assess the market appeal and potential sales value of proposed products, balancing aesthetic originality with customer demand and commercial objectives.

- E-commerce content development: Create visually engaging product and lifestyle imagery that strengthens online merchandising, communicates product value, and supports customer purchasing decisions.

- Creative workflow management: Organize multiple projects, manage deadlines, maintain clear communication, and deliver consistent, high-quality outputs in a fully remote working environment.

- Product feasibility awareness: Consider practical manufacturing requirements, material limitations, production constraints, and shipping considerations when developing physical product concepts.

Requirements

- Visual design and aesthetic expertise: Excellent visual taste and a strong understanding of interior design, styling, color theory, materials, textures, proportions, and composition.

- Advanced AI image-generation skills: Demonstrated proficiency with generative AI tools such as Nano Banana, Flux, Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, or comparable platforms.

- Photorealistic image creation: Proven ability to generate convincing interior scenes and product imagery while preserving accurate product characteristics, including shape, material, color, texture, and proportions.

- Creative concept development: Strong imagination and the ability to translate market insights, design inspiration, and customer preferences into original, visually appealing, and commercially promising physical products.

- Relevant portfolio: A portfolio demonstrating high-quality interior visuals, AI-generated imagery, product concepts, home décor projects, or other closely related creative work.

- Project management and organization: Strong organizational skills, reliability, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple creative assignments while meeting deadlines.

- English proficiency: Fluent English communication skills for collaborating with the team, discussing concepts, understanding feedback, and documenting creative decisions.

- Commercial awareness: An understanding of how visual design, product differentiation, and customer preferences influence purchasing decisions in e-commerce.

Strongly preferred: 

- Professional experience in home décor, interior styling, furniture, or lifestyle products.

- Experience developing concepts for physical products from initial inspiration through visual refinement.

- Familiarity with US interior design trends, home décor preferences, and target customer expectations.

- Experience producing product photography alternatives, lifestyle visuals, or marketing imagery for e-commerce websites.

- Knowledge of wood, natural finishes, and other materials commonly used in premium home décor.

Nice to have: 

- Experience collaborating with manufacturers, product designers, or suppliers.

- Understanding of product feasibility, manufacturing processes, production constraints, and shipping considerations.

- Experience using Pinterest, Instagram, or similar platforms to research interior design inspiration, consumer trends, and emerging product opportunities.

- Familiarity with iterative creative workflows that combine AI-generated concepts with product development and commercial evaluation.

Important role clarification: This position focuses on AI-assisted product concept development, interior styling, and photorealistic visual creation. It is not a traditional CAD design or UX/UI design role. The ideal candidate combines outstanding visual judgment with the ability to create attractive, realistic, and commercially viable home décor concepts using generative AI.

Benefits

- Competitive compensation: US$25–$45 per hour, depending on experience, skills, and portfolio quality.

- Flexible engagement: Choose between part-time and full-time collaboration, with an expected workload of approximately 25 hours per week.

- 100% remote work: Work remotely from Anywhere.

- Long-term opportunity: Initial 12-month contract with an emphasis on sustained collaboration and continued product development.

- Freelance flexibility: Independent contractor engagement, offering flexibility in organizing your work and managing creative projects.

- Creative ownership: Contribute directly to product concepts, interior styling, and visual assets that support commercial launches.

- AI-driven innovation: Work with modern generative AI tools to explore new creative workflows and develop innovative product imagery.

- Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with designers and other team members to refine concepts and bring new home décor products to market.

- Portfolio development: Build experience creating AI-powered product concepts and high-quality lifestyle visuals for a premium direct-to-consumer e-commerce business.

Application requirements: 

Please include the following when applying:

- Your portfolio featuring relevant interior visuals, product concepts, AI-generated images, or home décor projects.

- A list of the AI image-generation tools you regularly use.

- Your expected hourly rate.

- Your availability and preferred working arrangement (part-time or full-time).

description:
Qui sommes nous ? 

Chez MARGO, nos consultants travaillent sur ce qui compte vraiment : des projets complexes qui allient challenge intellectuel et impact business réel. 

C’est pourquoi nous accompagnons les plus grands acteurs de la finance, de l’industrie et de la tech sur leurs projets les plus stratégiques en Data Science, Machine Learning et Intelligence Artificielle. 

Pourquoi rejoindre la practice IA ? 

Vous évoluerez au sein d’une équipe encadrée par Hamza Bouanani, Practice Manager IA chez MARGO, également Lead Data Scientist chez BNP Paribas. 

Travailler à ses côtés, c’est intégrer une équipe d’experts passionnés, être challengé sur le plan technique et méthodologique, et contribuer à des projets à fort impact pour les clients. 

Vos missions 

Nous recherchons un Machine Learning Engineer pour rejoindre nos équipes et intervenir au cœur de la stratégie Data de nos clients (Industrie, Finance, Énergie). Votre objectif principal sera d'industrialiser les algorithmes de Machine Learning et de garantir leur cycle de vie en production. 

Vous interviendrez sur trois axes techniques majeurs : 

1. Industrialisation & Déploiement (Model Serving) 

- Transformation des modèles de recherche (Proof of Concept) en code de production robuste, testé et optimisé. 

- Développement d'APIs performantes (FastAPI, Flask) pour exposer les modèles aux applications métiers. 

- Conteneurisation des solutions (Docker) et orchestration sur des clusters (Kubernetes) pour assurer la scalabilité et la haute disponibilité. 

2. Architecture MLOps & Automatisation 

- Conception et maintenance de pipelines CI/CD dédiés au Machine Learning (réentraînement automatique, validation des modèles). 

- Mise en place et gestion d'outils d'orchestration de flux de données (Airflow, Kubeflow, Dagster). 

- Gestion du versioning des données et des modèles (DVC, MLflow) pour assurer la reproductibilité des expériences.

The NIRLAB team at 908 Devices , based in Lausanne, Switzerland, develops advanced handheld spectroscopy solutions that combine near-infrared (NIR) spectroscopy with machine learning. - Open minded, willing to learn new skills and share your expertise.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
About Rivia 

Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.

Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.

Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital.

Rivia’s ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end.

About AI Engineering at Rivia 

Given the highly complex nature of clinical trials and how they interface with our technology, the AI Engineering team at Rivia is pivotal in ensuring our clients achieve their desired outcomes and derive maximum value from our platform.

The team designs and operates agentic, production-grade AI workflows that power critical monitoring, data quality, and insight-generation capabilities for clinical trial stakeholders.​

By building reliable, auditable, and scalable AI systems, AI Engineering helps transform fragmented clinical data into actionable intelligence and positions Rivia as the AI-first platform for clinical trial intelligence.

The Role 

As a Senior AI Engineer at Rivia, you will architect and ship high-impact AI workflows that materially improve how clinical trial teams monitor studies, assess data quality, and make operational decisions.​

You will work as a key technical contributor embedded in product initiatives, owning AI features end-to-end from design and evaluation through to deployment, observability, and continuous improvement.​

The ideal candidate is a product-minded engineer who combines deep LLM and agentic systems expertise with strong software engineering skills, a bias to action, and a passion for turning cutting-edge AI into reliable, commercially impactful products in a complex, regulated domain.

What excites you 

- Being part of a collaborative startup where you can make a direct impact on the product, the business, and the team.

- Working in a fast-paced environment where you can leverage your AI engineering expertise to solve complex, real-world problems in clinical trials.

- Building AI systems that customers rely on for critical decisions, where trust, traceability, and auditability are essential.

- Owning outcomes end-to-end, driving clarity, momentum, and quality without heavy oversight, and continuously learning and experimenting in the rapidly evolving LLM landscape.

Responsibilities 

- Architect and ship production-grade agentic AI workflows, including tool use, orchestration, planning, memory, and structured outputs, for clinical trial intelligence use cases.

- Translate user workflows and product requirements into pragmatic, measurable AI solutions that work reliably in production and optimize for user and business value.

- Design and maintain evaluation pipelines, including gold sets, metrics, and experiments, and use them to drive iteration with rigor.

- Implement robust LLMOps practices, including tracing, monitoring, cost and latency management, safe deployment, and continuous improvement of AI systems in production.

- Design high-quality retrieval and context pipelines with strong guarantees on correctness, provenance, and auditability, particularly in regulated environments such as clinical trials.

- Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, Design, Sales, and Customer teams to ensure AI features are usable, trusted, and commercially impactful.

- Stay deeply current with the LLM ecosystem, actively experiment with new models and tools, and translate innovation into practical product advantage.

What Excites us 

- Product mindset, with a demonstrated ability to translate user workflows into pragmatic, measurable AI solutions that work reliably in production

- Deep familiarity with the current LLM ecosystem and active experimentation with new models, tools, and techniques.

- Proven experience building and shipping production-grade AI or agentic systems, ideally in high-stakes or complex domains.

- Strong software engineering skills and comfort owning systems end-to-end, from design to deployment and maintenance.

- Experience going from 0→1 at a VC-backed startup or similarly fast-paced environment.

Hiring Process 

Our hiring process takes 2-5 weeks over four distinct stages:

- Meet and greet: 30-minute call with the HR team to get to know each other. This is an informal chat.

- Technical Screening: 60-minute interview to delve into high-level technical concepts and your problem-solving approaches.

- Coding Interview: 60 mins with the team to assess your coding skills.

- Meet the team: 3-4 hours. Join us at our Zürich office for a visit that includes a team lunch and an in-depth technical interview to explore our mutual fit.

Our Values 

At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team. If you are driven to exceed targets, eager to shape the future of clinical trials, and passionate about making a meaningful difference in the biotech industry, Rivia is the place for you.

- In it to Win it: Approach every challenge with determination, resilience, and a drive, aiming for the best outcomes and solutions.

- Embrace change: We see change as an opportunity for growth, innovation, and improvement, continuously evolving to stay one step ahead

- Why not?: Asking why not, instead of why, allows us to show our curiosity, allowing us to challenge assumptions and explore new possibilities.

- Find the gap: We are curious and we proactively approach identifying opportunities and solving problems before they arise.

- Collective accountability: We are one team, on one mission and we are committed to shared responsibilities and mutual support, enabling trust and collaboration.

- Value add solutions: Know better. Act better. We are dedicated to delivering meaningful and impactful results.

title: Head of Solution Consulting R&D / Field CSO
description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

WHY THIS ROLE, WHY NOW 

R&D leaders trust people who have done the science. More than half of the world's top 50 biopharma companies already use Benchling, and many of the most important are in Europe. Our ambition is 10x faster science, from idea to first dose. With Science Foundries, launched at Benchtalk 2026, agents and scientists run entire R&D workflows together, so a three-person team can have the productive capacity of thirty.

In a senior R&D role, you can change how one organisation does science. As our Field CSO, you'll take one question to R&D organisations across EMEA: how do we get from idea to first dose 10x faster?

ROLE OVERVIEW 

You'll lead our EMEA R&D Solution Consulting organisation: a team of 12, with two first-line leaders covering our Enterprise and Strategic segments, plus occasional support for APAC deals. You'll be the scientific counterpart to our General Manager, EMEA, and work alongside our Field CTO. They lead on IT, data science and architecture; you lead on the scientists and how their work changes.

RESPONSIBILITIES

title: Business Development Intern
description:
Big changes start with people who want to achieve more. 

How do employees get to work? Why do company cars sit idle while parking spaces are scarce? And how can we make sustainable mobility the most attractive choice?

At Urban Connect , we turn these challenges into practical solutions. We bring shared e-bikes and company cars, public transport, mobility budgets and digital parking management together on one platform. We help companies reduce costs, make better use of resources and give their employees greater freedom.

Companies such as Roche, Google, SWISS and Lonza already rely on us. Our ambition goes further: we want to transform how companies manage mobility. 

To make that happen, we are looking for curious minds who take ownership and want to make a difference together.

Your internship: accelerated learning, real responsibility 

Want to understand how a technology company grows—and help make it happen?

During this six-month internship, you will work closely with our Sales and Account Management team, as well as Product and Operations. You will learn to understand customer needs, develop compelling solutions and turn data into tangible business opportunities.

Your initiative matters. You will contribute your own ideas, take on increasing responsibility and see the impact of your work.

How you will make a difference 

- Turn data into opportunities: analyse usage and market data, including vehicle and parking utilisation, and translate your findings into recommendations for better corporate mobility solutions.

- Drive your own projects: Work with the team lead to take ownership of clearly defined projects, such as analysing products, assessing sales opportunities and developing corporate mobility concepts.

- Understand the product: learn how customers are set up on our platform, how bookings and billing work, and how vehicles and parking barriers are connected.

- Work smarter with AI: use AI tools thoughtfully, test new applications and help us improve research, analysis and everyday processes.

- Help drive growth: identify prospective customers, research their challenges and support the team in winning new business and expanding existing partnerships.

- Make a compelling case: create clear presentations, well-founded proposals and insightful quarterly reviews that demonstrate the value of our solutions.

- Keep things moving: maintain accurate customer data and activities in HubSpot, ensuring good conversations lead to clear next steps.

- Connect teams: resolve technical questions with the Product, Operations and Technology teams and communicate the answers clearly to customers and the Commercial team.

What you bring 

- An excellent degree, for example in business, economics, data science, engineering or industrial engineering. We are looking for excellence, curiosity, creativity and courage - not to have studied a perfect subject.

- Some practical experience through an internship, part-time job, personal project or entrepreneurial initiative.

- An analytical mindset, confidence with Excel and the ability to understand and communicate complex ideas and interdependencies clearly and simply.

- Ability to think outside of the box and to question conventional ways of doing things. 

- Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot - and the excellent judgement to critically assess their output. In fact, good judgment is a key criterion for success with us. 

- An interest in technological progress, the curiosity to truly understand how things work, and the confidence to contribute your questions and ideas to a highly motivated team.

- Excellent German and good English skills. French is a big plus. 

Above all, we value your mindset: you learn quickly, ask thoughtful questions and think ahead. You take initiative, develop suggestions and seek support when you need it. You care about the details, strive to make good work even better and are willing to take a risk sometimes to try something new - even when that means making a mistake and learning from it.

What you can expect 

High standards - and an environment of smart, kind people to challenge you to grow. 
We are ambitious, give direct, constructive feedback and support one another. Excellence shows up in our everyday work: in thoughtful solutions, careful execution and the drive to keep improving.

A view of the whole business. 
You will work at the intersection of sales, customer success, technology and operations, learning how an idea becomes a solution that customers value.

Direct access and room to take initiative. 
Good ideas get heard quickly here. Your responsibility grows with your capabilities and commitment.

The opportunity to build a future with us. 
If we are a good fit for each other, there is an opportunity to join Urban Connect beyond the internship and grow with the company.

You will also benefit from:

- Flexible working hours and a beautiful office in Zurich. 

- A monthly mobility budget and access to our e-bikes and shared electric cars.

- A motivated team that enjoys working together (mostly in person), sharing knowledge, growing together, and celebrating success together!

Ready to make a difference? 

Send us your CV and a few personal lines: Why Urban Connect? And what are you proud of having initiated, solved or improved yourself? 

We look forward to meeting you.

title: Growth Marketer (m/f/d)
description:
About Benetics AI

People who build lose nearly a quarter of their working time to things that have nothing to do with building. Ferdinand, an electrician and engineer who had founded companies before, started Benetics AI in 2022 to give that time back. Our first product is a voice assistant for the construction site. It works in over 100 languages and every dialect, and nobody has to type.

More than 500 companies in 10+ countries use Benetics AI: electricians, HVAC installers, timber builders, roofers and solar installers. We are bootstrapped, cash-flow positive and growing in triple digits.

About the role

We are looking for a growth marketer who likes making things and getting them in front of the right people. You will own campaigns across our channels, with Meta, Google and organic social as the main ones today: you plan them, make the content and build the AI workflows behind them. You will work closely with marketing, product and sales, using customer feedback and campaign results to decide what to make next.

What we're looking for

- Campaign-oriented: Build campaigns around a real customer need, connecting audience, message and channels.

- High quality bar: Strong judgment and a track record of shipping work that stands out, from ad copy to short-form video.

- Audience & account-driven: Deeply understand the trades we serve and use what customers and sales tell you to shape every campaign.

- Multi-channel experience: Hands-on depth across several channels, today mostly Meta Ads, Google Ads and organic social.

- Content creation & repurposing: Create posts and short-form video, and turn customer stories and product demos into formats that fit each channel.

- Test and scale: Test clear hypotheses on audiences, messages and creative, and feed what you learn into the next round.

- Marketing analytics: Track spend and lead quality across channels with input from sales, and keep reporting simple and useful.

- AI builder: Build AI workflows and agents that turn customer insights and performance data into new copy, images and video, share them with the team, and keep human review where it matters.

- Sets & hits goals: Own the goals for your channels, measured on cost per lead and lead quality, and decide what to cut and what to scale.

- Velocity: Move quickly from idea to launch and adapt as channels and tools change.

- Language & location: Excellent German and English, spoken and written, and based in Zurich, working from our office on site

Experience

- 3 to 5 years in growth or performance marketing, with campaigns you ran hands-on and can talk through.

- Experience at a B2B tech company; small businesses or the construction trades as an audience are a plus.

- Experience with HubSpot and with connecting creative or marketing tools through automation is helpful.

Why Benetics AI

- A profitable, bootstrapped company with no investor setting the plan.

- Ownership of your channels and the workflows behind them, with room to test and improve how we work.

- Close work with marketing, product and sales, with customer feedback and product knowledge feeding into your content and campaigns.

- Freedom to pick your tools and automate routine work.

How we hire

- Introduction with hiring manager, 15-minute video call

- A practical case with the team.

- Conversation with Ferdinand, our founder, 30 minutes, about the company, growth and the role

- Final decision. We decide quickly and tell you why.

You don't meet every requirement? Apply anyway. Tell us in two paragraphs about a campaign, a piece of content or an AI workflow you built, what you changed and what happened. You don't need a cover letter.

This is a full-time role, hybrid with 3 days a week in our Amsterdam office, or remote from anywhere in the EU.

What you'll work on 

Stream Video runs on an SFU we built in Go on top of Pion, plus ingest and recording fleets, all on a global edge network we own across more than one cloud. Nobody at Stream has owned this media plane end to end before. Our central infrastructure team is tuned for request-based services, and video breaks in different ways: live sessions can't be dropped, bandwidth is the biggest cost, and placement is the main lever. That's why this is a Staff role. You'll set the direction for the video backend and its infrastructure with your own roadmap, reporting to our Director of Engineering with a direct line to our CTO. The Video SDK teams own the client side, and you'll work closely with them and with infrastructure. Part of the fleet is mid-move to Kubernetes.

Job responsibilities: 

- Architecture: write the architecture and roadmap for Stream Video's backend and media infrastructure, and decide what ships.

- Scale livestreaming: architect the SFU and media pipeline (WHIP, WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, SVC), including the path from WebRTC to CDN-backed HLS for very large audiences.

- Own the fleet: reliability, autoscaling, placement, rollouts, observability and cost for long-lived sessions across clouds, with cost per gigabyte as a first-class metric.

- Gate production changes: define the validation that decides which changes, including AI-generated ones, reach live media, using behaviour tests on realistic networks, nightly telemetry scans and a public quality benchmark.

- Take the final escalation: handle the hardest quality, latency and production incidents, and work with enterprise customers on advanced integrations.

- Raise the bar: mentor senior engineers through design review, code review and hiring.

About you 

You've owned systems where a dropped session or a bad rollout is visible to users within seconds, and you think about cost and reliability as much as features. You'd rather write the hard design doc than wait for one. A founder background is an asset here. The team is small, so you'll still write and review plenty of code. If you're looking for a large organisation with a platform team to hand problems to, or a management track, this role won't suit you.

You have: 

- Extensive backend engineering experience, including significant time owning architecture for high-scale production systems

- Expert proficiency in Go or an equivalent systems language (Rust, C++, Java)

- A track record owning real-time, stateful or latency-sensitive systems at very high scale

- Deep knowledge of distributed systems and networking: failure modes, placement, capacity planning and cost

- Strong experience with real-time media or streaming: WebRTC, SFU/MCU concepts, RTP/RTCP, DTLS, or RTMP, SRT and HLS

- Clear written communication: design docs and RFCs that others can act on

- Hands-on experience adopting AI coding and agent tools, and judgement on how to make them safe in production

Bonus points: 

- Built or operated an SFU, or contributed to Pion or another WebRTC stack

- Moved a stateful fleet to Kubernetes, or ran media workloads across more than one cloud

- Knowledge of bandwidth estimation, congestion control, simulcast, SVC and codecs (Opus, VP8/VP9, AV1)

- CockroachDB/PostgreSQL, RocksDB, Raft and Redis at scale

- Experience at developer tooling, API or SDK companies

- Founder or early-stage startup experience building real-time products

- Python or Rust alongside Go

- Conference talks, technical writing or notable open-source work in real-time media

What makes this role exciting 

- Scope: the infrastructure direction for video is yours to run as a product, with the authority to decide what ships.

- Impact: Video is Stream's most complex product, and many customers run it alongside Chat, Feeds and Moderation, so this work matters across the company.

- Stack: Go, Pion, WebRTC, WHIP/WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, Protobuf, CockroachDB/Postgres, RocksDB, Raft and Redis, with Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT Codex in daily use.

- Starting point: a concrete first 90 days. Ship a validation gate on every infrastructure change that reaches production media, and move part of the fleet to Kubernetes with a cost-per-gigabyte number attached.

Why join Stream? 

We're a Series B company with offices in Boulder, Amsterdam, Skopje and Toronto, and a team of 140+ people from 37 nationalities. We're backed by Felicis Ventures, GGV Capital, 01 Advisors, Techstars, and Arthur Ventures, with angels including Dick Costolo (ex-CEO of Twitter), Olivier Pomel (CEO of Datadog), Tom Preston-Werner (co-founder of GitHub), and Nicolas Dessaigne (co-founder of Algolia).

We'll be straight with you: a startup is more demanding than a large company. There's no fixed playbook, you'll own things end to end, and you'll sometimes pick up work outside your title. That's also what makes it a fast place to grow. If you want real ownership and high scale more than structure and a set career ladder, you'll feel at home here.

What we offer 

- Company equity

- 28 days paid time off plus Dutch public holidays

- Pension plan with a company contribution

- NS Business Card or a company bike, covered

- Personal development budget of EUR 500 per year

- Catered lunches in the office

- MacBook Pro

- Up to EUR 60 a month toward a gym or sports club membership of your choice

- Highly skilled migrant (kennismigrant) visa sponsorship and relocation support if you're moving to Amsterdam

This list applies to Netherlands-based employees and is adjusted to your location of residence. If you work remotely from another EU country, you'll be employed through our Employer of Record partner and get company equity plus local benefits depending on your country of employment.

Our culture 

Stream is a casual, transparent team that aims high and supports each other. In engineering, we care about ownership and quality, and our goal is to ship stable software. Management stays hands-on, with less middle management and more time spent doing the work. If that sounds like the environment you want next, apply now.

Stream is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on skills and experience, and we don't discriminate based on age, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, nationality, religion or belief, political opinion, disability or chronic illness, marital status, working hours, type of contract, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need an adjustment at any point in our hiring process, let us know.

Hybrid office policy: applicants based (or relocating to) one of our office locations are expected to work according to the applicable local office attendance policy.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.
